title: (2027 PhD/ABD graduates) Senior Associate (Antitrust & Competition Economics) - European Union
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world. Since 1965, CRA experts have combined rigorous cutting-edge research, state-of-the-art methodology, and proven experience to address our clients’ most complex challenges.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.

Learn more about our work by reviewing our Services and Industries on our website.

The Antitrust & Competition Economics is hiring for the following European Union offices in Brussels, Belgium; Dusseldorf and Munich, Germany; Paris, France.

Position Overview

Senior Associates work closely with senior consultants on project teams and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, playing a key role in shaping the economic analysis and thinking of these cases. Successful candidates have a strong knowledge of economic concepts and a range of research and quantitative skills. A typical Senior Associate would:

  • Identify and conceptualise issues, specifying rigorous economic models to analyse market issues and data, undertaking statistical and econometric estimation, and managing the work of research associate staff and colleagues;
  • Supervise, train and mentor research associate staff;
  • Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using market, industry or client-proprietary data;
  • Act as a primary point of contact for lawyers and other industry or government clients on a variety of practice-relevant issues;
  • Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R, SAS, Matlab, and Mathematica), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions; and
  • Contribute to practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.).

Explore how CRA can help you launch your career and learn why PhDs choose CRA.

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD degree in economics with a completion date of December 2026/Summer 2027 and an academic focus on Applied Microeconomics or Applied Microeconometrics, with specializations like industrial organization, labor, health, behavioural and public economics, or other quantitative areas;
  • Experience in Excel, Stata, Python, R, SQL, SAS, ArcGIS/ArcPy, or Cloud computing (Databricks/Spark, Google Cloud, Azure, AWS);
  • Demonstrated understanding of, and ability to explain, economic, financial and/or accounting concepts, and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;
  • Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;
  • Effective written and oral communication skills;
  • Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;
  • Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;
  • Excellent time management and task prioritization skills; and
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.

As much of our work occurs in our offices, minimal travel is required.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in Europe, submit through this posting:

  • Resume/CV – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals. Also, please note if you have a location preference;
  • Research/Job market paper – please submit your original research or dissertation;
  • Letters of Recommendation – please have three (3) LORs submitted directly to -----

To apply for one of our other global locations, please visit our Careers Site to view available jobs.

Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. Candidates focusing their search on industry and consulting who need to be considered early should indicate that in the CRA online application and submit all materials as early as possible.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including both formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with project management skills, training continues with team management/development, client presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a competitive salary and superior benefits package (plus a sizeable performance bonus), wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

descriptionHtml:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers.

  • Deliver compelling presentations and value propositions that demonstrate how solutions can help customers investigate and disrupt criminal activities.

  • Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams.

  • Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience.

The following qualifications are expected:

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and successfully close high-value, six- and seven-figure deals.

  • Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives.

  • Excellent storytelling abilities and the capacity to translate customer challenges into compelling value propositions.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, account management, prospecting, and strategic territory planning.

  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and ownership of commercial outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.

    • Benefits:

title: Account Executive - Cologne/ Düsseldorf
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in NRW. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)
descriptionHtml:
Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. 

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.
  • Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.
  • Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation
  • Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.
  • Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
  • Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.

Who you are

You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. You are naturally curious and analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.

Minimum requirements

  • Fluent in German
  • 7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
  • Experience moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements and cost models
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly curious with a strong interest in technology 

Preferred requirements

  • Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/Software company
  • Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, but not prerequisite

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Department: Advertising

Location: London 

Contract Type: Permanent

Full Time/Part time: Full Time 

Reporting into: Business Director

About Ogilvy 

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Argos, , Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK Maxx and Pernod Ricard.  

In 2023, Ogilvy UK celebrated their 75th anniversary and was the most awarded agency in Europe. Ogilvy is home to the largest influencer marketing practice globally, and hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – now in its 12th year. 

The Role:  

An Account Executive provides the solid and essential foundations of the team. Keeping projects on track, fostering enduring and robust relationships with junior clients and internal agency team to make sure every detail is considered from briefing to final execution – you’re the glue that holds the internal team together. 

The ‘go to person’ for both Client and Agency when it comes to co-ordination, and a master of the little things that make all the difference.  

You’ll need to be switched on, full of energy, keen to learn and obsessed with great work. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Be the client and competitor expert – become the fountain of all knowledge on client mandatories and regulations, be on the lookout for information, articles and new work relating to the clients, the category or the competition 
  • Be the go-to for Junior clients – helping to maintain and strengthen relationships at that level  
  • Be opinionated about the creative – bring your own unique perspective on work to creative reviews, share creative you think is good/interesting with the team, offer ideas on how to work more effectively     
  • Be commercial - Work closely with finance team to ensure all day-to-day account and project finance is managed smoothly  
  • Be the main support for your team – be organised and proactive in thinking about how you can assist internal teams and clients to keep everything running smoothly and to set the right conditions for great work to thrive   
  • Be organised - Ensure guard books, client server files and brand guidelines are kept up to date; own client status meetings and reports – ensuring actions are met; attend meetings and capture notes and clear next steps; support on prepping creative presentations and sense check work with meticulous attention to detail.  
  • Be collaborative – develop great working relationships with all teams internally; support delivery by managing internal reviews & approvals, setting up projects and defining small scopes    
  • Be curious – get to know the craft of advertising, actively read industry press to develop your own sense of what good looks like, ask questions and actively seek out new learning opportunities   
  • Be an Operational Steward: As the team's operational linchpin, you drive daily operations, uphold processes, and maintain alignment for smooth project execution. You partner with the Project Director to develop scopes, fees, timings, and resource allocation, expertly setting up projects on platforms (e.g., Wrike, Workday), orchestrating kick-offs, and aligning internal stakeholders. 

 Key Skills:  

  • A meticulous eye for detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset 
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple projects  
  • A collaborative approach – to enable you to work closely with creatives, strategists, producers, and clients to bring campaigns to life 
  • A natural communicator  
  • A love of brands, storytelling and creativity  

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core.   • Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Endkunden und fungierst als primärer Ansprechpartner für die dir zugewiesenen Partner (Broker und MSP), um eine enge Zusammenarbeit, die Unterstützung der Partner und den Fortschritt der Geschäftsabschlüsse sicherzustellen.

  • Du baust die Pipeline auf und pflegst sie, vor allem durch die Einbindung von Partnern und die Nachverfolgung von Marketing- und Partner-Leads.

  • Du wendest die Prinzipien des Solution Selling an: Du identifizierst die Probleme der Kunden, vermittelst den Wert der Risikominimierung und erklärst, warum die Lösungen von Eye die Investition wert sind.

  • Du erkennst Wachstumschancen in deiner zugewiesenen Region und im Partnernetzwerk.

  • Du arbeitest mit den Produkt- und Marketingteams zusammen und vertrittst Eye auf Branchenevents

Dein Profil

  • Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Bedarfsanalyse und Solution Sales aus

  • Deine Reisebereitschaft sollte bei ca. 40 % liegen, auch wenn viele Termine remote stattfinden

  • Du wirst Teil eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Cyber Security-Start-ups in Europa

title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com.

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents, nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez www.wppmedia.com.

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.

Rôle et missions :

Vous intégrerez l’entité experte en communication extérieure (OOH et DOOH) de WPP Media, acteur de référence de l’affichage papier et digital en France.

Rattaché directement au Directeur Commercial OOH/DOOH, vous piloterez en toute autonomie un portefeuille d'annonceurs de premier plan. Vous interviendrez en tant qu’expert conseil et commercial auprès des équipes média internes et des clients pour démocratiser, valoriser et développer les investissements en affichage.

Vos missions au quotidien :

  • Conseil stratégique & Recommandations média :
  • Prendre en charge les briefs clients et challenger les besoins en visibilité locale, nationale et événementielle.
  • Concevoir des stratégies OOH/DOOH sur-mesure, créatives et performantes .
  • Rédiger les recommandations et les soutenir avec impact lors des présentations clients ou auprès des pôles Conseil de l'agence.
  • Négociation & Achat média :
  • Réaliser une veille en temps réel des inventaires et opportunités d'affichage disponibles sur le marché.
  • Consulter et négocier les conditions tarifaires, les emplacements stratégiques et les formats auprès des régies partenaires (JCDecaux, Cityz Media, Mediatransports,...).
  • Déploiement opérationnel & Bilan de campagne :
  • Coordonner la bonne mise en place des campagnes (réservations, transmission des éléments techniques, validation des BAT,...).
  • Mesurer et analyser l'efficacité des dispositifs (calcul des performances d'audience via Mobimetrics, couverture/répétition, KPIs DOOH).
  • Élaborer des bilans de campagne précis, enrichis d'insights et d'apprentissages pour fidéliser les clients.
  • Développement commercial & Suivi financier :
  • Faire preuve de pédagogie et de proactivité pour évangéliser les leviers de l'affichage print & digital et développer le chiffre d'affaires de votre portefeuille.
  • Assurer le suivi administratif et budgétaire de vos campagnes (bons de commande, facturation annonceurs et régies).

Profil Recherché :

Expérience : Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 2 à 4 ans dans l'achat d'espace et la gestion de campagnes d'affichage (OOH et/ou DOOH), idéalement acquise en agence média (profils issus de régies publicitaires ouverts si vous disposez d'une bonne vision d'ensemble de l'écosystème).

Compétences techniques & Outils :

  • Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème de la communication extérieure et des régies publicitaires.
  • La maîtrise ou une bonne connaissance des outils de mesure d'audience affichage (idéalement Mobimetrics) est un réel atout.
  • Solide maîtrise du Pack Office, notamment Excel (gestion budgétaire, analyse chiffrée) et PowerPoint (création de livrables clients percutants).
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel courant indispensable (écrit et oral

Qualités relationnelles & Soft skills :

  • Autonomie & Rigueur : Vous êtes capable d'organiser votre activité en direct avec votre manager, avec le souci du détail et la culture du résultat chiffré.
  • Fibre commerciale & Aisance à l'oral : Vous avez le sens du contact, aimez aller à la rencontre des équipes Conseil et des annonceurs, et savez convaincre lors de réunions ou soutenances.
  • Créativité média : Vous êtes curieux, passionné par les innovations visuelles et les nouvelles technologies appliquées au DOOH.
  • Qualité rédactionnelle : Une excellente expression écrite et orale en français est indispensable.

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur.

Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.


Localisation : Levallois-Perret

Nos avantages comprennent :

  • Cadre de travail : Un tout nouveau campus moderne à Levallois-Perret (terminus ligne 3 - Pont de Levallois) regroupant toutes les agences du groupe WPP.
  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année.
  • Congés offerts : 2 jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte.
  • Ancienneté : Jours de congé additionnels par palier de 5 ans d’ancienneté.
  • Santé & Équité : 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaboratrices souffrant d’endométriose.
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel (CESU), et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH.

  • Engagement sociétal : Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act.
  • Tools : Accès à des outils performants et à la pointe de la technologie pour la gestion des campagnes et le reporting (WPP Open).

Process de recrutement :

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du parcours :

  1. Entretien avec l’équipe Recrutement : Un premier échange téléphonique ou par visioconférence avec l’équipe Talent pour faire le point sur vos compétences, vos aspirations et vous présenter le groupe.
  2. Entretien opérationnel (10-15 min) : Un premier contact rapide (Teams ou téléphone) avec le Manager pour aborder concrètement le poste et l'équipe.
  3. Entretien physique & Business Case : Une rencontre finale dans nos locaux à Levallois-Perret avec le Manager et la Directrice de l’entité, incluant une étude de cas.

title: Account Manager SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) - Mitteldeutschland
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Mitteldeutschland zählt zu den wichtigsten Gesundheitsregionen Deutschlands – und zu den Märkten, die Digitalisierung am dringendsten brauchen. Wir bei Doctolib machen diesen Wandel möglich: mit einer KI-gestützten All-in-One-Lösung, die Healthcare Professionals entlastet und Patient:innen bessere Versorgung bringt – Praxis für Praxis.

Als Account Manager SaaS / B2B (x/f/m) führst Du Dein Territory wie ein eigenes Business: von der strategischen Marktbearbeitung bis zum kontinuierlichen Umsatzwachstum. Deine Mission: Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams in Thüringen und Sachsen für Doctolib zu begeistern, nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum voranzutreiben und Deine Region zu einem der stärksten Märkte Deutschlands zu entwickeln. Die Chance, die vor uns liegt, ist noch weit größer als das, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Territory Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Du trägst die vollständige Verantwortung für Dein Vertriebsgebiet – von der Marktanalyse über gezielte Akquise bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du entscheidest, wie Du Deine Energie einsetzt, um maximalen Impact zu erzielen.

  • Nachhaltiges Umsatz- und Pipelinewachstum: Du verantwortest Deinen Erfolg, Deine Pipeline und Dein Netzwerk in der Region – und Du weißt, wie Du alle drei systematisch aufbaust und konsequent entwickelst.

  • Stärke im Neukundengeschäft: Du verstehst, was Ärzt:innen und Praxisteams bewegt – und machst dieses Verständnis zu Deinem stärksten Argument. Du akquirierst zielgerichtet, pitchst mit Überzeugung und bringst Deals konsequent zum Abschluss.

  • Datengetriebene Vertriebssteuerung: Du misst Deine Performance konsequent mit Salesforce, analysierst Deine Kennzahlen, erkennst Muster früh und steuerst gezielt nach.

 

Dein Profil

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Nachgewiesene Stärke im Digital Health Sales: Du bringst solide Vertriebserfahrung im Vertrieb von komplexen Praxissoftware-Lösungen (SaaS) mit und verstehst, was Deine Kunden aus dem Gesundheitswesen beschäftigt. Die Dynamik komplexer Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Neukundenakquise mit strategischem Blick: Du liebst es, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen – und Du gehst dabei nicht nach Bauchgefühl vor. Du analysierst, priorisierst und pitchst mit Präzision.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du bist davon überzeugt, dass smarte Technologie den Praxisalltag wirklich verbessern kann – und Du machst diese Überzeugung im Gespräch spürbar. Für Ärzt:innen, für Praxisteams, für den Markt.

  • Kommunikation auf Top-Niveau: Du drückst Dich sehr gut mündlich und schriftlich auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) aus; Deine Englischkenntnisse sind außerdem mindestens auf Konversationsniveau (B1).

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, dass der größte Impact im direkten Kontakt entsteht – bei Ärzt:innen, in Praxen, in der Region. Ein Wohnort in Thüringen oder Sachsen (oder die Bereitschaft, umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deines Vertriebsgebiets sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind daher Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Unser Doctolib Parent Care-Programm

  • Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

  • Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner Moka.com

 

Job Details

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit (40h / Woche)

  • Außendienst im Vertriebsgebiet von Hof über Erfurt und Jena bis nach Magdeburg und Leipzig

title: Accounting Manager
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in France.

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee accounting operations and lead financial integration across a growing international group of software businesses. You will manage the General Ledger (GL) team while taking ownership of accounting processes for newly acquired entities, from financial due diligence through post-merger integration. Working closely with senior finance leadership, M&A specialists, external auditors, tax advisors, and business stakeholders, you will ensure accurate financial reporting and effective multi-GAAP consolidation. You will play a central role in strengthening accounting structures, improving financial controls, and supporting the group's continued international expansion. This position offers the opportunity to develop expertise in M&A accounting, statutory reporting, and multi-entity financial management. You will also drive innovation by introducing AI-powered tools and automation to make finance operations more efficient and scalable.


Accountabilities

  • M&A Due Diligence and Integration: Lead the accounting workstream for potential acquisitions, conducting financial due diligence and managing post-merger integration activities, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation support, and fair-value adjustments.

  • NetSuite Implementation and Onboarding: Manage the integration of newly acquired businesses into NetSuite, designing and configuring their chart of accounts, reporting dimensions, and accounting structures to ensure seamless financial onboarding.

  • Financial Consolidation and Multi-GAAP Reporting: Oversee consolidation for newly acquired entities and manage multi-book reporting across different accounting standards, ensuring alignment between group reporting and local statutory GAAP requirements. Handle intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and reporting adjustments.

  • General Ledger and Month-End Close: Lead the GL function and ensure accurate, timely, and consistent month-end closing processes across multiple international entities.

  • Entity Accounting and Tax Compliance: Oversee accounting and statutory reporting for European, Canadian, and US entities, coordinating with external tax advisors to ensure compliance with local tax regulations and reporting obligations.

  • Statutory Audit Management: Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating and managing statutory audits, particularly across European and Canadian entities.

  • Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and develop the GL team, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Process Optimization and Automation: Review existing accounting and consolidation workflows, implement scalable financial controls, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and practical applications of AI tools.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the CFO, Director of Accounting and Tax, M&A and Controlling teams, external advisors, and portfolio company leadership to support financial integration and strategic decision-making.

    • Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

  • At least 8 years of professional accounting experience, including previous experience leading or managing an accounting team.

  • Professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent local certification is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite is essential, including designing accounting structures and onboarding new businesses or legal entities into the platform.

  • Proven experience in M&A accounting, particularly financial due diligence, post-merger integration, opening balance sheets, and consolidation of newly acquired businesses.

  • Experience working within SaaS, software, or technology companies, ideally in a complex multi-entity international structure.

  • Strong knowledge of financial consolidation and multi-GAAP reporting, including the ability to manage group reporting alongside local statutory accounting requirements.

  • Experience overseeing month-end closing, statutory reporting, and tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Familiarity with statutory audits, particularly within European markets, and the ability to coordinate effectively with external auditors.

  • Understanding of intercompany accounting and transfer pricing principles is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of complex accounting matters, and consistently meet financial reporting deadlines in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international teams.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, enhance work quality, and identify opportunities for automation within accounting operations.

  • Curious and adaptable mindset, with an interest in emerging technologies and their practical application to financial processes.

  • 100% Remote Work: Fully remote working arrangements, offering the flexibility to work from wherever you prefer.

  • Flexible Working Hours: Freedom to organize your working schedule around your responsibilities and personal preferences.

  • Competitive, Location-Based Compensation: Salary packages aligned with local market benchmarks for remote professionals, with compensation details shared in writing before the first interview.

  • Flexible Paid Time Off: Time-off arrangements designed to support rest, personal commitments, and a healthy work-life balance.

  • Autonomy and Ownership: A high-trust working environment where employees have the freedom to take initiative, make decisions, and approach challenges independently.

  • Professional Development: Opportunities to expand your expertise in international accounting, M&A integration, financial consolidation, and AI-powered finance operations.

title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen?

Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen.

De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt.

Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten.

Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen.

Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk.

De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen.

HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan.

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers.

  • Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten.

  • Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen.

  • AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers.

  • Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen.

  • De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden.

  • Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent.

  • Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen.

  • Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven.

  • Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie.

Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken.

Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie.

Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen.

“We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.”
– Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead


Wie ben je?

  • Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren.

  • Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren.

  • Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen.

  • Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties.

  • Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring.

  • Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen.

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen.

title: Agent Strategist
descriptionHtml:

We’re looking for someone to own the success of Pace’s agents inside our largest insurance customers.

You’ll take an insurer’s operational problem, determine how our agents and insurance operations team should solve it, and see it through to launch and measurable results. The role blends advisory work with building: part operations strategist, part product owner.

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Have experience in strategy, operations, or technology consulting, or another advisory role where you led customer engagements with senior stakeholders.

Insurance or financial services experience, hands-on work with AI agents, and founder or startup experience are all a plus.

Our team

Two characteristics define the Pace team:

  1. Integrity. We want to work with good people who care deeply about the impact of their work. Our team is committed to doing the best work of their careers and understands that building something lasting takes years of focus.

We’re building a team of exceptional people who grow into leaders. Whether your path is becoming a world-class individual contributor, owning a line of business, or leading a team, we want Pace to be a place where you can learn, make an impact, and grow over the long term.

We’re a team of under 40, working in person across New York and London. With leading customers and top investors, we’re positioned to make a lasting impact on one of the world’s largest industries.

title: AI Applied Engineering – Platform Engineer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

  • Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

  • Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

  • Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

  • Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

  • Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

  • Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

  • Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

  2. Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

  3. Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

  4. Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

  5. Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

  6. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

  • Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

  • Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

  • FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

  • Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

  • Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

 Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.


About this role:
  • Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models.
  • Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking.
  • Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.
  • Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.
  • Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.
  • Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
  • Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination.
  • Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo.

Must Haves:
  • Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision.
  • Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices.
  • Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning.
  • Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation.

Nice to Haves:
  • Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference).
  • Exposure to satellite or geospatial data.
  • Multi-agent or distributed systems experience.
  • Genuine interest in space.

What Can We Offer?
You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. You'll build new expertise on an emerging class of models, reusable across other detection-like use cases, with a concrete prototype and benchmark the team can build on. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France.

Some of our awesome internship benefits:
  • Gratification: €1,300 gross/month.
  • Lunch vouchers (tickets restaurant), because let's be honest, we love food! (we even have a Slack channel about it: #loft-gourmand)
  • Sustainable mobility package (forfait mobilité durable).
  • A genuinely international environment comprising 20+ different nationalities.
  • A genuine mentoring program to support you on a daily basis throughout the internship.
*Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
Who We Are
Loft: Space Made Simple.
Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.
