title: Anthropic Fellows Program, ML Systems & Reinforcement Learning
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Apply at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research 
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers 
  • Access to a shared workspace 
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

ML Systems & Performance Fellows

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include:

  • Alwin Peng
  • Zygi Straznickas

Note: You may research mentors' prior work, but all applications must go through the official form, not the mentors.

For a past example of an engineering-heavy project, see:

  • AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Building a CPU simulator for accelerator workloads
  • Adding backends for different accelerators on an open source project
  • Building on demand infrastructure for other infrastructure heavy fellows projects 
  • Building complex synthetic data or environment pipelines

Unique candidate criteria

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems
  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability
  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing (e.g. in trading)
  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

You may be a good fit if you

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic
  • Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Candidates must be

  • Fluent in Python programming
  • Available to work full-time on the Fellows program

Reinforcement Learning Fellows

Mentors, research areas, & past projects

Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential research areas and mentors include:

  • Ruhua Jiang
  • Kaidi Cao
  • Sunny Duan
  • David Brandfonbrener
  • Colt Steele
  • Dino Distefano
  • Will Williams

Projects in this workstream may include:

  • Building model-based tools to better understand AI training data and improve training data quality
  • A research project to better understand generalization
  • Creating RL environments to improve Claude models at capabilities that are within your domain of expertise
  • Building RL environments for safety-related tasks
  • Conducting research and implementing solutions in areas such as RL algorithms

Unique candidate criteria

You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you:

  • Have strong software engineering skills with experience building complex ML systems
  • Can balance research exploration with engineering rigor and operational reliability
  • Enjoy collaborating across research and engineering disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with large-scale distributed systems and high-performance computing
  • Have experience with training, fine-tuning, or evaluating large language models
  • Are adept at analyzing and debugging model training processes

Logistics

Logistics Requirements: To participate in the Fellows program, you must have work authorization in the US, UK, or Canada and be located in that country during the program.

Workspace Locations: We have designated shared workspaces in SF. We are also open to remote fellows in the UK, US, or Canada. 

Visa Sponsorship: We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the UK, the US, or Canada.

Program Duration: The program runs for 4 months, full-time. If you can't commit to the full duration, please still apply and note your constraints in the application. We review these requests on a case-by-case basis.

Please note: We do not guarantee that we will make any full-time offers to fellows. However, strong performance during the program may indicate that a Fellow would be a good fit for full-time roles at Anthropic. In previous cohorts, 25-50% of fellows received a full-time offer, and we’ve supported many more to go on to do great work on AI safety and security at other organizations.

The below are Anthropic's policies for full time roles. These do NOT apply to the Fellows Program.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Job Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Associate Principals at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Associate Principals conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy.  

At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally.

Responsibilities

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 5-7 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits

Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 day a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
  • Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership 

Customer Research (~20%)

  • Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
  • Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)

  • Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
  • Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

Stakeholders

Product Managers: Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
Engineering & Design: Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
Customer Success: Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
Sales: Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
Marketing: Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
Customers: Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂

title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
descriptionHtml:
About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the Role:
We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale.

Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks

  • Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure

  • Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features

  • Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines

  • Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs

  • Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment

  • Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load

  • Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet

  • Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL)

  • Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms

  • Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team

  • Take ownership and can work independently when needed

  • Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have)

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Collaborative and supportive work environment

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

  • Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Brand & Web Designer
descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Rosa, Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits. 👋

As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role design plays in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently.

I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live.

The first project you'd pick up with me is one I'm particularly excited about: evolving our brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product. After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook.

Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. You'll have a real say in our creative direction, and as the team grows, there's room for you to grow with it.

What you'll do:

  • Evolve our brand identity and translate it into a distinctive, coherent visual language across our website, campaigns and marketing materials

  • Design and improve our marketing website and landing pages, from early concepts and layouts to responsive designs, and build and maintain pages yourself

  • Develop creative concepts for campaigns and product launches, and carry them through to ads, social, ebooks, brochures, presentations and event materials

  • Create hero and product visuals that make a complex product clear and compelling

  • Make our website clearer, more engaging and easier to navigate, with an eye on accessibility and conversion

  • Build reusable components, templates and guidelines so colleagues can create on-brand materials themselves

  • Bring structure to how design work gets requested, briefed, reviewed and delivered, and find ways for AI and automation to take repetitive work off the team's plate

  • Brief and work with external specialists in development, motion, video or illustration when a project needs extra expertise

What you bring:

  • You have around 3–5 years of experience as a brand or marketing designer, ideally at a B2B tech or SaaS company, or at an agency working with B2B clients

  • Your portfolio shows real breadth in B2B marketing design: landing pages, ads, brochures, ebooks, hero visuals and product visuals. You know how to make a complex product easy to understand and good to look at

  • Website work is a regular part of your job, not an occasional task. You've designed and built marketing pages yourself and can explain what you owned. You work in Webflow, our platform, or in something comparable like Framer and are happy to switch

  • You think in concepts, not just layouts, and you have a strong eye for typography, composition and hierarchy

  • You can take a project from a fuzzy brief to delivery without someone managing it for you, and you keep a clear head about priorities when several people need something from you at once

  • You understand what design needs to do for marketing, and you can explain your choices to non-designers in a way that brings them along

  • You look for ways to work smarter, whether that's a template, a component or an AI workflow that saves the team hours

  • You're confident in Figma and communicate well in English

  • You live within commuting distance of Amsterdam and are available 38 hours per week, with at least 2 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

  • Free access to our office gym

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

  • Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

  • Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

  • Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

  • Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

  • Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

  • Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

What you’ll need

  • At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

  • An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

  • A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

  • A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

  • A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

  • Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

  • Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Bristol and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Business Analyst (m/w/d) – Agentisierung & AI Automation
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

In dieser Rolle baust du den Hebel, der Omnora in der Execution schneller macht als den Markt: Agentisierung. Du identifizierst die Prozesse und Entscheidungsstellen mit dem größten Business-Impact und übersetzt sie in agentenbasierte Workflows und KI-gestützte Automatisierung, die wirklich laufen: zuverlässig, messbar, skalierbar.
Du bist nicht “Reporting-BA”. Du bist Business Übersetzer:in mit Ownership. Du priorisierst Use Cases nach Impact, modellierst Daten und Prozesse, definierst Erfolgskriterien und bringst AI Agents von “Proof” zu “Production”. Gleichzeitig bearbeitest du klassische Business-Analyst-Themen: Insights, KPI-Systeme, Forecasting, Prozessoptimierung, Business Cases, Stakeholder-Alignment.
Kurz gesagt: Du machst aus Komplexität Klarheit und aus Klarheit automatisierte Ergebnisse.

What's in it for you

Was dich bei uns erwartet – für Macher:innen mit Anspruch:

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt + transparenter, quartalsweiser Bonus, der echten Impact belohnt – nicht Aktivität um der Aktivität willen.
  • Klares Spielfeld & starke Story: Ein marktreifes Produkt mit klarer Positionierung, realen Business Cases bei Enterprise-Kunden und einem Markt mit hohem Momentum (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen).
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Du arbeitest nah an den Entscheidern, bekommst schnelles Feedback und kannst deine Ideen unmittelbar einbringen.
  • Kultur echter Exzellenz: Ambitionierte Kolleg:innen, hohe Standards und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld mit Vertrauen, Klarheit und Wertschätzung – ohne Politik und ohne Bullshit.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten, klare Erwartungen: Remote-friendly mit Optionen für Onsite-Tage. Wichtig ist dein Beitrag zum Ergebnis, nicht die Optik.
  • Stabiles & wachsendes Umfeld: Profitables Wachstum, langfristige Perspektive und ein Thema, das für Unternehmen geschäftskritisch ist: mitarbeitergeneriertes Wissen & Intelligence Management.

How you can make an impact

  • Agentisierung mit Business-Fokus: Du identifizierst High-ROI-Prozesse (z. B. Sales Ops, Finance, Internal Ops), definierst agentische Workflows und sorgst für messbare Effekte.
  • Use-Cases & Priorisierung: Du baust eine klare Pipeline aus AI/Automation-Use-Cases: Scoring nach Impact, Risiko, Umsetzungsaufwand, Abhängigkeiten und bringst Entscheidungen auf Executive-Niveau.
  • From Problem to Spec to Build: Du übersetzt Business-Probleme in präzise Requirements (Inputs, Regeln, Leitplanken, Outputs), begleitest Implementierung und sorgst für klare Kriterien
  • AI-Agenten in die Realität bringen: Du definierst, wo Agents autonom handeln dürfen, wo ein Mensch nötig ist, und wie wir Fehler, Escalations, Monitoring und kontinuierliche Verbesserung sauber aufsetzen. Daraufhin entwickelst du diese Agenten und bringst sie "zum Leben".
  • Data & KPI Architecture: Du baust KPI-Systeme, Dashboards und Datenmodelle, die Teams steuern können, nicht nur anschauen. Single Source of Truth statt KPI-Debatten.
  • Operational Excellence: Du standardisierst Prozesse, Dokumentation, SLAs und Tooling rund um Analytics und Agentisierung. Damit Dinge wiederholbar werden, nicht heroisch.
  • Stakeholder Alignment ohne Theater: Du führst Workshops, klärst Trade-offs, challengest Annahmen und bringst Teams auf eine Linie. Schnell, sachlich, entscheidungsorientiert.

Skills to be successful

  • Business Analyst Fundamentals: 3+ Jahre (oder äquivalent) Erfahrung in Business Analysis, Ops/RevOps, Product Analytics, Consulting oder einem datengetriebenen Scale-up-Umfeld. Entscheidend: du lieferst Ergebnisse.
  • Data Fluency: Sehr sicher in KPIs, SQL/BI-Logik, Datenmodell-Denken, Ursache-Wirkung, saubere Messkonzepte. Du kannst Zahlen in Entscheidungen übersetzen.
  • Agentisierung/Automation-Mindset: Du denkst in Workflows, Zuständigkeiten, Exceptions, Guardrails. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und KI-gestützten Prozessen ist ein großes Plus.
  • LLM-/Agenten-Verständnis: Du musst kein ML-Engineer sein, aber du verstehst, wie LLMs/Ai Agents im Produktivbetrieb funktionieren (Constraints, Halluzinationen, Evaluierung, Logging, Prompting, Tools/Actions).
  • Struktur & Klarheit: Du schreibst Requirements, Specs und Entscheidungsgrundlagen so, dass Engineering damit bauen kann und Leadership damit entscheiden kann.
  • Ownership & Delivery: Du treibst Themen End-to-End, priorisierst hart, hältst Zusagen, und baust Systeme statt Einmal-Lösungen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du kannst challengen ohne Ego und Alignment herstellen ohne Politik.
  • Sprache: Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Über uns

Wir bauen das intelligente Rückgrat für die Wirtschaft von übermorgen.

Omnora ist die treibende Kraft der Intelligence Economy. Wir lösen eines der drängendsten Probleme der modernen Wirtschaft: Den massiven Wissensverlust durch den demografischen Wandel und das Scheitern herkömmlicher Wissensmanagementsysteme. Während andere lediglich auf KI-Modelle setzen, liefern wir den entscheidenden Treibstoff dafür: Menschliche Erfahrung.

Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, in der Unternehmen zu intelligenten Organismen werden. Unsere Mission ist es, individuelles Erfahrungswissen aus den Köpfen zu entkoppeln und in ein selbstlernendes Unternehmensgedächtnis zu überführen. So erschaffen wir eine hybride Intelligenz, in der menschliches Know-how und KI nahtlos verschmelzen. Wir machen Wissen nicht nur verfügbar, sondern im Moment der Entscheidung operativ nutzbar, rund um die Uhr und in Echtzeit. Das ist für uns die wahre AI-Readiness.

Was du bei uns erlebst?

  • Echte Wirkung: Wir stoppen die „organisatorische Amnesie“ und sichern die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit namhafter Kunden vom Mittelstand bis zum Großkonzern.
  • Stabilität & Unabhängigkeit: Wir wachsen profitabel, sind unabhängig von externen Investoren und handeln mit einer langfristigen, nachhaltigen Perspektive.
  • Technologische Speerspitze: Von automatisierten Experteninterviews bis hin zu prozessintegrierten KI-Agenten, wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die den Unterschied macht.

Bei Omnora triffst du auf ein hochambitioniertes Team, das Prinzipien wie Ownership, Integrität und Exzellenz tatsächlich lebt. Wir glauben an radikale Klarheit, gegenseitiges Vertrauen und das ständige Streben nach dem besseren Weg.

Wir bieten dir kein Umfeld zum „Verwalten“, sondern zum Gestalten. Wenn du Lust hast, Verantwortung für echte Innovation zu übernehmen und in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das dich fordert und fördert, dann ist Omnora dein nächster Schritt.

Werde Teil der Intelligence Economy. Willkommen bei Omnora!

title: CDI - Context & Analytics Engineer Manager - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Chief of Staff to CTO
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to act as the CTO’s right hand, responsible for building the operating discipline and execution leverage required to scale the technology organisation.

This is a high-impact leadership role focused on execution, clarity and accountability. You will ensure the organisation is working on the right priorities, making clear commitments, and delivering at pace without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.

Your mission is simple: build a high-performing engineering organisation that consistently delivers.

 

What you'll be doing

Execution & Delivery Discipline

  • Ensure engineering teams are aligned to the company’s most important priorities

Roadmap & Visibility

Cross-Team Execution

Organisation & Performance

  • Strengthen accountability, performance management and leadership discipline

Operating Model

  • Improve how central teams (Platform, FinOps, AI, Security, IT) support product teams

CTO Leverage

  • Reduce the CTO’s overhead on coordination, planning and follow-up

Who you are

  • Proven experience scaling engineering or product organisations in high-growth environments

title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Customers trust us when things go wrong. We're the software reliability platform built to investigate, respond to and prevent incidents. As a Commercial CSM, you're the partner to our mid-market engineering teams - getting them onboarded, embedded and expanding their usage, and maturing their incident management and reliability as they grow.

What that looks like day to day

Our Customer Success organisation is at the heart of incident.io. We're the team closest to our customers' hardest problems, and we're trusted to solve them. We believe in a customer-led product approach, working hand in hand with Product to uncover and address what each customer really needs. Our goal goes beyond satisfaction: we want to delight customers at every stage of their journey, and build long-term relationships grounded in trust, shared success and mutual growth.

You'll look after 70–80 Commercial customers: growth-oriented tech companies, mostly under 1,000 people, between $30k and $150k ARR each. Industry leaders like Vanta, Monday.com and Loom sit in this segment. Some are steady, some are scaling fast, and much of the job is knowing which is which, and what each one needs from you.

Most of your time goes to mid-market customers on our top-tier plan, where you're their dedicated CSM leading onboarding and adoption. You'll blend 1:1 time with scalable programmes to get teams to value quickly: best-practice sessions, end-user training, partnership and roadmap reviews. You'll also cover a subset of smaller customers in a low-touch capacity, leaning on usage data to spot risk and opportunity early.

Day to day, this is a high ownership role. You'll help customers navigate the product, unpick problems when they hit them, and keep everyone pointed at the outcomes their team actually cares about. You are responsible for proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities, and partnering with Sales and Expansion Account Managers to grow revenue within your accounts. Internally, you're the voice of the Commercial customer with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Support.

There's still a lot to build and a ton of opportunity for you to shape this segment. The Commercial motion works, but scaling and automating the customer journey is live work we're ramping up now - refining playbooks, automating the repeatable stuff, building the tooling and content that makes a portfolio this size easier to serve. We're AI-forward in how we approach it, so you'd be shaping this rather than inheriting it.

Who you are

  • You've carried a book of 40 to 100+ accounts and worked out how to be present across all of them without going quiet on half.

  • You've sold to, or supported, technical people, whether that's engineering teams, on-call rotations or developer tools. You can hold your own in a technical conversation without needing to escalate every one of them.

  • You've got commercial instincts. You spot the account that's about to double, you know what a growth signal looks like, and you know how to steer a renewal to a good outcome.

  • You know what scaled CS looks like when it's done well. Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently.

  • Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it.

  • You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £85K – £118K • Offers Equity

title: Commercial Director – Events & Strategic Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia. 

Commercial Director – Events & Strategic Partnerships 

Newsweek | UK / International | Full-time 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

Newsweek is seeking an experienced, commercially driven Sales Director to lead front-end revenue generation across our B2B events, sponsored content, special reports and strategic partnership portfolio. 

This is a senior, hands-on new-business role for a consultative seller who can turn market insight, industry trends and client business priorities into high-value commercial partnerships. 

The role spans Newsweek's key international growth sectors: AI & FinTech, Healthcare, Sustainability (including Food & Agri-Tech) and Travel & Tourism. We are looking for a commercially versatile individual who can identify opportunities across different industries, develop compelling propositions and personally convert them into revenue. 

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of sales, research, strategy and content. They will identify commercially relevant sectors and themes, engage senior decision-makers, understand their objectives and build bespoke solutions spanning event sponsorship, thought leadership, sponsored content, executive engagement and related Newsweek platforms. 

This is not a traditional advertising or transactional sponsorship-sales role. We are looking for someone who can originate opportunities, shape the proposition with internal teams and personally lead complex conversations through to close. 

UK-based role with competitive salary and commission. Working hours are normally 9am to 6pm. Attendance at our London Canary Wharf office is required at least twice a week. Occasional overseas travel required. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Consultative Sales & Revenue Leadership 

  • Own and grow a significant individual revenue pipeline across events, sponsored content, special reports and strategic partnerships. 
  • Lead senior-level consultative sales conversations, diagnosing a client's business, marketing and thought-leadership objectives before recommending solutions. 
  • Develop bespoke, multi-platform partnerships rather than relying solely on fixed sponsorship packages or rate-card selling. 
  • Prospect and win new business while expanding relationships with existing strategic clients. 
  • Build relationships with C-suite executives and senior leaders across marketing, communications, brand, public affairs, innovation and business functions. 
  • Manage the complete commercial cycle: research, prospecting, outreach, discovery, proposal development, negotiation, contracting and close. 
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting and clear accountability against revenue targets. 

Cross-Sector Commercial Development 

  • Identify and develop commercial opportunities across AI & FinTech, Healthcare, Sustainability (including Food & Agri-Tech) and Travel & Tourism. 
  • Research industry trends, emerging technologies and market challenges to identify new event and partnership propositions. 
  • Translate client business objectives into commercially attractive events, thought-leadership programmes, content and strategic partnerships. 
  • Get up to speed quickly on industry-specific challenges and engage senior decision-makers in each sector with confidence. 
  • Collaborate with internal sector specialists to strengthen commercial propositions and ensure industry relevance. 

Event Research, Strategy & Commercial Development 

  • Work at the front end of event development, from programme planning to researching industries, market trends, client challenges and commercially relevant themes. 
  • Help determine where Newsweek should build events and special projects based on audience relevance, sponsor demand and revenue potential. 
  • Translate market intelligence into compelling event themes, partnership propositions and sponsor narratives. 
  • Work with Events, Editorial, Research, Marketing and Creative teams to ensure propositions are credible, differentiated and commercially viable. 
  • Contribute to event positioning, audience strategy, advisory-board development, speaker targets and sponsor category mapping where these strengthen the commercial proposition. 
  • Identify new sectors, formats and commercial opportunities that can develop into repeatable, commercially sustainable Newsweek B2B event franchises. 

Sponsored Content & Thought Leadership 

  • Sell strategy-led sponsored content and thought-leadership programmes connected to Newsweek events and special projects. 
  • Develop solutions that may include sponsored articles, special reports, executive interviews, roundtables, research, webinars, video, speaking opportunities and digital amplification. 
  • Connect client objectives to the right combination of content, audience, event and distribution assets. 
  • Partner closely with internal content and delivery teams while maintaining clear separation between commercial partnerships and independent editorial decision-making. 

Strategic Partnerships & Client Leadership 

  • Act as a senior commercial representative of Newsweek with clients, agencies and partners. 
  • Build long-term relationships based on insight and business value rather than one-off transactions. 
  • Present confidently to senior stakeholders and develop persuasive commercial narratives and proposals. 
  • Negotiate high-value partnerships while protecting Newsweek's commercial position, brand and delivery standards. 
  • Represent Newsweek at relevant industry events, client meetings and international engagements. 

REQUIREMENTS 

Experience & Background 

  • Substantial B2B commercial sales experience, ideally at Sales Director or Commercial Director level within media, events, business intelligence, research, publishing, conferences or a related sector. 
  • Demonstrable track record of personally closing high-value event sponsorship, content-led or complex B2B partnerships, ideally in one or more of technology, AI, financial services, healthcare, sustainability, food and agriculture, or travel and tourism. 
  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple sectors, understand industry-specific challenges and translate market intelligence into commercially attractive events, content and strategic partnerships. 
  • Evidence of building new revenue streams, entering new sectors or helping shape commercially successful propositions. 
  • A strong existing network of senior client relationships is desirable, but the ability to originate new relationships, open doors and personally generate revenue is essential. 
  • Strong consultative-selling capability with experience selling solutions rather than standard products. 
  • Experience engaging C-suite and senior marketing, communications, brand and business decision-makers. 
  • Strong understanding of event sponsorship and the commercial role of content, thought leadership and executive engagement. 
  • International sales experience and confidence operating across multiple markets is highly desirable. 
  • Experience with research-led, insight-led or advisory-style sales is an advantage. 

Skills & Competencies 

  • Commercially sharp, strategic and strongly revenue-driven. 
  • Natural new-business hunter with the credibility to operate at senior executive level. 
  • Excellent discovery and questioning skills; able to uncover client priorities and translate them into commercial opportunities. 
  • Strong research capability and intellectual curiosity across industries and emerging business themes. 
  • Excellent storyteller and presenter, able to turn ideas into compelling client propositions and decks. 
  • Comfortable working with incomplete briefs and shaping an opportunity from the ground up. 
  • Strong negotiation, stakeholder-management and closing skills. 
  • Confident using CRM, sales intelligence and AI-enabled research tools. 
  • Highly organised, self-directed and comfortable managing multiple opportunities simultaneously. 
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to influence Editorial, Events, Research, Marketing and Creative stakeholders without losing commercial momentum. 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 

  • Consistently developing and converting a high-quality pipeline into contracted revenue. 
  • Winning new clients and expanding strategic relationships across multiple industries. 
  • Building larger, integrated partnerships combining events, content and executive engagement. 
  • Identifying commercially viable opportunities for new Newsweek event franchises. 
  • Demonstrating strong individual sales performance while collaborating effectively with internal sector specialists and delivery teams. 
  • Contributing to the long-term growth and profitability of Newsweek's international B2B business. 

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

title: Commercial Lawyer
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

We're looking for a commercially minded lawyer to work hands-on with GTM, shaping, negotiating and closing customer deals. You'll own the legal workstream on commercial opportunities from early deal discussions through signature, while bringing privacy, regulatory, security and AI considerations into the work early. You'll also help turn recurring deal questions into playbooks and processes that let Dust move faster.

What you'll do

GTM partnership and deal execution

  • Work directly with Sales and GTM on customer and partner opportunities, from deal shaping through negotiation and signature.

  • Develop negotiation strategies, propose workable alternatives and help resolve customer objections.

  • Explain risk in commercial terms and help teams move deals forward, escalating material decisions to the General Counsel.

  • Act as a legal engineer to help develop and refine our daily use of AI agents across the business.

Commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate SaaS agreements, MSAs, order forms, DPAs, security terms and procurement documents.

  • Work through terms involving pricing and usage commitments, liability, indemnities, data use, security, audit rights and service commitments.

  • Support vendor, technology-provider and strategic partnership agreements.

Privacy, regulation and product considerations

  • Integrate privacy, data protection, AI regulatory, security and other relevant considerations into commercial deal strategy.

  • Work with Product, Security, Privacy and other teams to assess proposed customer commitments and identify practical solutions.

Playbooks and legal operations

  • Turn recurring GTM questions and negotiation patterns into templates, fallback language, playbooks and training.

  • Use Dust and other appropriate tools to make legal work more efficient, while applying sound judgment to confidential and sensitive matters.

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales, France or another relevant jurisdiction, with substantial commercial contracts experience. Around five years' post-qualification experience is a useful guide, not a hard cutoff and we would consider exceptional candidates with fewer years experience. We hire for talent and aptitude rather than pure qualifications.

  • Experience actively supporting commercial teams and negotiating B2B technology or SaaS deals.

  • Experience advising on or negotiating SaaS and AI-related commercial deals (of all varieties, including complex commercial and technical partnerships) in the UK, US and other international markets is highly desirable.

  • Practical understanding of privacy, data protection, AI regulation and security, and how these affect commercial negotiations.

  • An interest in defaulting to an efficient and guard railed AI-first approach to in-house legal structure.

  • Business-standard English is required, including for drafting and negotiation. Business-standard French is a strong advantage, but not essential, particularly for the Paris-based position.

Attitude

  • Pragmatic and commercially minded, with the judgment to balance deal momentum and risk. Someone who doesn't just advise, but leads and drives commercial considerations.

  • Clear communicator who can explain legal issues in business terms and work effectively with non-lawyers.

  • Collaborative and confident working across teams in a fast-moving environment.

Agency

  • Takes ownership of commercial legal work through negotiation and signature, rather than providing advice from a distance.

  • Proactively surfaces issues, proposes solutions and escalates material risk decisions appropriately.

  • Looks for ways to make repeatable legal work faster and more consistent.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: £75K – £97K • Offers Equity
