descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Own end-to-end Spectrum industrial delivery across Block 2 and Block 4, from raw material supply to launch-ready vehicle handover. Treat Mission Launch Operations as the internal customer and be accountable for delivering launch vehicles on time, every time, to the agreed cadence and acceptance criteria. Lead the Value Stream teams to cascade these commitments across functions and sites, securing an executable plan with VP Spectrum Production and other functional owners. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Cascade cadence horizontally. With Operational Planning, work backwards from customer handover dates through launch-pad AIT, logistics, vehicle integration, engine test, manufacturing, suppliers and raw materials. Translate cadence into linked milestones, lead times, buffers and capacity requirements, with named owners and committed dates. Verify readiness at each handover and resolve gaps across the full flow. 
  • Own the customer commitment. Be the accountable industrial delivery interface to Mission Launch Operations. Agree vehicle delivery dates, launch cadence, configuration, readiness and handover criteria. Maintain a shared view of plan, target and forecast for every vehicle; communicate risks early, lead recovery and agree changes through authorised governance. 
  • Lead the Block 2 and Block 4 teams. Set objectives and hold Value Stream Leads accountable for delivery integration, readiness and recovery. Protect clear focus on current vehicle delivery and future product industrialisation, managing dependencies and configuration transitions between blocks. 
  • Drive critical-path recovery. Identify constraints driving milestone deviations and secure sequenced recovery commitments from functional owners. Agree production and AIT interventions with VP Spectrum Production; verify their impact on delivery and escalate unresolved capacity, funding or priority conflicts. 
  • Lead industrial readiness and scale. Integrate the roadmap to agreed Rate 20 and Rate 50 ambitions. With Production Engineering, Procurement, Quality and VP Spectrum Production, establish evidence of process capability, supplier readiness, capacity, tooling, skills and test availability. Track gaps, investment dependencies and readiness decisions. 
  • Connect development to industrial delivery. Through the Block 4 Lead, align industrial milestones with the Programme Director and Chief Engineer. Integrate Spectrum Development Operations hardware commitments and Design for Manufacture feedback from Design and Production Engineering, using APQP as guidance. Subsystem Programme Managers own development and qualification campaigns. 
  • Own end-to-end production system performance. Own the Spectrum-wide value stream framework and Isar Production System performance from suppliers through launch operations. Set flow priorities and improvement outcomes. Partner with VP Spectrum Production on deployment within manufacturing and global AIT, supported by the Production System / CI Leader. 
  • Improve flow and economics. With functional leaders and Finance, reduce queues, work in progress, rework, lead time and unit-cost drivers. Prioritise improvements by their effect on the whole value stream and verify sustained benefits without compromising HSE or acceptance requirements. 

Governance and decision rights 

Lead the Spectrum delivery review against Mission Launch Operations commitments. Show vehicle handover and cadence adherence, plan versus forecast, critical path and recovery. Require functional commitments and verify recovery restores customer dates. Escalate unresolved trade-offs to VP Global Operations; retain visibility of baseline deviations when dates change. 

The Director owns end-to-end industrial delivery integration and priorities through the Value Stream Leads. Functional leaders retain line management, resources and execution accountability. Agree cross-block allocations with VP Spectrum Production and maintain visibility of the approved baseline when forecasts change. 

Key working relationships 

  • VP Spectrum Production. Owns production execution, teams, resources and operating capability through Production Execution, AIT, MD Sweden, Global HSE and operational CI. Agree manufacturing, Propulsion AIT, Launch Vehicle AIT and engine-test commitments, recovery actions and capacity interventions. Swedish regional employee management remains with MD Sweden. 
  • Spectrum Development Operations. Reports to VP Spectrum Production and delivers agreed prototype and development hardware and manufacturing feedback. The Block 4 Value Stream Lead integrates that work package into the overall industrial plan, including shared capacity and transition to production. 
  • Programme Directors and Chief Engineers. Programme Directors own programme baselines; Chief Engineers retain technical authority. Align industrial plans, configuration transitions and readiness evidence with programme milestones. Engineering owns design decisions and technical disposition. 
  • Planning Procurement and Logistics. Operational Planning owns detailed production and supply schedules; Procurement owns supplier commitments; Logistics owns transport execution. Value Stream Leads integrate these commitments and coordinate closure of end-to-end constraints. 
  • Production Engineering Quality and CI. Production Engineering owns process and tooling development and validation. Quality retains independent assurance and acceptance. Director Quality & CI owns business-wide improvement methodology and maturity assessment; production leaders own local improvement results, with CI coaching. 
  • Mission Launch Operations and Enterprise Planning. Mission Launch Operations is the internal customer for launch vehicles. Agree and review delivery, cadence and handover readiness; the Director remains accountable for end-to-end industrial delivery. Campaign command and launch authorisation remain with designated leaders. Provide customer demand, readiness and delivery implications to Enterprise Planning and SIOP.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Senior leadership of end-to-end product delivery, value streams or industrialisation in space, aerospace or complex manufacturing, including development-to-production transitions.
  • Proven ability to lead through a matrix, resolve cross-functional constraints and integrate planning, suppliers, manufacturing, AIT and launch or customer delivery.
  • Strong critical-path, capacity and financial judgement; practical experience deploying Lean and improving flow, quality, cost and delivery.
  • Practical AI capability is required: demonstrable use of AI and digital tools to improve departmental efficiency, analysis or reporting. Understands connected ERP, MES and PLM information, traceability and reliable data.
  • Relevant engineering or technical qualification, or equivalent experience; clear executive communication, sound judgement and ability to develop accountable leaders.

title: Distinguished Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!
The role:

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer based in our Paris office to lead the technical transformations that are too large, too cross-cutting, or too critical to belong to a single engineering team.

This is a company-wide IC role with direct report to the CTO and explicit authority to drive major technical decisions across Product Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure and Data.

This isn't an advisory role, it's a mandate to change how Brevo Engineering works at a foundational level.


What you will do:

You will own a small number of high-impact technical transformations end to end: architecture, implementation strategy, migration, adoption and retirement of legacy systems.

Examples include:

  • rebuilding our CI/CD and deployment architecture across hundreds of services and repositories;
  • replacing fragmented logging and observability patterns with an OpenTelemetry-based platform backed by ClickHouse;
  • redesigning how we use Kafka and introducing stronger platform abstractions around messaging;
  • turning ClickHouse into a first-class internal product rather than a database consumed inconsistently across teams;
  • defining and driving common standards around service communication, reliability, runtime architecture and developer platforms.

    • These initiatives will cross organizational boundaries and require changes to both infrastructure and application code.

    Your responsibility is to own the projects end to end, driving them through every stage and resolving whatever obstacles arise until it is delivered.


    Who you are:
  • You have already operated at Principal, Distinguished, Senior Principal, Fellow, or equivalent level within a significantly larger engineering organization.
  • You have repeatedly led transformations involving
  • hundreds of engineers or large service fleets,
  • distributed systems and production infrastructure,
  • complex migrations where old and new worlds had to coexist,
  • strong technical disagreement across senior teams,
  • and architecture decisions with broad and lasting consequences.
  • You move fluidly between a system design discussion, a code review, a production incident, a migration plan, and an executive-level technical decision.
  • You bring deep expertise in several of the following: Kubernetes, CI/CD, Kafka, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, distributed databases, service communication, developer platforms, and large-scale observability.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Electrical Systems Designer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

  • Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft electrical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, diagramming and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of aircraft electrical installations, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach, attention to detail, and the ability to present clear rationale for solution proposals.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Engineering Manager - Travel FX App
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. title: Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead
descriptionHtml:
About us

Infinite Lambda is a data and AI consultancy that helps the world’s leading companies become data-first. We design and build modern, cloud-native data platforms, and we help our clients turn them into real business value with AI.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, and we’re now a global team across three regions. Headquartered in London, we have engineers and consultants in the United States, the UK, France, Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Vietnam and Singapore. We’re also building new teams in Brazil, Argentina and Chile.

Our mission is to bring exceptional people together to make an impact where technology meets sustainable growth. You’ll work alongside experts in dbt, Snowflake and the wider modern data stack on complex, meaningful projects, in a culture built on curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning.

We’re a diverse team, and we want everyone to feel comfortable being themselves at work. If you want to grow fast, learn constantly and help shape where we go next, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. As Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead, you’ll own how Infinite Lambda solves that problem: moving the world’s largest organisations off Informatica, Talend, SSIS/SQL Server, DataStage, stored procedures and, increasingly, SAS and Alteryx, onto modern platforms ready for AI.

Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle:

  • Assess: Estate discovery, feasibility analysis and migration strategy, ending in a fixed-cost, fixed-timeline proposal that gives clients certainty from day one.

  • Convert: Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass ontology that lays the foundation for AI use cases.

  • Validate: Reconciliation architecture and row-level sign-off, so every migration is provably correct.

The first part is delivery excellence that compounds. You’ll make sure every migration we deliver is better than the last. That means defining the standards, building the playbooks and reusable assets, and turning the lessons from each strategic engagement into capability across the practice. You’ll also develop the engineers and leads who carry that standard across AMER, EMEA and APAC.

The second part is commercial impact. You’ll turn delivery quality into a competitive edge: faster delivery, sharper scoping and pricing, and healthy margins you can measure and report on. Working closely with Sales and Solution Engineering, you’ll shape the offer that makes Infinite Lambda the obvious choice for enterprise migration, anywhere in the world.

Responsibilities

1. Practice and standards

  • Be the person engineers, sales and clients ask when a migration question is hard: what to migrate first, what to refactor and what to move as is, and how to resolve conflicting logic.

  • Own the migration standard for Assess, Convert and Validate. This covers reference architectures, sequencing, reconciliation and stage-gate checklists, and what we won’t do.

  • Make sure Fast and Deep Discovery produce a defensible estimate, a dependency map and early red flags before we commit to a fixed price.

  • Hold the same quality bar in every region: conversion quality, reconciliation sign-off and post-go-live incidents.

  • Keep the practice up to date as Flowline, the source parsers and the target platforms change (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg).

2. Knowledge, IP and the asset catalogue

  • Join engagements at scoping and agree what each strategic migration should leave behind (patterns, decisions, failure modes, measurements) and who will capture it.

  • Capture lessons at wave checkpoints, and close each engagement with a review of what worked, what didn’t, and what should change in the standard.

  • Decide which lessons become reusable assets and which stay one-offs.

  • Bring field requirements and recurring challanges to the Flowline product team, and move proven assets into Product & Services.

3. People and enablement

  • Build a global bench of migration specialists. Develop engineers across AMER, EMEA and APAC into a team that can deliver migration waves to our standard, independently and at scale.

  • Own the path from practitioner to leader. Design and run the progression that takes engineers from dbt and Snowflake foundations, through Flowline accreditation and deep expertise in a legacy source system, to owning delivery waves and ultimately leading client assessments.

  • Turn what we know into how we work. Make our accelerators and existing assets visible and reusable across every team, so each engagement starts from our best work rather than a blank page.

4. Commercial

  • Make sure live engagements actually use the practice’s accelerators.

  • Help Sales and Sales Engineers scope, estimate and price from measured delivery speed, so the client pays for the acceleration instead of getting it for free.

  • Make the commercial case for the practice in proposals, extensions and new scope. This includes turning Discovery engagements into migrations and expanding into BI and semantic-layer work.

5. Partners and internal work

  • Act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and Fivetran, and feed what we learn in delivery into joint go-to-market, certifications and co-marketing.

  • Write interview material and run technical interviews for migration roles.

  • Present the practice’s work inside the company and, where it makes sense, at external events and in case studies.

Requirements

  • Ownership at a strategic level. You take full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. You’ve owned a practice, a service line or a major programme end to end (its direction, quality, people and commercial results), and you’re comfortable making the calls that shape how a business delivers.

  • Enterprise migration experience at scale. You have a track record of leading large, complex migrations off legacy platforms such as Informatica, Talend, Oracle, SSIS or DataStage, and you know where these programmes tend to go wrong.

  • Depth across both ends of the migration. You have hands-on knowledge of legacy source systems and modern platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg, dbt, Fivetran), plus a structured approach to assessment, conversion and validation.

  • A builder of repeatable delivery. You’ve defined reference architectures, sequencing frameworks and quality gates, and built libraries of reusable assets and accelerators that teams actually use.

  • A multiplier of talent. You’ve developed engineering teams across regions through mentoring, structured skill pathways and accreditation, and you’ve raised the bar for how those teams deliver.

  • Credibility with clients and partners. You can lead discovery sessions with senior client stakeholders, act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with partners such as Snowflake and Databricks, and assess engineering talent in interviews.

  • Commercial awareness. You understand how delivery choices affect scoping, pricing and margin, and you enjoy working with Sales to win the right work.

Line management & how you will be supported

Your line manager is the Chief Customer Success Officer, who is accountable for your direction, the practice charter and the review of your objectives. Strategic direction will be consulted with CTO and Head of Engineering.

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

▶ ▶ To ensure legislative compliance, applicants may be asked to provide up-to-date proof of a clean criminal record. Examples of said proof include extract n°3 of the Criminal Record (France), Büntetlen előélet (Hungary), Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK), an extract from the Criminal Register (Slovakia), or a country-specific equivalent. Providing proof of a clean criminal record is the final step in the hiring process and will only be requested should the applicant accept an offer from Infinite Lambda.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

title: Experienced Analytics Engineer - Customer Experience
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Join our Customer Experience Analytics team and help build the data foundation behind a better customer journey at Back Market. You'll be working with a crew of analysts to serve data-driven decisions across the customer experience. We collect trustworthy behavioural data, build analyses, and help teams use data in their day-to-day decisions.

 

As a Customer Experience Analytics Engineer, you will turn messy data into reliable, scalable models that drive real business decisions. You'll partner closely with our customer journey, engagement and service team to make sure they can answer important questions about customer behaviour, engagement, retention and the impact of product and CRM initiatives.

This role combines hands-on data modelling with a strong understanding of business needs. You will help define the metrics, datasets and tools that allow the Customer Experience teams to move quickly while keeping a high level of trust in the data.

Your mission

You will own and develop the analytics engineering foundations for the Customer Experience vertical.

Build trusted data foundations

  • Build, maintain and improve production-grade data models using dbt and BigQuery.

  • Transform data from Amplitude, customer systems, experimentation tools and Braze into clean, reusable datasets.

  • Define reliable sources of truth for customer behaviour, engagement, retention, CRM performance and experiment results.

  • Improve data model performance, documentation, testing and cost efficiency.

Support product and service innovation

  • Partner with product, business, operations and engineering teams to assess new product and service opportunities.

  • Help teams define the right metrics, data requirements and success criteria before a project starts.

  • Support the launch and measurement of new services and partnerships, such as a potential partnership with a telecom operator.

  • Build the datasets and reporting needed to monitor adoption, customer behaviour, operational performance and business impact after launch.

  • Use data to identify opportunities to improve existing products and services.

Enable experimentation and customer engagement analytics

  • Build reliable datasets for product and business experiments, including experiment populations, exposure data, treatment groups and results.

  • Partner with analysts and product teams to improve behavioural tracking and experiment analysis.

  • Build and maintain data models for CRM and Braze performance.

  • Support customer segmentation, lifecycle analysis and campaign measurement.

  • Help teams understand how product and CRM initiatives affect engagement, conversion, retention and customer experience.

Make analytics accessible and reliable

  • Build trusted datasets and reusable components in OMNI.

  • Define clear metrics and dimensions that stakeholders can use independently.

  • Implement tests, monitoring and alerts for critical data models.

  • Document model logic, metric definitions, ownership and known limitations.

  • Support analysts and business stakeholders in using the right data for their decisions.

  • Contribute to analytics engineering standards, data governance and best practices across the team.

You should apply if

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analysis engineering, business intelligence engineering or a similar role.

  • Strong expertise with dbt, BigQuery, Python, and SQL—you're comfortable building production-grade data models

  • Track record of translating business needs into reliable data infrastructure

  • Excellent communication skills in English; French is a plus but not required

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing and scaling data pipelines with orchestration tools like Airflow

  • Experience working with event-based or behavioural data.

  • Experience working with external data sources or data enrichment

Familiarity with data quality frameworks and testing

ABOUT THE ROLE:

  • Individual contributor role

  • Based in Bordeaux, France

  • Hybrid - 3 days per week at the office mandatory

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

  • TA Screening – 45 min

  • Technical Interview – 60 min

  • Leadership Interview – 60 min

  • Stakeholder Interview – 45 min

  • BM Values – 45 min

  

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

Our end-to-end solutions seamlessly combine advanced, scalable industrial hardware with a central software suite powered by Physical AI to make manufacturing truly autonomous, efficient, and scalable. By delivering field-ready robotic solutions that just work, we empower industrial companies to automate without complexity and successfully solve the global labor shortage.

With locations in Munich and Austin, and backed by leading global investors such as Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, we are redefining Autonomous Industrial Robotics.

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Field Solution Technician (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as Europe’s leading provider of automation solutions.

You are the driving force behind the successful implementation and further development of our robot automation solutions. Your technical expertise and commitment ensure that our customers throughout Germany benefit optimally from our innovative technologies.

Your Responsibilities

  • In-house programming and testing: You will be programming, testing, and troubleshooting RoBCo solutions at our HQ prior to deploying and commissioning at the customer site

  • On-site commissioning: You will install and integrate our robot automation solutions directly at the customer's site. You will master technical challenges and ensure seamless operation.

  • Customer focus and support: You translate our customers' individual requirements into robust, efficient solutions. Training, final acceptance and support are also part of your area of responsibility.

  • Development and innovation: In our modern robotics laboratory in Munich, you will test new technologies, carry out trial setups and actively contribute to the further development of our products.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Technical expertise: Training in the field of automation technology, e.g. as a mechatronics technician, electronics technician, mechatronics engineer or a comparable qualification.

  • Practice and passion: Initial experience in commissioning automation solutions or similar technologies - and enthusiasm for innovative technical challenges.

  • Mobility and customer focus: You have a driving licence and enjoy travelling, Germany-wide, and make it your business to understand and exceed customer requirements.

  • Structured way of working: Precise documentation and clear communication are a matter of course for you.

  • Team spirit and problem-solving skills: You enjoy working with different departments and finding pragmatic solutions that comply with standards or set new benchmarks.

  • Language skills: Fluency in German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Filialleiter / Stellvertretender Filialleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mitfahren kann jeder. Du willst vorne fahren?
Dann übernimm bei uns eine Filiale. Du führst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Leuten und kümmerst dich um über 3.000 Artikel. Dazu kommen jede Menge Kunden, die mit dem richtigen Rad nach Hause rollen wollen. Ob du leitest oder erstmal stellvertrittst, finden wir zusammen raus.

Über uns

Wir sind Little John Bikes. Bei uns dreht sich alles ums Rad, vom Stadtflitzer bis zum E-Bike. Wir sind bodenständig, reden Klartext und lachen gern. Und unsere Branche nimmt gerade richtig Fahrt auf.

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Geld, das sich lohnt: hohes Grundgehalt plus Ertragsprovision für deine Leistung und die deiner Crew.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag. Punkt.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, ab 55 sogar 32.
  • Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Jedes Jahr.
  • Arbeitszeitkonto: Im Sommer gibst du Gas, im Winter nimmst du dir die Zeit zurück. Über das Jahr passt's.
  • Einarbeitung in einer Patenfiliale. Keiner schmeißt dich ins kalte Wasser.
  • Dein Weg zum Meister: Du bist Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle? Wir fördern dich bis zum Zweiradmechanikermeister.
  • Weiterbildung und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, damit du als Führungskraft wächst.
  • Echte Perspektive: von der Stellvertretung zur Filialleitung. Und darüber hinaus.
  • 30 % Rabatt für dich, das ganze Jahr.
  • Dienstrad-Leasing. Wär ja auch komisch, wenn nicht.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Empfehlungsprämie: Du holst gute Leute in die Crew, wir sagen Danke.
  • Produkte, die Spaß machen: E-Bikes und hochwertige Räder in einer Branche mit Zukunft.


Was du bei uns bewegst

Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein.

  • Du führst und motivierst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Mitarbeitern. Als Filialleitung trägst du die Verantwortung. Als Stellvertretung unterstützt du und springst ein.
  • Du planst die Abläufe, von der Sortimentspflege bis zum Einsatzplan.
  • Du hältst über 3.000 Artikel in Schuss.
  • Du stehst selbst auf der Fläche, berätst Kunden und machst den Deal klar.
  • Du hast die Zahlen im Blick und bringst deine Filiale nach vorn.
  • Du bist da, wenn's mal hakt. Für deine Crew und für die Kunden.


Was du mitbringst

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung im Einzelhandel.
  • Führungserfahrung als Filialleitung oder Stellvertretung. Oder richtig Lust auf deinen ersten Schritt in die Führung.
  • Du behältst den Überblick. Auch im Juli, wenn der Laden brummt.
  • Du redest gern mit Menschen und bringst den Abschluss sicher nach Hause.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und steckst andere mit deiner Energie an.
  • Empathie und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Muss ja.
  • Flexibilität in der Saison.


Nice-to-haves

  • Handelserfahrung aus Fahrrad, Auto, Möbel, Mode oder Schuhe.
  • Fahrradwissen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss.
  • Werkstatt-Background als Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle. Einige unserer Filialleiter haben genau so angefangen und machen bei uns ihren Meister.


Klingt nach deinem Ding?

Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht.

Diese Stelle passt auch, wenn du dich als Filialleiter, stellvertretender Filialleiter, Storemanager, stellvertretender Storemanager, Leiter einer Fahrrad- oder Autofiliale, Verkaufsleiter im Fahrradbereich oder als Zweiradmechatroniker mit Führungsambitionen (m/w/d) siehst.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Government Clients (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

This is not a traditional engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.

You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.

You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.

You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Embed and Build: Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.
  • Own the Outcome: Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.
  • Be the Tip of the Spear: Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.
  • Engineer Solutions for the Mission: Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.
  • Shape Our Product: Act as the vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams. You will translate complex, real-world operational needs and feedback into the next generation of Sayari's platform.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).
  • Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.
  • Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.
  • A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred
  • Focus on government missions
  • Must be a U.K. citizen and be able to obtain secret clearance
  • Ability to work at the client site 25-75% of the time.

Desired Skills & Experiences:

  • Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).

title: Founder & CEO — AI Complaint Resolution
descriptionHtml:
Founder & CEO — AI Complaint Resolution

Complaints are being written by AI. Build the AI that resolves them fairly, for every regulated business. Build the next generation of complaint and regulated-request handling, for a world where customers' AI writes the complaint.

Location: London

Start date: ASAP

About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with Aviva, one of the UK's leading insurers, we are building a new portfolio of ventures out of London.

About the Venture:

Complaints are changing faster than the teams that handle them. Generative AI makes complaints longer and easier to file: the Financial Ombudsman says up to a third of responses to its initial assessments now look AI-generated, and it has seen 200-page submissions in reply to an eight-page decision. Soon personal agents will file and chase complaints for people, so one event becomes several. UK financial services firms received 1.85 million complaints in the first half of 2026, up 6.3%, and a human still has to read and check every one. Every ombudsman referral can cost a firm £680.

It isn't only financial complaints. New kinds of regulated requests are arriving that no off-the-shelf tool handles well, such as waves of GDPR data requests from job candidates a company never hired. Each one raises the same questions: why is this happening, do we have to respond, and how do we respond fairly and on time?

We are building the AI desk that handles them. It splits a long complaint or request into its separate claims, checks each one against the policy, the customer's records and the rules, and drafts a fair, cited response within the deadline, with a handler always making the decision. Every outcome and published ombudsman decision feeds back in, so the drafts get better case by case. We start with insurers, banks and lenders, then move to utilities, telecoms and any regulated business.

Jobs to be Done:

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

  • Find the sharpest pain. Decide which workflow to own first, whether AI-written financial complaints, data requests or another emerging regulated workflow, and who feels it most.

  • Build a product handlers trust. Take the AI desk from concept to something complaint handlers rely on to save real time, and that regulators accept as fair handling.

  • Pilot with Aviva. Prove it on real (anonymised) complaint files across motor, home and pet, and show fewer ombudsman referrals and faster, more consistent decisions.

  • Plug into how firms work. Integrate with the case-management systems firms already use, rather than asking them to switch.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the standard for complaint and regulated-request handling across sectors and countries.

Your Ideal Experience:

The ideal candidate gets excited by messy workflows and knows first-hand why complaints matter in a regulated business.

  • Experience in or alongside a regulated business: financial services, insurance, utilities, telecoms, legal or compliance. Direct experience in complaints or customer operations is a strong plus.

  • A builder's instinct for workflow: you see a manual, painful process and know how AI and good product design can fix it.

  • Comfortable building with AI: you can shape agentic products and work closely with engineers, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

  • B2B commercial instinct: you can sell to heads of complaints, operations and compliance in large organisations.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

  • Credibility with a large corporate partner and with forward-looking venture investors.

Most importantly, you want to make complaint handling faster and fairer for both the business and the customer.

This is your company. We're here to help.

title: Full Stack Software Developer - React / Python / PostgreSQL
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

Develop web-based engineering configuration tooling for managing structured mission, vehicle, payload, subsystem, component and calibration data. You will build the user-facing application, backend services and delivery infrastructure that turn engineering data into traceable, reusable and portable configuration artefacts for simulation, testing and software workflows. Working with domain engineers, embedded software developers, systems engineers, IT and cybersecurity stakeholders, you will help deliver a dependable platform for engineering teams. 

Your role in our space mission...

  • Design, implement and maintain end-to-end features across the engineering configuration platform’s frontend, backend API, database and deployment stack. 
  • Build clear and efficient React/TypeScript user interfaces for creating, editing, reviewing and navigating hierarchical engineering configurations. 
  • Develop robust Python services and REST APIs for configuration data, validation, traceability, approvals, export and integration with other engineering tools. 
  • Model structured, reusable configuration data in PostgreSQL, including parameter metadata, ownership, history and relationships between missions, vehicles and subsystems. 
  • Develop reliable import and export workflows for YAML and other portable formats used by simulation pipelines, test rigs and flight-software tooling. 
  • Integrate authentication and authorisation with enterprise identity providers and single sign-on, with appropriate security boundaries and role-based access control. 
  • Own software quality through automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, code review, observability, documentation and disciplined release practices. 
  • Contribute to Docker-based Linux deployments, CI/CD pipelines and separate test and production environments, working with IT and cybersecurity stakeholders on networking and reverse-proxy integration. 

Qualifications

  • Strong professional software development experience across frontend and backend systems. 
  • Production experience with TypeScript, React and modern browser-based application development. 
  • Strong Python development skills and experience designing maintainable REST APIs and service layers. 
  • Experience with relational data modelling and PostgreSQL, including migrations, validation and transactional behaviour. 
  • Practical experience with Docker, Linux, Git and CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, automated testing, debugging, API design and secure application development. 
  • Ability to translate complex engineering workflows and domain concepts into intuitive, dependable software. 
  • Strong ownership, communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment. 

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI or a comparable Python web framework, OpenAPI/Swagger, SQLAlchemy and modern frontend state-management or component libraries. 
  • Experience with OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, enterprise identity providers, role-based access control, reverse proxies, infrastructure automation or internal developer platforms. 
  • Experience in aerospace, simulation, scientific software, digital engineering, safety-critical systems, MATLAB/Simulink or engineering data pipelines. 
  • Experience with YAML-based configuration, schema validation, data provenance, approval workflows, audit trails or configuration-management systems. 

Benefits

  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

title: General Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As General Manager of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:

The world's most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

What you will do

What we expect from you

  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Group Agency Director
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Captify, now part of Verve Group, is the leading Search Intelligence Platform for the open web and the largest independent holder of first-party search data outside of Google, connecting the real-time searches from over 2 billion devices globally. Its Search Intelligence technology powers omnichannel programmatic advertising and real-time insights for the world’s biggest brands, such as Disney, Unilever, eBay, Mercedes-Benz, Microsoft, Nestlé, GSK, Uber, Mars, P&G, Sony and Toyota—without reliance on third-party cookies. Captify brings brands more customers, publishers greater yield and consumers the most relevant digital experiences.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and passionate Sales Planner to work alongside the Sales team to create growth opportunities with new and existing clients. You will be responsible for identifying key marketing opportunities, delivering best in class audience insights and supporting the commercial teams with your client and vertical expertise. In this role you will play a crucial part in helping drive commercial success and growth for the business.

What we're looking for

As Group Agency Director, you will own Captify's relationship with Publicis Groupe and be accountable for growing revenue across the group. You will lead a team of agency-facing sellers, set the strategy for the patch, and make Captify a go-to partner for Publicis agencies and their clients.

This is a senior commercial role. It combines hands-on relationship building at leadership level with team management, forecasting and close work with our product, data and operations teams.

  • Reports to: VP of Sales 
  • Location: London, hybrid
  • Direct reports: 3/4

What you'll do 

Revenue growth

  • Own and deliver the annual revenue target for the Publicis Groupe patch, including new and repeat business.
  • Build a clear account plan across Publicis agencies and networks, identifying where Captify can grow share of spend.
  • Lead pitches, proposals and upfront or partnership negotiations at agency and holding-group level.
  • Keep an accurate pipeline and forecast, and report performance to the leadership team.

Relationship leadership

  • Be the senior point of contact for Publicis Groupe, building trusted relationships from trading and investment leads through to agency and client leadership.
  • Position Captify's search intelligence as a strategic asset for planning, activation and insight, not only a media line.
  • Spot opportunities to work directly with key Publicis clients alongside their agencies.
  • Stay close to the group's priorities, structure changes and trading arrangements.

Team management

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of agency-facing sellers.
  • Set clear targets, run regular pipeline and performance reviews, and support the team on key deals.

Working across Captify

  • Work with Client Success, Product, Insights and Trading to deliver campaigns that perform and grow.
  • Feed agency and client needs back into product and commercial strategy.
  • Share wins, case studies and best practice with the wider commercial team.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience in agency-facing sales or partnerships in ad tech, data or digital media, with a strong track record of hitting and beating revenue targets.
  • Established senior relationships within Publicis Groupe (for example Publicis Media, Starcom, Zenith, Spark Foundry, Digitas or Epsilon) and a good understanding of how the group plans and trades.
  • Experience leading and developing a commercial team, ideally including people managers or senior sellers.
  • Confidence negotiating at holding-group level, including partnership and investment deals.
  • A solid grasp of programmatic, audience data, measurement and the privacy-led changes shaping digital advertising.
  • A consultative, insight-led selling style, and the ability to turn data into a clear commercial story.
  • Strong forecasting and pipeline discipline, plus comfort with CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • Energy, resilience and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

What success looks like in 12 months

  • Revenue from Publicis Groupe is growing in line with or ahead of target.
  • Captify is active across more Publicis agencies and clients, with a clear plan for the next year.
  • A partnership or preferred-supplier agreement is in place or in active negotiation at group level.
  • The team is fully staffed, hitting its targets, and has clear development plans.
  • Pipeline and forecasting are accurate and trusted by leadership.

What We Offer

  • Stay healthy with our Bupa HealthCare Plan with easy access to medical care
  • Support your long-term financial security with our Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme, with Verve contributing 5% of your qualifying earnings
  • Pick what matters most to you in our Personalised Benefits Platform, with a budget of £50/month
  • Recharge with 25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays
  • Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars
  • … and even more reasons to join us!
