title: Group Finance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our investment platform and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with commercial judgement and execution excellence.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

As we expand our portfolio of AI factories, GPU clusters, and supporting infrastructure, we are hiring a Group Finance Director to lead across financial reporting, financial planning, strategic finance and finance operations.

This is a highly visible role working directly with the executive team and shareholders that will interact with all parts of the business from procurement to operations. You will lead the finance function on a day-to day basis and build scalable processes to support business growth.

What You'll Do

  • Leadership and development of group finance functions, overseeing all aspects across; FP&A, Controllership, Treasury and Finance Operations

  • Provide support for the process around acquisitions and strategic partnerships

  • Build meaningful relationships with customers and suppliers ensuring best in class working capital management, overseeing AR, AP, payroll

  • Manage debt compliance in project finance and SPV environment, managing complex organisation structure.

  • Manage customer and supplier onboarding as well as shareholder requests

  • Develop and review the annual budget, forecast and scenario planning process and facilitate monthly business reviews, ensuring the constant measurement of business performance against target.

  • Implement strategies to enhance profit margins through effective pricing, cost control, and operational efficiencies. Own monitoring of key customer and supplier contracts and collaborate across functions to identify opportunities for margin improvement and ensure alignment with overall business objectives.

  • Document and improve current finance processes, identifying manual workarounds, control gaps and opportunities for automation.

  • Lead or support finance system improvements, reporting enhancements and implementation projects, with external support where required.

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to assess ROI, funnel conversion across customer segments.

  • Lead scenario modelling and commercial forecasting to support data-led decision-making.

  • Oversee group financial reporting to ensure delivery of timely consolidated management accounts, statutory reporting and performance of regular audits.

  • Interface directly with Senior Leadership Team and shareholders.

  • Drive continuous improvement and utilise AI to drive a world class financial reporting and control function.

  • Develop and track key commercial KPIs and dashboards to drive accountability and performance.

  • Prepare board packs and present key insights to PE investors.

  • Lead treasury operations, liquidity management, and cash forecasting.

What You'll Bring

  • Qualified accountant with previous experience as a group finance director in a PE backed business, managing broad range of activities across a finance function.

  • Demonstrated experience in leading build out of scalable finance operations.

  • Experience working in multi-jurisdictional operating landscapes including establishing presence in new jurisdictions.

  • Strong working VAT compliance and tax compliance knowledge with experience of preparing / reviewing and filing VAT and annual tax returns.

  • Experience managing transfer pricing assessments and compliance.

  • Strong treasury, liquidity management, and risk management expertise.

  • Strong conceptual and financial skills and ability to envision the “big picture”, while being “hands-on” and maintaining close attention to detail.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition

  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • High levels of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in data centres, digital infrastructure, telecommunications, energy, power, utilities or cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure, hyperscaler ecosystems or energy markets.

  • Exposure to power markets and commodity hedging.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build a best in class finance function, balancing historic reporting with forward-looking insights

  • Full financial compliance across global operations with agility to expand into new regions.

  • Establish scalable treasury and risk management frameworks.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the executive team.

Why Join Radiant

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry

  • Build infrastructure that underpins the next industrial revolution.

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital.

  • Participate in the company's growth and value creation.

  • Collaborate with experienced operators, investors and technologists.

title: Growth Analytics Associate
descriptionHtml:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Growth Content Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Contexte

Tu rejoindras l’équipe Brand, au sein du pôle Communication & Contenu de Pennylane.

Notre mission : faire grandir et incarner la marque Pennylane sur l’ensemble de nos canaux, en garantissant la cohérence de notre récit, la qualité de nos contenus et leur pertinence pour nos audiences.

Dans ce cadre, tu travailleras en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe Growth pour concevoir et orchestrer les contenus qui accompagnent nos prospects tout au long de leur parcours : lead magnets, emails, contenus de nurturing et déclinaisons multicanales.

Ton rôle ne se limitera pas à répondre à des demandes de production. Tu devras comprendre les objectifs derrière chaque besoin, proposer les bons sujets et formats, puis organiser leur réalisation. Tu contribueras aussi à structurer nos méthodes de travail et à intégrer l’IA dans nos workflows de contenu, sans compromis sur la qualité.

Tes missions


1. Définir et piloter les contenus Growth

  • Être le point de contact de l’équipe Growth pour ses demandes de contenu : comprendre les objectifs, les audiences et les priorités, puis recommander les formats et angles éditoriaux adaptés.

  • Concevoir et coordonner la production de lead magnets : guides, checklists, livres blancs ou autres ressources utiles à nos audiences.

  • Traiter des sujets variés, liés aussi bien à l’exercice comptable qu’au produit et aux problématiques des entreprises.

  • Construire un plan de déclinaison pour chaque contenu important : identifier ce qui peut être réutilisé, adapté et diffusé sur d’autres supports.

  • Revoir et améliorer les parcours emailing : messages, séquences, cohérence éditoriale et articulation entre les contenus.

  • Concevoir des contenus courts pour alimenter les boucles de nurturing, notamment après le téléchargement d’un lead magnet.

  • Suivre les résultats avec l’équipe Growth, identifier les contenus qui fonctionnent et proposer des améliorations.

2. Orchestrer la production de contenus multicanaux

  • Prendre en charge les demandes de contenu pour le site web (vitrine, pas le produit).

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe SEO sur les besoins de production de contenus (ex : tournages ou relecture).

  • Développer la performance de notre chaîne YouTube : identifier les sujets et formats pertinents, coordonner la production des vidéos, optimiser leur diffusion et analyser leurs résultats pour faire évoluer la stratégie.

  • Contribuer aux témoignages clients : cadrage éditorial, préparation des tournages, coordination de la préproduction et de la postproduction, puis déclinaison des contenus, notamment en ads.

  • Briefer et coordonner les contributeurs internes et externes, assurer les retours et garantir la qualité des livrables.

3. Structurer nos content operations et faire de l’IA un levier de production

  • Mettre en place des façons de travailler simples et efficaces : recueil des demandes, briefs, priorisation, calendrier, suivi de production et validation.

  • Identifier les étapes répétitives ou chronophages et proposer des workflows plus efficaces, notamment grâce à l’IA.

  • Utiliser l’IA pour accélérer la recherche, la préparation des briefs, la rédaction, les déclinaisons et la réutilisation des contenus, selon les besoins.

  • Construire et améliorer des ressources réutilisables : prompts, modèles, guidelines et exemples.

  • Savoir quand utiliser l’IA, et quand ne pas l’utiliser, en gardant la maîtrise de la vérification des faits, du ton, de la pertinence et de la qualité finale.

  • Partager les pratiques qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe et les faire évoluer à partir des retours et des résultats.

Profil recherché

  • Une expérience en content marketing, stratégie éditoriale, content operations ou rôle similaire, idéalement dans un environnement B2B.

  • Un bon jugement éditorial : tu sais choisir un sujet, un angle et un format en fonction d’une audience et d’un objectif.

  • De capacités rédactionnelles irréprochables en français : tu sais écrire clairement, structurer un message et rendre accessibles des sujets parfois techniques.

  • Une bonne compréhension de l’anglais pour évoluer dans une entreprise qui se développe à l’international ; une maîtrise parfaite de la langue n’est pas nécessaire cependant.

  • Une approche très opérationnelle : tu aimes organiser la production, clarifier les demandes, prioriser et faire avancer plusieurs projets en parallèle.

  • Une pratique concrète et curieuse des outils d’IA générative : tu sais les intégrer à ton travail, évaluer leurs résultats et imaginer des workflows utiles à une équipe.

  • Une capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés - website, SEO, brand, ads, experts métier et prestataires - et à challenger un brief lorsque nécessaire.

  • Avoir déjà produit des lead magnets, des campagnes email ou des parcours de nurturing, ou coordonné des contenus vidéo ou des témoignages clients.

  • De l’autonomie, de la rigueur et un bon sens des priorités : tu sais faire avancer les projets sans perdre de vue leur objectif.

  • Un intérêt pour la mesure de l’impact des contenus et l’amélioration continue.

  • Une familiarité avec les sujets comptables, financiers, SaaS ou avec d’autres sujets techniques est un plus.

title: Growth Engineer – Outbound & Data Automation (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du liebst es, Outbound-Prozesse technisch zu automatisieren, datengetriebene Leads zu generieren und E-Mail-Infrastrukturen auf Skalierung zu trimmen? Dann passt du perfekt zu uns!

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Growth Engineer – Outbound & Data Automation (m/w/d) (in Vollzeit, als Freelancer oder Berater/Coach), der nicht nur E-Mails versendet, sondern als technischer Spezialist unsere Cold-Outbound-Infrastruktur auf das nächste Level hebt. Mit deinem starken IT-Background, tiefem Wissen rund um Tools wie Instantly sowie Automatisierungstools baust du hocheffiziente, datenbasierte Lead-Generierungssysteme auf.

Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Infrastruktur & Delivery-Setup: Du baust professionelle Cold-Outbound-Setups auf (Spintax, Domain-Warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Instantly) und stellst maximale Zustellbarkeiten für große E-Mail-Volumina sicher.

  • Cold Email Automation: Du richtest skalierbare E-Mail-Kampagnen in Instantly ein, optimierst A/B-Tests und steuerst den systematischen Versand über viele Accounts hinweg.

  • Data & Lead Scraping: Du nutzt IT- und Scraper-Tools (z. B. Clay, PhantomBuster, Apollo, API-Schnittstellen), um hochspezifische Zielgruppen-Daten zu extrahieren, zu bereinigen und anzureichern.

  • Prozess- & Workflow-Automatisierung: Du verknüpfst Outbound-Tools über Zapier, Make oder benutzerdefinierte Webhooks nahtlos mit unserem CRM und Vertriebs-Workflow.

  • Analyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du überwachst Reply Rates, Deliverability und Meeting-Booking-Raten datenbasiert und leitest kontinuierlich technische sowie inhaltliche Stellschrauben ab.

Was du mitbringst

  • Fundierter IT-Background (Verständnis von DNS-Einstellungen, Webhooks, APIs, Datenstrukturen und Automatisierung).

  • Tiefgehende Praxiserfahrung im Umgang mit Instantly (oder vergleichbaren Cold-Email-Tools) für das Versenden von Mails in hohem Volumen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Cold-Outbound-Bereich, in der datenbasierten Lead-Generierung und in der technischen Kampagnen-Steuerung.

  • Erfahren im Umgang mit Lead-Scraping- und Enrichment-Tools (z. B. Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) sowie Automatisierungs-Plattformen (Make / Zapier).

  • Du arbeitest hochgradig strukturiert, denkst analytisch sowie unternehmerisch und scheust dich nicht davor, selbst operativ mit anzupacken.

  • Kommunikationsstark auf Deutsch und Englisch. Offen für flexible Zusammenarbeit (Berater/Coach, Freelancer oder Festanstellung in Vollzeit).

title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt.

  • Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist.

  • Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppen und optimierst auf Lead-Qualität, nicht nur auf Volumen. Neue Kanäle testest du an, wenn die Zahlen es hergeben.

  • Funnel und Conversion: Du baust und testest Landingpages und Funnels, optimierst Qualifizierung, Formulare und On-Page Conversion und sorgst dafür, dass Anzeige, Botschaft und Landingpage zusammenpassen.

  • SEO und Content: Du steuerst Agentur, Freelancer und Gastautoren, planst Themen und Ratgeberartikel und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte technisch und inhaltlich sauber ranken. Longform-Content denkst du von Anfang an so, dass daraus Shorts, Reels und Ads entstehen.

  • Creatives: Du konzipierst Ads, Hooks und Skripte und drehst einfache Formate mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt und Postproduktion laufen AI-gestützt oder über Freelancer. Du musst kein Videoprofi sein, aber ein gutes Auge für das haben, was in Ads performt.

  • Newsletter und Lead Nurturing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst Segmentierung, Automationen und Inhalte entlang der gesamten Investor Journey weiter, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Leads.

  • Daten und Tracking: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und unserem Marketing-Dashboard, hältst das Tracking sauber und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.

  • Brand: Du ziehst unsere Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Ads über Social Media bis zu Investorenmaterialien.

  • AI-First: Du arbeitest AI-first, bei Creatives, Schnitt, Artikeln, Reporting und Automatisierung. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.

  • Perspektive: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und bist von Tag eins für die Zahlen verantwortlich. Mit wachsendem Erfolg steuerst du dein eigenes Team an Freelancern, Agenturen und Werkstudenten.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing in einem Startup oder Scale-up und einen Proven Track Record: Kampagnen, Kanäle oder Funnels, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast

  • Du bist hands-on in Paid Social und Paid Search und hast Erfahrung mit Landingpage- und Funnel-Testing. SEO und E-Mail-Marketing kennst du gut genug, um Agenturen und Freelancer zu steuern

  • Du denkst in Funnel-Kennzahlen: CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate und Lead-Qualität sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine Buzzwords. Du setzt Tests sauber auf, wertest sie aus und ziehst Konsequenzen

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Hooks, Creatives und Storytelling und weißt, was auf Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert. Eigene Erfahrung mit Kamera und Schnitt ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

  • Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt

  • Du arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität

  • Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeiten

  • Bonus: Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte oder in erneuerbaren Energien, oder du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera

Benefits

  • Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt!

  • Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.

  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Team Abende und unser jährliches Offsite stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.

  • Workation: Anfang 2027 reisen wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns

Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.

Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

descriptionHtml:
Hey, wir sind die Koller & Lode GmbH.

Hast du Bock auf …

  • Deine Erfahrung im Cold Outreach nutzen und daraus einen Kanal bauen, der uns planbar neue Handwerksbetriebe als Kunden bringt

  • Ein festes Gehalt von 3.500 bis 5.000 € brutto im Monat plus Leistungsvergütung, wenn du richtig Gas gibst

  • 100 % Remote von deinem festen Arbeitsplatz zuhause, egal wo in Deutschland

  • Erfahrene Outbound-Spezialisten an deiner Seite, mit denen du dein Können auf das nächste Niveau bringst

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Denn bei uns verfolgen wir GENAU ein Ziel:

Wir helfen Handwerksbetrieben in ganz Deutschland dabei, planbar neue Aufträge zu gewinnen und zuverlässige Mitarbeiter aus der Region einzustellen, und dafür geben wir jeden Tag 110 %. Ein wichtiger Kanal, über den wir selbst neue Kunden gewinnen, sind Cold-Email-Kampagnen, mit denen wir Inhaber von Handwerksbetrieben direkt ansprechen. Genau diesen Kanal sollst du verantworten.

Falls du schon selbst Cold-Email-Kampagnen verschickt hast und jetzt richtig skalieren willst, statt hier und da ein paar Mails rauszuschicken, dann hast du bei uns deine neue Peergroup gefunden. Wer mehr reißt, verdient bei uns auch mehr. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen, deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

Aber lass mal Klartext sprechen. Wen suchen wir und welche Aufgaben erwarten dich?

Aufgaben

  • Du setzt eigenverantwortlich unsere Cold-Email-Kampagnen auf, mit denen wir Handwerksbetriebe als Kunden gewinnen, von der Zielgruppe über die Lead-Liste bis zur fertigen Sequenz in Instantly.

  • Du baust mit Clay und AnyMail Finder Lead-Listen mit passenden Handwerksbetrieben und ihren Inhabern und sorgst dafür, dass nur verifizierte Kontakte in deine Kampagnen gehen.

  • Du schreibst die Copy selbst, also erste Mails, Follow-ups und Testvarianten, und zwar so, dass sich ein Dachdeckermeister angesprochen fühlt und antwortet.

  • Du wertest deine Copy aus und findest heraus, welche Betreffzeilen, Einstiege und Angebote wirklich Antworten bringen.

  • Du behältst die KPIs im Blick, allen voran Reply-Rate, Interested-Rate und Bounce-Rate, und leitest daraus jede Woche die nächsten Tests ab.

  • Du kümmerst dich um die Infrastruktur hinter dem Versand, also um Domains und Postfächer über Mailforge und PrimeForge, um das Warm-up und eine saubere Zustellbarkeit.

  • Du nutzt Claude und n8n im Alltag, um schneller zu recherchieren, Copy-Varianten zu entwickeln und Abläufe zu automatisieren.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen, der aus den Antworten auf deine Kampagnen Erstgespräche mit den Inhabern macht.

Qualifikation

  • Dein Schwerpunkt ist Cold Outreach. Du hast schon über 1.000 Cold Emails in Kampagnen verschickt, die du selbst aufgesetzt hast, und kennst Reply-Rate, Bounce-Rate und Zustellbarkeit aus eigener Praxis.

  • Du weißt, wie man Domains und Postfächer sauber aufsetzt und aufwärmt, damit deine Mails im Posteingang landen und nicht im Spam.

  • Du nutzt KI wie Claude jeden Tag für deine Arbeit, und idealerweise baust du dir mit n8n oder ähnlichen Tools schon eigene Automationen.

  • Du schreibst kurz, klar und so, wie Menschen wirklich reden.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen und findest heraus, warum eine Kampagne funktioniert und eine andere nicht.

  • Idealerweise hast du schon mit Clay, Instantly oder Mailforge gearbeitet. Wenn du bisher mit anderen Tools wie Lemlist oder Smartlead verschickt hast, bringen wir dir unseren Stack schnell bei.

  • Du willst Gas geben und mehr verdienen, und dafür arbeitest du auch mal länger, wenn eine Kampagne es braucht.

  • Du suchst eine Festanstellung in Vollzeit und arbeitest von deinem festen Arbeitsplatz zuhause in Deutschland.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse.

  • Du sprichst perfektes, fehlerfreies Deutsch, weil deine Mails an Inhaber von Handwerksbetrieben in ganz Deutschland gehen.

  • Ein Plus ist, wenn du schon B2B-Entscheider wie Geschäftsführer oder Inhaber angeschrieben hast.

  • Wir legen keinen Wert auf bestimmte Ausbildungswege, denn entscheidend ist, was du kannst.

  • Wichtig zur Einordnung: Erfahrung mit Newslettern, Social Media oder im klassischen Vertrieb reicht für diese Stelle nicht, wir suchen echte Praxis im Cold Outreach.

Benefits

  • Ein festes Gehalt von 3.500 bis 5.000 € brutto im Monat, je nach Erfahrung, plus Leistungsvergütung für starke Ergebnisse

  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 100 % remote

  • 25 Urlaubstage sowie weitere Vorteile wie Prämien, Team-Events, Schulungen und Weiterbildungen

  • Ein Onboarding mit erfahrenen Outbound-Spezialisten, die mit dir unseren kompletten Stack von Clay bis Instantly durchgehen

  • Apple-Arbeitsgeräte, Top-Ausstattung und Zugang zu allen Tools, mit denen moderne Outbound-Teams arbeiten

  • Echte Verantwortung für einen Kanal, der direkt Umsatz bringt, und schnelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Team, das wächst

  • Ein Produkt, das im Markt einzigartig ist und das Handwerksbetriebe aktuell wirklich brauchen

Passt du zu uns als Growth Marketing Manager?

Wenn du beim Lesen schon überlegst, wie du die erste Mail an einen Dachdeckermeister formulieren würdest, und dabei ein Kribbeln im Bauch spürst, dann ist diese Stelle genau richtig für dich. Wir suchen niemanden, der Newsletter verschickt, sondern jemanden, der Cold Outreach schon selbst gemacht hat und jetzt Systeme bauen will, die richtig skalieren. Wachstum beginnt außerhalb der Komfortzone.

Wie geht es weiter?

Bewirb dich einfach über das kurze Bewerbungsformular hier auf der Seite. Lass uns dann 10 Minuten telefonieren, um direkt herauszufinden, ob du ins Team passt und ob die Stelle genau die richtige für dich ist.

title: Growth Partnerships Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

Join us if you want to

  • Take ownership across a broad remit - you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Zable from day one

  • Work in small teams of exceptional people - who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Build the best technology in-house - using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 

About the role

Lendable is becoming Zable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

  • Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

  • Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

  • Some deal structuring experience

  • Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

  • A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

  • Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

  • A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

  • Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

  • Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

  • Mentor and support a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

  • Represent the partnerships function in senior leadership and budget reviews

Commercial & Performance:

  • Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners – CPA, Revenue share, hybrid and flat-fee structures – and know which model fit the partner

  • Own the partnerships budget and unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

  • Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

  • Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

  • Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end, brief, plan, ship, measure

  • Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

  • Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Partner Management:

  • Own the partner relationship, be the trusted operator they call first

  • Manage budgets and timelines across activations

  • Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

  • Track partnership performance against targets, CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

  • Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

  • Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

  • Partner with creative on activation assets

  • Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

  • Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Zable

  • The opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

About the role:

As we enter our next phase of growth, we're looking for a driven Growth Intern to join our team for the summer. You'll work directly within the Growth team, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations. This is a hands-on role with real responsibility.

What you’ll do:

  • Deal support - help AEs on strategic deals via pre meeting and project assistance

  • Support outbound sales motions - contribute to developing outbound strategies and help craft pitches that resonate with banks, wealth managers, and fintech clients

  • Drive data-driven insights - run analyses on pipeline and sales performance to identify where we should focus, and help turn those findings into concrete initiatives

  • Lead market research - independently research the competitive landscape, identify new business opportunities, and surface trends that inform our GTM strategy

  • Support us on business development - work closely with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Product to support and align on strategic priorities

title: Head of Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Hi 👋🏾, I’m Abhik, Ashby’s Co-Founder and CTO. Ashby is growing fast, which means exponential growth across every product metric: jobs, applications, interviews, you name it. We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.

We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!

 

The Role

In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining a long-term vision and 6-month roadmap for Platform & Infrastructure.

  • Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).

  • Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!

  • Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.

  • Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.

  • You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.

  • If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, then figure out how to hire them and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to be exceptional. You’ll be a key leader in ensuring that continues!

 

The Qualifications

We’re entrusting you with a company priority, so we want you to know how to scale products and build the great teams that do that. This means:

  • You played an important role leading a company through a high-growth period (either as an IC Lead or Engineering Leader).You had to make high-quality decisions under pressure. That often meant striking a balance between short-term fixes to keep the product from falling over and long-term investments to ensure it didn’t happen again.

  • You have experience hiring and building hiring processes, and enjoy it! You’ve designed interviews, interview loops, and led hiring strategy.

  • You have a track record of excellent collaboration with other departments. You were a key contributor to company-level initiatives that involved Product Engineering, Product, Sales, or Support. Those departments felt heard and supported, yet positively challenged by you.

  • You are knowledgeable about platform and infrastructure technologies, networking, and hardware. You know how Kubernetes goes beyond a Container Orchestration Platform, how traffic flows between Load Balancers and Pods, and how the intricacies of the underlying hardware can cause Cloud abstractions to break, etc.

  • You are a great communicator, particularly in writing. You’ll need to be able to go deep with Infrastructure Engineers in conversations while also communicating those concepts to folks like myself who have much less experience.

You should be comfortable managing a team spanning from the Americas West Coast to Europe. You’ll be able to hire managers to focus on specific time zones, but I expect you to have skips with some engineers (and you should want to, too!). To ensure a reasonable work schedule, we’re only hiring candidates who live in the PST-GMT time zone.

 

What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 🥵 TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

 

Why You Shouldn’t Apply

  • You’ve always been a line manager or never led a department within Engineering. You haven’t led the definition and evolution of culture and processes.

  • You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology. We believe great leaders are folks who were great engineers themselves. That starts with loving the craft and never giving it up.

  • You went into management because it was the only growth path available. We want folks who could have been Principal engineers (or were one!).

  • You're happy with a team of engineers who are predominantly early-career or mid-career or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. You believe that with enough guardrails, the team can get things done.

  • To you, a Staff or Principal Engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or conducting architecture reviews. You don’t believe staff and principal engineers could lead by the example they set or the leverage they create through their work.

  • You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently from the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers or consistency.

 

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:

  • Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design

  • Natural collaboration and deliberate communication

  • Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage, including LLM-driven dev tooling.

  • Putting effort into building a diverse team

 

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They often discovered problems, prioritized the right ones, and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive.

 

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in <2h meetings per week (I wrote about it here).

To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over 4 years. ~34 hours of focus time, 2.5h of interviews, and 3.5 hours of meetings:

We also meet in person at least twice a year, once as a department and once as a company. You also have a small budget to meet up with folks in your city/region.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

  • Great developer tooling. For example, our CI/CD takes ~10m, we deploy at least 15x a day, and our debugger works out of the box. Everyone on the team has contributed to our developer experience 💪🏾.

  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) that we constantly improve. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).

  • AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups.

Today, 30% of engineers and 50% of our engineering leaders at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. We actively maintain and improve these numbers by sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, banning leetcode interviews, providing guidance and coaching to candidates, and more.

 

Work-Life Balance: It’s A Marathon, Not a Sprint

The intensity of work at Ashby should feel like a marathon, not a sprint (nor speed-walking). We work with urgency and ambition to build excellent software, but we don’t need to prove out a new software category or product-market fit. That requires ingenuity and thoughtfulness, and that doesn’t happen with unrealistic deadlines or sleepless nights.

Our remote, low-meeting, high-ownership culture gives engineers (and to a similar degree, you) a lot of flexibility in how they structure their days and weeks. In practice, that means they keep their own hours, but there will be moments of intensity, like launching their feature at our annual user conference. We offer unlimited PTO, and they actually get to use it. Some of our most exceptional engineers take almost 30 days of vacation per year.

This way of working allows many of us on the team to be active parents, including Benji and me. I block off 1.5 hours every morning to spend with my daughter and drop her off at school. Mujda (Product Engineer) puts it best in an article about us: “I can say that Ashby is a great place to be a mom… No one bats an eye if I have to take my kid to a doctor’s appointment or have to work weird hours because childcare fell through.”

 

Interview Process

This is an important role that will lead our Platform & Infrastructure teams now and for the foreseeable future. The interview process reflects that in both challenge and length (5 rounds, ~6.5h):

  1. Introduction call with me (30m, live)

  2. A technical screen where we pair in our actual codebase (1h, live)

  3. An interview to explore your past experience as a leader (1h, live)

  4. Interview with Colin, our Head of EMEA Engineering (45m)

  5. Final round where you meet various folks on the team and explore leadership and technical topics (3h)

I’ll have a strong read on whether we’re trending toward an offer by Round 3. Near the end of the process, we’ll do reference checks with a former manager, two direct reports, and a peer in Engineering. Depending on my bandwidth, we may start with an additional 30m screen with a recruiter.

This is also an important decision for you, so once you start interviewing, I’m always happy to have coffee chats in person or over Zoom to get to know each other.

 

Your First Six Months at Ashby

Your first three months at Ashby will be spent learning about Ashby Engineering and easing into leadership. While most of your onboarding will be driven by a 6-month plan you put together (and refine over time), you’ll also ship some product changes, features, and infra changes. What better way to learn how ICs work than to be one! Don’t worry if you’re not familiar with our technologies. The team is really helpful, and our dev environment is pretty awesome: it sets up in a single script, and you’ll be able to push your first product change on day one.

You and I will do 30-day, 60-day, 90-day, and 6-month reviews to calibrate on our unique culture and how you, I, and the team will work together.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋

Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly.

This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them.

In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets.

  • Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention.

  • Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio.

  • Establish AI-native ways of working across the team - embedding modern tooling, setting standards for how AI accelerates discovery, delivery, and decision-making, and ensuring the team operates at the leading edge of product practice.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Commercial Finance to deliver scalable, reliable distribution products that meet the needs of TMCs, OBTs, and other partners.

  • Represent Product in commercial and partner discussions, acting as a credible voice on capability, roadmap, and strategic direction with senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Drive a culture of clear prioritisation, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement - ensuring the team is always working on what matters most.

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior product leadership role, with ownership of strategy, delivery, and commercial outcomes for partner-facing products.

  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, with the ability to set high standards and build team capability over time.

  • Commercial acumen and confidence working closely with Sales and Account Management organisations, with a clear understanding of how product decisions connect to revenue and retention.

  • Experience owning or contributing to a P&L, with the ability to translate financial performance into clear product priorities.

  • A hands-on approach to AI - you use it in your own work and understand how to embed it meaningfully into team workflows and product processes, ideally with experience setting AI-native standards across a product organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and UX at a senior level.

  • Ideally, experience working with distribution platforms, APIs, or partner-facing technology in a travel, transport, or similarly complex B2B environment.

  • Helpful if you have experience navigating the dynamics of enterprise partner relationships, balancing bespoke client needs with scalable platform thinking.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

title: Head of Product Design
descriptionHtml:
Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.

Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.

Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.

Job responsibilities

  • Website product strategy

    • Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com
    • Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages
    • Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.

    Customer journeys and experience

    • Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community
    • Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site
    • Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities
    • Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.

    Narrative, copy and content quality

    • Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture
    • Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences
    • Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need
    • Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience
    • Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.

    Experiences for people and agents

    • Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants
    • Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process
    • Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information
    • Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.

    Publishing model for the AI era

    • Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement
    • Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation
    • Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance
    • Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks
    • Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.

    Design quality and experimentation

    • Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system
    • Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time
    • Sign off on experience quality before major launches.

    Team and agency leadership

    • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability
    • Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work
    • Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design
  • A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences
  • Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like
  • Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy
  • Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders
  • Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes
  • Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks
  • Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information
  • Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured

title: Head of Warehouse Projects

title: HR Shared Services Lead
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a HR Shared Services Lead to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.

About Us

M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen.

The Role

You’re the one who spots the expiry date before anyone else does, notices when the data doesn’t add up, and quietly keeps the people side of a business running. This role puts that skill at the centre, and gives you the room to redesign how it’s done.

What makes this different

You will lead HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, own UK HR operations, and have a genuine voice in how data and AI change the way HR work gets done. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion, so the work connects to something larger than the queue.

What You'll Do

  • Run a service people trust, and learn from what it tells you. You’ll lead day-to-day delivery in Freshservice, from queue health and SLAs to escalations and quality, and turn ticket and HiBob data into reporting that shows leaders where the friction is and how to remove it.

  • Own UK HR operations from offer to exit. That covers onboarding, right-to-work and sponsorship records, contracts, lifecycle changes, and offboarding for employees, EOR workers and contractors, all audit-ready and protected under UK GDPR.

  • Be the safe pair of hands across payroll and benefits, then make the work lighter. You’ll back up payroll inputs, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, compensation queries and global mobility, and spot where automation and AI can take repetitive admin off people’s plates, with clear SOPs and a knowledge base so nothing lives in one person’s head.

What You'll Need

  • Demonstrable experience leading HR shared services or a comparable service function, with a proven record of managing queues, SLAs, escalations and continuous improvement across several stakeholder groups.

  • Hands-on command of HRIS and service-management platforms (HiBob and Freshservice are ideal, but similar tools transfer well), backed by strong data and analytics skills: reconciling records, building reports and finding the pattern in the noise.

  • Practical UK experience across benefits and payroll administration, pensions, EOR, compensation and right-to-work processes, and real curiosity about what AI can do for HR operations.

A relevant degree is helpful and CIPD progress is a plus. Please don’t talk yourself out of this if you meet most of it. Plenty of strong people hold back from roles unless they tick every box, and we would rather hear from you.


How we work

This is a remote role within a team spread across the UK, Europe and Africa. You’ll report to the Head of HR Shared Services and work closely with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal and IT, plus external partners such as the Home Office, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. You’ll coach colleagues and help shape how the team covers peaks and absences. We care about clear ownership and good outcomes, and we trust you to manage your own time.


The reality check

This role is demanding. You’ll run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with confidential cases and competing priorities arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup, your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. If you’re already the person who closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. 

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.
