  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

title: Intern, System Architecture
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us. 

Job Summary:

Our system architecture department sits at the interface of hardware development, manufacturing, and the quantum architecture to design the first fault-tolerant quantum computer. The optical architecture group are specifically responsible for:

  • discovering and developing new schemes for photonic quantum computation
  • translating abstract quantum information protocols into the designs of physical systems
  • modelling quantum optical systems to determine the requirements for hardware systems

Internships are hired on a rolling basis, with durations of 3 to 6 months. We offer placement opportunities in Palo Alto, California (United States), Bristol (United Kingdom), and remotely.

The internship role requires a challenging mix of analytical skills and programming. We are looking for fast learning, productive, creative individuals who are motivated to translate theoretical concepts into real technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to ongoing optical architecture technical projects. For example:
    • Writing prototype software implementations for controlling and simulating the optical networks inside photonic quantum computers.
    • Applying results from quantum information theory, network design and/or optimization to improve optical architecture designs.
    • Development and discovery of new approaches to photonic quantum computing.
  • Simulate and benchmark different protocols.
  • Document and communicate results.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • Degree in: Physics, Math, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent.
  • Currently studying or recently finished a postgraduate degree (PhD preferred).
  • Experience in programming in Python, C++, Julia or similar languages.
  • Competent use of collaborative software development tools (e.g., GitHub) is desirable.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and work closely with others.
  • Preferred: knowledge of quantum optics, photonic hardware, switch network design, optimization, graph theory.

title: IT Support Analyst
descriptionHtml:
📍 Sheffield and Lincoln Hybrid - 3 days per week in office (2 of which will be one office with the 3rd day in the other office), 2 working remotely.

  

The Opportunity:

We are looking for an IT Support & Security Analyst to act as the primary technical point of contact across our Sheffield and Lincoln offices, reporting to the IT and Security Manager. You will split your time between front-line helpdesk operations and proactive security administration in a fast-paced, adaptable environment.

  • Helpdesk & On-Site Support: Serve as the go-to contact for hardware (macOS, Windows, ChromeOS), connectivity, and tickets logged via Freshservice across Sheffield and Lincoln.

  • Identity & Cloud Administration: Manage full user lifecycles, access permissions, policies, and Google Workspace configurations.

  • Device & Patch Management: Enrol, monitor, and secure endpoints using Google MDM, Hexnode, and Intune, maintaining automated patch schedules via Action1.

  • Security & Incident Operations: Monitor, investigate, and remediate alerts across SentinelOne EDR/MDR, GCP, and email security tools, while proactively mitigating emerging threats.

  • Networking, Compliance & AI: Support Cisco Meraki networking and VPNs, maintain SOPs and audit evidence for vendor and security assessments, and assist with rollouts of internal AI productivity tools.

 

What we need from you:

  • Bring experience in IT support, systems engineering, or security operations, backed by strong knowledge of core networking concepts.

  • Have hands-on administration experience with macOS, Windows, or ChromeOS, alongside MDM tools like Hexnode, Intune, or Google MDM.

  • Possess practical experience maintaining compliance evidence in an ISMS (such as Vanta, Drata, or Sprinto) aligned with Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001.

  • Are a proactive troubleshooter who digs into both hardware issues and suspicious logs, knowing precisely when to resolve or escalate.

  • Excel at communication - able to explain security plainly to non-technical colleagues while collaborating effectively with senior engineers.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience with security and network tooling, specifically alert triage in EDR/MDR platforms (e.g., SentinelOne), Cisco Meraki, and OpenVPN.

  • Practical background in Google Workspace Administration and service desk platforms such as Freshservice.

  • Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA A+/Security+, Google Workspace, ISC2 CC) or an interest in applying AI tools to IT and security workflows.

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

title: IT-Techniker (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

Bei uns betreust du feste Kunden statt ständig neuer Tickets. Du kennst ihre Systeme, weil du sie selbst aufgebaut hast.

Unsere Kunden sind kleine und mittlere Unternehmen in der Region Bad Reichenhall–Salzburg. Viele betreuen wir seit Jahren. Du bist für sie der Ansprechpartner für ihre IT: am Telefon, per Fernwartung und vor Ort. Deutschland-Touren gibt es bei uns nicht.

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung deiner Kunden
    Du bist erste Anlaufstelle, wenn es klemmt, und löst Störungen remote oder direkt beim Kunden. Weil du die Umgebungen kennst, musst du dich nicht jedes Mal neu einarbeiten.

  • Microsoft 365 und Security
    Du richtest M365 ein, verwaltest Benutzer und Lizenzen und setzt Sicherheitsrichtlinien um. So bleiben unsere Kunden sicher und arbeitsfähig.

  • Windows Server
    Du installierst, wartest und aktualisierst Server, kümmerst dich um Patches und sorgst dafür, dass alles stabil läuft.

  • Netzwerk und Firewall
    Du planst und betreust Netzwerke und konfigurierst Firewalls. Als Fortinet-Partner arbeiten wir viel mit FortiGate.

  • Projekte von der Planung bis zur Übergabe
    Ob M365-Migration, neuer Server oder Netzwerkumbau: Du planst mit, setzt um und übergibst an den Kunden. Du siehst also, was aus deiner Arbeit wird.

  • Abstimmung im Team
    Du sprichst dich mit Kollegen und dem Einkauf ab, damit die richtige Hardware zur richtigen Zeit beim Kunden ist.

Anforderungen

  • Du kennst dich mit IT-Infrastruktur aus und willst Kunden betreuen, die du wirklich kennst.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine IT-Ausbildung, zum Beispiel als Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als IT-Techniker, Systemadministrator oder System Engineer, gern aus einem Systemhaus oder einer internen IT

  • Praxis mit Microsoft 365 und Windows Server. Du hast damit schon im Alltag gearbeitet, nicht nur in der Schulung

  • Grundlagen in Netzwerk und Firewall: VLANs, VPN und Firewall-Regeln sind dir nicht fremd

  • Freude am Kundenkontakt. Du erklärst Technik so, dass auch Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, weil du täglich direkt mit unseren Kunden sprichst

  • Führerschein Klasse B für die Fahrten zu Kunden in der Region. Ein Firmenfahrzeug aus dem Pool steht bereit, du fährst also nicht mit deinem eigenen Auto

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung mit Fortinet bzw. FortiGate

  • Zertifizierungen, zum Beispiel von Microsoft oder Fortinet

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-365-Security

Dir fehlt etwas davon?
Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir sind ein Team von rund 10 Leuten mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung. Was dir noch fehlt, lernst du bei uns direkt am Kunden.

Vorteile

Bei uns kennst du deine Kunden und deine Kollegen beim Namen. Und abends bist du zu Hause.

  • Kunden in deiner Region
    Du betreust kleine und mittlere Unternehmen zwischen Bad Reichenhall und Salzburg. Keine Deutschland-Touren, keine Hotelnächte, keine Wochen auf Montage.

  • Firmenfahrzeug für Kundentermine
    Zu Kunden fährst du mit einem Fahrzeug aus unserem Pool, nicht mit deinem eigenen Auto.

  • Kurze Wege im kleinen Team
    Wir sind rund 10 Leute. Du sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, statt auf Freigaben aus drei Abteilungen zu warten.

  • Projekte, die du von Anfang bis Ende begleitest
    Du planst mit, setzt um und übergibst. Du siehst, was aus deiner Arbeit wird, und bist nicht nur für ein einzelnes Ticket zuständig.

  • Breite Technik statt Einbahnstraße
    Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Netzwerk und Firewall. Dazu arbeiten wir mit vielen Herstellern, unter anderem Microsoft, Fortinet, HP, Lenovo und Synology.

  • Wellpass
    Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbäder und Kurse über eine Mitgliedschaft (in Deutschland).

  • Bewerbung in wenigen Minuten
    Du beantwortest ein paar kurze Fragen und hinterlässt deine Kontaktdaten. Ein Lebenslauf ist nicht nötig, wir melden uns bei dir.

DIe Monate bei WISTA

Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen. Du lernst unsere Kunden Schritt für Schritt kennen, mit einem Kollegen an deiner Seite.

  • Die ersten Tage
    Du lernst das Team kennen, bekommst deinen Arbeitsplatz und deine Zugänge und siehst, wie wir arbeiten: von der Kundenanfrage bis zur Lösung.

  • Die ersten Wochen
    Du fährst mit erfahrenen Kollegen zu unseren Kunden, lernst ihre Systeme kennen und siehst, wie die Umgebungen aufgebaut sind. Erste Anfragen löst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team.

  • Nach etwa zwei bis drei Monaten
    Du übernimmst immer mehr selbst: Anfragen deiner Kunden, Wartungen und erste Projektaufgaben. Bei Fragen hast du jederzeit jemanden im Team.

  • Danach
    Du betreust deine festen Kunden eigenständig, begleitest Projekte von der Planung bis zur Übergabe und bist für sie der feste Ansprechpartner.

title: Junior Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We’re looking for an analytical, commercially-minded Junior Strategy Analyst to help us grow and scale the product exponentially. This is a dynamic role where you’ll tackle high impact business problems across a number of disciplines including pricing, growth, credit risk, new product development and product analytics.

You’ll help us solve our most complex multi-dimensional challenges, working cross-functionally to deliver insight-driven strategies that optimise performance, drive responsible growth, and put the customer at the heart of decision-making.

You’ll operate in a fast-paced environment where ideas matter more than hierarchy, and execution beats bureaucracy. Your work will directly influence who we serve, how we grow, and how we deliver sustainable value.

  

Key Responsibilities

Drive pricing & promotions optimisation:

  • Support the development and optimisation of pricing and promotional strategies across our channels and products through data-driven analysis, balancing customer engagement, growth, price elasticity and profitability, while continuously refining approaches based on product performance and scenario modelling

  • Analyse performance at channel, product and customer segment level to identify opportunities to improve pricing, product and conversion efficiency

  • Build insight into conversion funnel performance and highlight where cost or conversion can be improved

  • Stay abreast of industry trends and market activity to ensure our products remain competitive and fit for purpose

Pricing experimentation & impact assessment:

  • Design, set up and run pricing tests and product A/B and multivariate experiments, working with Product, Data Science and Engineering to ensure they are implemented correctly

  • Track experiment performance against pre-agreed success metrics and guardrails, and deliver clear readouts with recommendations on whether to roll out, iterate or stop

  • Measure the realised impact of commercial initiatives after launch, and compare outcomes against the original business case

  • Build and maintain monitoring of key commercial metrics so the team can track the impact of changes over time

  • Build a growing evidence base on price elasticity from these tests to inform future pricing decisions

  • Validate that implemented pricing and strategy changes are working as intended once deployed in production, flagging and investigating any unexpected behaviour.

Evaluate expansion opportunities:

  • Support the evaluation of new product, channel and segment opportunities by extracting and analysing data and contributing to commercial models

  • Help maintain assessment frameworks and tooling so that evaluations are consistent and repeatable

Collaboration & communication:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Credit Risk, Data Science, Product and Growth to bring your strategies to life.

  • Present analysis and recommendations clearly and concisely, backed by data, to the team and wider stakeholders.

  • Document analyses, queries and experiment results so they are reusable by the wider team.

Your experience

Essential:

  • 1+ years of experience in an analytical role (e.g. Product Analytics, Growth, Pricing).

  • Proficiency in SQL; working knowledge of Python.

  • Understanding of experimentation fundamentals; hands-on exposure to A/B testing is a strong plus.

  • A structured approach to problem solving, strong attention to detail and comfort working through ambiguity.

Desirable:

  • Experience in an FCA-regulated financial services firm.

  • Exposure to pricing or conversion funnel analysis.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Junior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Functieomschrijving

Ben jij analytisch, nieuwsgierig en vind je het leuk om technische vraagstukken uit te pluizen? Werk je graag met software en wil je begrijpen hoe systemen en platformen met elkaar samenwerken? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou. Je gaat je bezighouden met Identity & Access Management en werkt mee aan het ontwikkelen, beheren en verbeteren van een technisch platform.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior IAM Platform Engineer werk je mee aan een platform rondom identity en toegangsbeheer. Je leert hoe je ervoor zorgt dat gebruikers en systemen op een veilige en betrouwbare manier toegang krijgen tot applicaties en informatie.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • ontwikkelen en beheren van onderdelen van het IAM-platform;

  • werken aan identity- en authenticatieoplossingen;

  • programmeren en testen van software;

  • analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken;

  • werken met verschillende ontwikkel- en beheertools;

  • meewerken aan verbeteringen en nieuwe functionaliteiten;

  • samenwerken met collega's binnen een Agile/DevOps-team.


Je hebt affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling, IT-infrastructuur en security en bij voorkeur basiskennis van één of meerdere van deze technologieën:

  • Java;

  • Kubernetes;

  • Docker;

  • GitLab;

  • Linux;

  • CI/CD;

  • Identity & Access Management.

Je hoeft nog niet alles te beheersen. Een relevante opleiding, stage of eigen projecten zijn een goede basis. Daarnaast ben je bereid om op locatie te werken in Den Haag óf in Zwolle.

Het Business & IT-traineeship

Via The Trainee Company combineer je werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Je start met een intensieve onboarding waarin je wordt voorbereid op je eerste opdracht. Tijdens het traineeship volg je trainingen en behaal je relevante certificaten die aansluiten bij jouw ontwikkeling binnen IT.

Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen tijdens je opdracht. Zo leer je niet alleen in de praktijk, maar werk je ook gericht aan je technische én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Deze vacature is onderdeel van onze werving voor de traineeshipklas die in maart 2027 start. We komen graag nu al met je in contact.

Klaar om jouw carrière te starten op het snijvlak van IT, security en platform engineering? Solliciteer dan op het Business & IT-traineeship van The Trainee Company.

descriptionHtml:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

  • You have spoken at developer conferences, meetups, workshops, webinars, or technical customer events.

  • You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material.

  • You should be excited to travel, give talks, run demos, host events, talk to developers and technical leaders, and bring what you learn back into the company.

  • You care about developer experience, open source, AI engineering, and the quality of the rooms you spend time in.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can independently decide what to do before there is a mature playbook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

A strong plus:

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Lawyer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Omnilex started by building the AI workspace lawyers actually want to use, including the world's first AI-powered legal commentary, a living layer of legal understanding that redefines how lawyers work. In just one year, that product became the daily tool of thousands of legal professionals across Switzerland, Germany, and Liechtenstein, and a leading legal AI workspace in those markets. Now we are using that foundation to build something even bigger: the AI-native law firm. Every case our lawyers solve becomes a productized, AI-native service. Legal capability that scales, compounds, and can be deployed on demand for the next client. With a 4.5M raise, we're scaling this across Europe. You'll be joining a young, passionate, and dynamic team of 19.

The role

You are a lawyer, and you bring your book of relationships with you. You pick up real customer cases and solve them using Omnilex as your weapon. Then you do something almost no lawyer has ever done: you take what you just built and turn it into a productized, AI-native service that the next customer can run on demand.

You own the customer end-to-end. You're the person they call, the person they trust, and the person whose name shows up when the contract gets renewed. The legal teams you work with are some of the most demanding in Europe, and they expect to talk to a lawyer. That's you.


What you will do

Solve the cases

  • Pick up real customer matters. Do research, drafting, structuring arguments and deliver work product that holds up.

  • Be the lawyer in the room when a customer hits a wall they cannot get over alone.

Legal-engineer cases into AI-native services

  • After each case, decompose what you did into reusable building blocks: prompts, workflows, templates, knowledge.

  • Work with product and engineering to turn those blocks into services any customer can run on Omnilex.

  • Maintain a portfolio of services you own and iterate with product and engineering until they are as good as the original work.

Own the commercial relationship

  • Be the named lawyer on the account. Senior partners, GCs, and heads of legal deal with you directly.

  • Convert pilots into multi-year contracts, expand into new practice groups, more seats, and deeper workflows.

  • Use your existing network to open doors that take Sales months to crack.


What success looks like

  • A library of AI-native services you authored is in production and used daily by companies.

  • Customers in your portfolio renewed, expanded, and brought in referrals because of you.

  • Revenue under your ownership grew meaningfully quarter over quarter.


Who you are

  • Swiss bar admission with 2 to 6 years of post-qualification experience.

  • You currently work at a Swiss mid-size firm or boutique and run your own cases. You work directly with clients today, not through a partner.

  • Portable client relationships: clients or referrers who would follow you, or a concrete plan to build them.

  • An existing professional network of lawyers, GCs, partners or alumni.

  • Commercial instinct: you can explain a legal solution to a client in five minutes, with a structure and a recommendation, without a script.

  • A genuine interest in legal craft and in how AI is changing the practice of law.

  • Comfortable working with managing partners, GCs, engineers and founders.

  • Native German and fluent English. French is a plus.


Why join Omnilex

  • You will do legal work that actually matters. Cases for the most sophisticated legal teams in Europe.

  • You will own a portfolio of customer relationships with real commercial upside.

  • You will productize your own legal expertise. The services you build outlive any single matter and compound across the platform.

  • Competitive salary and transparent ESOP. You are early enough that ownership means something.

title: Lead AI Governance (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Offre d'Emploi : Lead AI Governance (Center of Expertise Data & AI Governance - Central)

Notre équipe Data & AI Governance recherche un·e Lead AI Governance (f/m/d) en CDI, basé·e à Lille ou Paris.

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data et l’intelligence artificielle sont au cœur de notre stratégie, guidant chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client et sportive. Notre défi ? Déployer une IA éthique, sûre, performante et auditable à l'échelle mondiale.

Tu seras rattaché au Head of Data & AI Governance et tu rejoindras le Data & AI Governance Center of Expertise (CoE) en tant que référent·e technique et méthodologique (rôle d'expert / Staff track, sans management hiérarchique direct). Ta mission sera de bâtir et porter notre framework de gouvernance de l'IA, de sécuriser notre passage à l'échelle (Agentique, GenAI & ML classique) et de guider l'ensemble des équipes vers une IA de confiance.

TON CONTEXTE DE JEU

  • Une organisation internationale fédérée : ~70 pays et 5 Business Units majeures avec une forte autonomie locale, nécessitant un cadre clair, agile et une visibilité centrale.
  • Un produit interne dédié : La plateforme GovAI, en cours d'industrialisation (registre unique des cas d’usage, évaluation algorithmique et gestion continue des risques).
  • Un collectif pluridisciplinaire soudé : Animation d'un comité opérationnel hebdomadaire réunissant le Legal, la Compliance, les Risques, la Sécurité et les Achats.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que lead d'expertise et chef d'orchestre fonctionnel, tu fais le pont entre les exigences réglementaires, la technique et le business. Tu es là pour éclairer les choix stratégiques et fédérer la communauté autour de standards responsables.

Tes missions s'articulent autour de 4 grands axes :

  • Pilotage Stratégique & Framework : Définir notre doctrine d'AI Governance (alignée sur l'AI Act / RGPD) et animer le Comité Opérationnel (Legal, Risques, Sécurité). Tu portes la roadmap globale et pilotes son succès par des KPIs concrets (ROI, délai de qualification).
  • Plateforme "GovAI" & Governance as Code : Travailler avec l'équipe Produit/Build du CoE pour industrialiser notre plateforme interne. L'objectif : implémenter une logique de Governance as Code en automatisant l'intégration des garde-fous (biais, traçabilité, drift) directement dans les pipelines (MLOps/LLMOps) pour réduire le Time to Market.
  • Gestion des Risques & Actifs IA : Standardiser la classification des risques (systèmes critiques vs non-critiques) et piloter l'inventaire unifié des modèles (GenAI & ML). Tu garantis la conformité des données (entraînement/inférence) sur tout le cycle de vie.
  • Acculturation & Réseau (AI Literacy) : Fédérer un réseau mondial (~70 pays, 5 BU) de Data Scientists, PM et leaders Tu agis en partenaire de confiance et Business Enabler pour démocratiser l'IA de confiance sans freiner l'innovation.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expertise Senior en Gouvernance IA & Data : Une solide expérience sur les problématiques d'IA Responsable, de gestion des risques algorithmiques et de réglementation (notamment l'AI Act européen, RGPD, standards ISO/IEC 42001 ou NIST AI RMF).
  • Leadership d'influence & Posture d'expert : Excellente capacité à fédérer des collectifs pluridisciplinaires (tech, business, legal), à vulgariser des concepts complexes et à obtenir l’adhésion sans autorité hiérarchique dans un environnement international et distribué.
  • Culture Technique Data & Machine Learning : Compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie des modèles ML/DL, des architectures Cloud, des spécificités de la GenAI (RAG, fine-tuning, guardrails) et des mécanismes de données associés.
  • Esprit "Business Enabler" : Pragmatisme et sens du résultat ; tu conçois la gouvernance comme un accélérateur d'innovation sécurisé plutôt que comme un centre de contrôle bloquant.

STACK TECHNIQUE & ÉCOSYSTÈME

Dans ton quotidien, tu interagiras avec un écosystème technologique moderne :

  • Gouvernance, Métadonnées & Catalogage : Unity Catalog, Collibra, outils d'inventaire IA / Model Registry
  • Data, AI & MLOps : Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow), Python, dbt, Airflow, frameworks de test & monitoring IA (évaluation LLM, détection de biais/drift)


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diplôme (Licence, Master ou École d'Ingénieur) en Informatique, Data, Systèmes d'Information ou domaine connexe.
  • 10 ans d'expérience au minimum en Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Data Quality ou gestion de programme data.
  • Expériences probante sdans l'animation de communautés et la conduite du changement.
  • Anglais courant (niveau B2/C1 minimum) dans un environnement international.

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. title: Lead Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Our Retail and Consumer experts are dedicated to helping clients in an industry which is being transformed by new technologies and evolving consumer expectations. Leveraging over a decade of experience in Applied AI, we combine exceptional technical and delivery expertise to empower businesses to adapt and thrive.

 

About the role

As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects.

This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability.

  • Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications.

  • Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams.

  • Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements.

  • Managing relationships and communications with technical stakeholders, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals.

  • Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft.

  • Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation.

 

Who we're looking for:

  • You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend.

  • You possess strong customer leadership skills, able to act as a trusted technical advisor and drive long-term strategic relationships with demanding clients.

  • You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape.

  • You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows.

  • You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure.

  • You excel at cross-functional collaboration, effectively aligning technical strategy with Engineering, Commercial, and Infrastructure teams.

  • You have experience extending technical oversight to business unit-level initiatives, using your vision to influence and contribute to organisational success.

 

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (30 minutes)

  3. Take Home Technical Assessment

  4. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Data Scientist, Revenue - Ads, Revenue
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Revenue domain is growing — Ads business is on the mission to develop an advertising ecosystem within Vinted and we’re just getting started. We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist to join our cross-functional team in Ads to help us make the most of our real estate and evolve toward a high‑performance, privacy‑respectful, in‑house advertising ecosystem over time. Think: an ad of an external partner can generate euros directly but we may well advertise our own Marketplace services or newly launched categories to optimise on net revenue as well as user engagement. 

If you have built performance-first Ad optimisation systems and are ready to take on hands-on work while shaping the Data Science roadmaps from a greenfield state - this role is for you.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Own optimization logic for Ads systems. Own the data science approach behind core Ads optimization problems such as ranking, targeting, pacing, budget allocation, candidate selection, and auction or bidding logic where relevant.
  • Develop practical approaches that improve advertiser performance, marketplace relevance, and business outcomes.
  • Take charge of model and algorithm development. Design, develop, and iterate models and algorithmic approaches used in Ads delivery and optimization. This may include prediction, scoring, calibration, exploration/exploitation methods, and constrained optimization approaches suited to Vinted’s marketplace context.
  • Lead experimentation and performance improvement frameworks. Own the analytical and experimental process for improving optimization systems. Define hypotheses, evaluation frameworks or logic changes and support translating learnings into better system behavior.
  • Guide objective function and constraint design. Help define optimization objectives that balance advertiser value, revenue, user experience, and operational constraints. Turn product and business goals into tractable optimization problems and implementable Data Science logic.
  • Be responsible for Ads performance diagnostics. Own deep-dive analysis of system behavior and performance degradation. Identify where delivery, relevance, auction dynamics, supply-demand imbalance, or model issues are limiting outcomes, and propose solutions.
  • Contribute to Production implementation in Ads. Partner with engineering and Decision Scientists to move models and optimization logic from idea to reliable implementation.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Decision Scientists, Analytics Engineers and developers to shape advertiser-facing features and internal optimization capabilities with a clear understanding of feasibility, impact, and tradeoffs from the Data Science perspective.
  • Collaborate with Decision Science counterparts and other Data Scientists to ensure optimization changes are evaluated with appropriate metrics, guardrails, and marketplace context.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and backend teams to ensure training data, feedback loops, online signals, and offline datasets are suitable for robust optimization work.
  • Help explain system behavior, performance drivers, and expected impacts of optimization changes to non-technical stakeholders when needed.

About you 

We are looking for someone who combines:

  • strong applied machine learning and statistical skills,
  • experience with Ad Tech systems and optimization problems,
  • strong product and business judgment,
  • comfort working on production systems with engineers,
  • and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, evolving domains.

The strongest candidates will have experience in areas such as:

  • ads ranking,
  • auction systems,
  • pacing and budget optimization,
  • marketplace or recommendation systems,
  • relevance modeling,
  • or other real-time optimization environments where multiple objectives must be balanced.
  • Well-versed in Python and SQL, BigQuery is an advantage
  • Have a structured, meticulous way of working when trying out different approaches towards a set goal
  • Be a conscious team player who understands when their work touches that of other team members and proactively aligns with them
  • Good at explaining details of machine learning methods to lay audiences
  • Solid written and spoken English

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:€90.100—€132.500 EUR

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Overview of the Role

You will build the Site Reliability Engineering function at Zego, embedding reliability, observability and operational excellence as core engineering concerns - AI is the primary lever for doing that at scale, not a bolt on.

  • You will be our dedicated SRE, working alongside Systems Engineering and embedded with Product and Engineering across roughly 120 engineers. Teams own their services and their own on-call. You own the framework, the instrumentation and the AI tooling that makes that ownership work.

  • You will make teams good at running what they build: alert quality over alert volume, runbooks an agent can execute rather than prose that describes, and diagnostics good enough that an engineer or an agent reaches resolution without an SRE in the room.

  • You will be the primary advocate for reliability with Product and Engineering, making the case with data rather than assertion, so platform health is prioritised alongside delivery commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and land the reliability standard: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and production readiness criteria that teams apply to their own services, with adoption measured rather than assumed.

  • Encode standards into automation rather than enforcing them by hand. Guardrails in CI, agents that check reliability and observability posture on pull requests, and safe defaults in shared infrastructure so the reliable path is the easy path.

  • Build SRE capability on Zego's AI platform, extending our MCP servers and agents, and making the estate legible to them through machine readable runbooks, structured telemetry and diagnostics an agent can act on.

  • Own observability as a practice, including instrumentation design, signal quality, cardinality and cost.

  • Raise the standard of incident response end-to-end, from detection and triage through to retrospectives that produce change. Put AI to work where it pays off most, stripping toil out of incidents so responders can focus on judgement

  • Measure toil, publish it, and remove it through tooling that others can run without you.

What you will need to be successful in the Role

We are looking for an engineer who lives SRE and DevOps culture, and treats AI tooling as a default part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. You will engage and empower teams through decisions grounded in data, and you will be as comfortable building with AI as consuming it: extending MCP servers, writing agents, and automating the operational work that would otherwise fill your week. We treat reliability at Zego as a platform capability, so we care more about what you can make repeatable for others than what you can fix yourself.

What you’ll bring to the Team

  • Deep SRE experience: SLI and SLO definition, error budget management, and ownership of incident response through to blameless retrospectives.

  • Fluency with AI as an engineering tool rather than a chat window: building agents and automation, working with MCP servers or equivalent, and judgement about where an agent can act and where a human stays in the loop.

  • Strong software engineering in Python, writing tested, maintainable code that other engineers can run and extend.

  • Observability depth with OpenTelemetry and Datadog.

  • AWS at scale, and Kubernetes based platforms managed through Infrastructure as Code.

Desirable

  • Istio, Crossplane and ArgoCD. We run all three and will teach the specifics to the right person.

  • Running ML or AI workloads in production, such as model serving or feature pipelines. We do this at Zego and you would help support it.

  • Having been a sole delivery owner somewhere, and knowing what that does and does not mean.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

title: Learning and Adoption specialist (12 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C2

Team: Client Delivery EMEA

Contract: 12 month fixed-term

Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Please submit your application in English.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


What you'll bring 

Ideally you’ll have:

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.

  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.

  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.

  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.

  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.

  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.

  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.

  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart 

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.

  • Proven Training Leadership: A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

title: Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracts and Regulatory)
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

LemFi's Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We draft, negotiate and advise ourselves, and we bring in outside counsel only where local law or deal complexity demands it. This role sits inside that team, reporting to the Deputy GC, and owns the contracts that keep our payment infrastructure running: card acquiring, payment processing, banking and payout partners, and the technology and outsourcing agreements behind them.

You will work closely with Payments, Partnerships, Product, Compliance and Finance across our regulated entities in the UK, Ireland and Norway. The regulatory advice you give will shape the contracts you negotiate, and the contracts you negotiate will directly affect how fast LemFi can move with new partners and products.

What you'll build and own

  • Draft, review and negotiate payment processing, card acquiring, PSP, banking, safeguarding, payout and aggregator agreements, end to end.

  • Handle technology, SaaS and outsourcing contracts, including the ICT requirements under DORA and outsourcing rules for regulated firms.

  • Run the day-to-day contract flow through Jira and SpotDraft: NDAs, DPAs, amendments, renewals and terminations, turned around quickly.

  • Apply and develop the LemFi contracting playbook, templates and fallback positions so the business can move faster on repeat deal types.

  • Advise Payments and Partnerships on payments and e-money regulation across the UK, Ireland and Norway, covering PSRs 2017, EMRs 2011 and Irish and Norwegian equivalents.

  • Review customer T&Cs, product changes and marketing for regulatory compliance, and track incoming reforms such as the EU payments package.

  • Use AI-assisted contract review and drafting tools to handle a high volume of work without sacrificing accuracy, flagging where your own judgement overrides the output.

Your experience

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales or Ireland, or as an advokat in Norway, with 3 to 6 years' PQE.

  • Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating payment processing, acquiring, banking or payment partner agreements, at a law firm or in-house.

  • Working knowledge of payments and e-money regulation in the UK or EU, including the Payment Services Regulations 2017 or the Electronic Money Regulations 2011.

  • Experience with technology and outsourcing contracts in a regulated environment.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of contracts, setting your own priorities and turning work around at pace.

  • Clear, commercial communicator: you write for non-lawyers without losing the legal precision that matters.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with card scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard) and their application to acquiring and issuing contracts.

  • Experience with DORA or equivalent ICT/operational resilience frameworks for regulated firms.

  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, relevant for the Oslo base.


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

title: Managing Director (Cable manufacturing)
descriptionHtml:
Role purpose

This is a hands-on general management role. The Managing Director will personally lead key customer and supplier negotiations, set commercial priorities, and make the operating decisions that determine margin, cash flow, and service quality.

Key responsibilities

Area

What the Managing Director owns

P&L, cash, and working capital

Own the annual business plan, budget, and forecasts. Deliver agreed targets for revenue, gross margin, operating profit, and cash flow. Manage operating costs, inventory levels, slow-moving stock, customer credit, receivables, and capital expenditure within delegated authority.

Sales and market development

Retain and grow key accounts. Personally lead strategic customer relationships, major negotiations, and bids. Build new business with installers, electrical wholesalers, industrial customers, and project buyers. Set pricing and discount policies, lead pipeline reviews, and coach the commercial team.

Purchasing, import, and supply

Own the purchasing strategy and supplier relationships. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and supply commitments. Decide which products to stock locally, source from French or European suppliers, or supply through Abc Company manufacturing. Oversee import and export activities where applicable, with appropriate technical documentation and product conformity checks.

Distribution operations

Oversee warehousing, stock accuracy, cable cutting, order preparation, and delivery. Set service standards for quote turnaround, product availability, and on-time delivery. Resolve recurring issues that affect customer service or cost.

People and oranization

Lead the French team across sales, purchasing, operations, and administration. Set clear responsibilities and performance expectations. Recruit and develop key talent, including the Business Development Manager, and hold managers accountable for results.

Group reporting and integration

Serve as Abc Company’s senior operating leader in France. Translate Group priorities into a local business plan, report performance and risks, and coordinate finance, technical support, sourcing, and manufacturing with ABC Company. Maintain effective local controls and escalate decisions outside delegated authority.

Requirements

Candidate profile

Required

  • Senior leadership experience in electrical cable distribution or electrical equipment wholesaling in France, with demonstrable knowledge of the cable market, its buyers, and its routes to market.
  • Direct accountability for a business unit, subsidiary, or company P&L, with examples of decisions and results across revenue, gross margin, operating costs, and working capital.
  • A track record of retaining strategic accounts, winning new business, and negotiating effectively with customers and suppliers.
  • Hands-on operating experience in a stockholding distribution business, including purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, and customer service.
  • Experience leading teams across commercial and operational functions.
  • Fluent in French and professional English for working with Abc Company Group and international suppliers.

Preferred

  • Experience with cross-border sourcing, imports, and manufacturer–distributor relationships.
  • Experience leading a business through an acquisition, turnaround, or expansion.
  • Familiarity with low- and medium-voltage cable ranges, technical specifications, and project-based supply.

First-year priorities

Period

Expected outcomes

First 90 days

Meet key customers, suppliers, and employees. Establish a baseline for revenue, margin, stock, receivables, and delivery performance. Present a commercial and operating plan with clear priorities, owners, and measures.

By six months

Put key-account plans, pricing controls, and stock priorities in place. Establish a regular P&L and cash review with Abc Company. Agree which Abc Company-manufactured products are ready to offer in France and what is needed to bring the remaining ranges to market.

By 12 months

Deliver against the agreed P&L and working-capital targets. Demonstrate profitable new-account wins, retain priority customers, and show measurable progress in service reliability.

title: Managing Director - France
descriptionHtml:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing
