title: Product Marketing & Growth Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Payflows
Payflows is the AI companion that makes a company's existing ERP AI-native, so finance teams can close faster without the pain of migrating from their legacy tools. Founded in Paris in 2022, we have raised €26M from Balderton, Ribbit Capital and Headline, and work from hubs in Paris, London and New York. We work with mid-cap and large enterprises, private equity firms and organisations helping businesses transform their finance operations.

Why we're hiring

We want Payflows to be the first brand people think of when they think about AI in enterprise finance and creating the continuous close.

Today, our sales and partnerships teams tell a compelling story to CFOs, finance leaders, private equity firms and consulting partners every week. But we're only reaching a fraction of the people who need to hear it.

We need someone to change that. Someone who can take a deep understanding of our product, the problems it solves and the story our GTM team tells, and find creative ways to bring it to the entire market: through product demonstrations, videos, interactive experiences, campaigns, customer stories, thought leadership and ideas we haven't thought of yet.

Your job is to figure out how to make every relevant audience understand, experience and get excited about Payflows.

The role

You'll make every audience that matters to Payflows understand, experience and get excited about what we do: enterprise buyers, finance leaders, PE operating partners, consulting partners and the wider finance and technology community. You'll spend time understanding the product, listening to customers, joining sales and partnership calls and learning how we win. You'll be given a story to start from, and you can of course refine it.

You'll be part product expert, part creator, part growth marketer and part chief storyteller. Some days you'll be producing a product video. Others you'll be designing an interactive AI experience, building a campaign for private equity operating partners, creating a customer use case or finding a completely new way to get Payflows in front of the market.

You'll sit at the intersection of Product, GTM and Marketing, working directly with our founders, Head of GTM and product team. We don't have a playbook for this role. We want you to build one.

What you'll do

  • Know the product inside out. Spend time with our product and engineering teams. Understand what we're building, how it works and why it matters. You need to be able to explain our product better than almost anyone outside the engineering team.

  • Get close to the market. Join sales and partnership calls, listen to customers and understand what matters to CFOs, finance teams, PE operating partners and consulting firms. Learn how our GTM team positions Payflows and why different audiences care.

  • Turn product into experiences. Find creative ways to demonstrate what Payflows can do. Build product videos, interactive demos, AI experiments, use cases and campaigns that make the value tangible.

  • Find new ways to tell the story. Customer stories, LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, webinars, short-form video, product launches. Take one insight and find as many interesting ways as possible to bring it to different audiences.

  • Make complex things simple. Take sophisticated finance workflows and AI capabilities and make them understandable, relevant and exciting. Adapt the story depending on whether you're speaking to a CFO, a PE operating partner or a technology consultant. No generic AI marketing language.

  • Own distribution. Figure out where our audiences spend their attention. Get our ideas in front of them, experiment with new channels and formats, and find ways to turn our existing customer, investor and partner networks into distribution.

  • Connect marketing to revenue. Understand what generates engagement, creates conversations, drives partner interest and helps sales win. Track the results, experiment constantly and double down on what works.

What we offer

  • One of the most important roles at Payflows, and a playbook that's yours to build, with our founders, Head of GTM and product team behind you.

  • The opportunity to shape how an ambitious AI company takes its product and story to market, with a product worth getting excited about and the freedom to experiment.

  • A front-row seat to how AI is changing enterprise finance, working alongside the CFOs, investors and partners leading it.

  • A full-time role in our Paris office.

Why Join

  • Greenfield ownership — you're not inheriting someone else's playbook, you're writing it

  • Direct access to leadership — small team, fast decisions, high visibility

  • Strong backer network — Balderton, Ribbit and Headline open doors; their networks are an audience you can reach from day one

  • Meaningful equity — early-stage, competitive package

  • Category tailwind — agentic AI in finance is one of the most active investment themes in enterprise software


Who you are

  • A product marketer at heart. You love understanding how products work, identifying the value they create and finding ways to communicate that to the market. You don't just want to write about products; you want to bring them to life.

  • Deeply curious about technology and AI. You enjoy getting under the hood of products, experimenting with new tools and understanding what's possible. You can translate technical capabilities into compelling business value.

  • An ideas machine. You constantly think of new ways to engage different audiences. You're not limited to traditional marketing formats and get excited about trying things nobody else is doing.

  • A hands-on builder. You don't need an agency, a designer or a production team to get started. You can write, create, experiment, build and ship things yourself.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that the objective isn't to win marketing awards. It's to make more people understand Payflows, create demand, strengthen our ecosystem and help the business grow.

  • A problem solver. You don't wait for a brief. You see a problem, figure out what needs to happen and make it happen. You're comfortable operating with very little structure.

  • Comfortable with senior people. You enjoy spending time with founders, product teams, CFOs, investors and consultants. You're curious about how businesses operate and how technology changes them.

  • Native-level English, Paris-based. You write and communicate like a native English speaker and are ready to work from our Paris office. French is a plus, but not essential.

This isn't for you if…

  • You see marketing primarily as writing posts, managing social media or coordinating campaigns.

  • You don't enjoy getting deep into how a product actually works.

  • You need someone else to come up with the ideas or tell you what to do.

  • You prefer planning and briefing over making and shipping.

  • You measure success by content produced rather than audiences reached, engaged and converted.

  • Build product rituals – Shape planning, review and OKR routines; introduce tooling to streamline documentation and knowledge sharing.

  • Maintain product catalogue and documentation – Partner with technical writers to keep documentation current and accessible.

  • Standardise release cycles – Coordinate with Engineering and Science teams to manage release timelines and ensure reliability.

About you

  • 5+ years in product operations, product management or strategy/operations roles (e.g., chief of staff, consulting) in deep‑tech or AI environments.

  • Comfortable working with data and analytics; able to turn usage data and feedback into actionable insights.

  • Strong cross‑functional collaborator; experienced in aligning product, engineering, marketing and sales teams around shared priorities.

  • Process‑oriented mindset; skilled at building repeatable workflows and release processes.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Fluency in English; French is a plus.

  • Bonus: experience with AI/ML products, pricing and packaging strategies, or consulting/finance backgrounds.

Hiring Process

Our recruitment process is designed to assess your fit for the role and give you a sense of our culture:

  1. Introduction call – 30 min

  2. Hiring manager interview – 30 min

  3. Interview with the product management team – 30 min

  4. Interview with the Solutions team – 30 min

  5. Deep‑dive interview with case study presentation – 60 min

  6. Culture‑fit discussion – 30 min

  7. Reference checks

Location & Remote

The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

  

By applying, you agree to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Product Owner Q-Bridge / WebOrder
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner Q-Bridge / WebOrder

Heemstede en Dordrecht | 32-40 uur per week

Ben jij een Product Owner die energie krijgt van het verder ontwikkelen en toekomstbestendig maken van een softwareproduct? Voor Q-Bridge / WebOrder zoeken we iemand die de regie neemt over de continuïteit, modernisering en groei van het platform. Jij bewaakt niet alleen de dagelijkse prestaties van het product, maar bepaalt ook de koers voor de toekomst.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt nauw samen met development, support, operations en sales en bent de verbindende schakel tussen klant, product en techniek. Met jouw visie geef je richting aan de productontwikkeling en zorg je ervoor dat Q-Bridge / WebOrder blijft aansluiten op de behoeften van zowel bestaande als nieuwe doelgroepen.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Heemstede en bent minimaal twee dagen per week aanwezig op onze locatie in Dordrecht. Zo blijf je nauw betrokken bij de verschillende teams en de organisatie.

Een veelzijdige rol voor iemand die eigenaarschap durft te nemen, strategisch kan denken én graag zichtbaar resultaat boekt in een product dat dagelijks door klanten wordt gebruikt.

Wat zijn je werkzaamheden?

  • Je bepaalt en bewaakt de productvisie en roadmap van Q-Bridge/WebOrder en geeft richting aan de verdere modernisering van het product.

  • Je prioriteert productontwikkeling samen met development en bewaakt de continuïteit, kwaliteit en stabiliteit van de applicatie.

  • Je zorgt dat contractuele afspraken, wet- en regelgeving en compliance-eisen op orde zijn en stuurt op een financieel gezond en winstgevend product.

  • Je bewaakt de balans tussen klantwensen, maatwerk en productstandaardisatie en vertaalt feedback van belangrijke klanten en ontwikkelingen in de markt naar concrete productkeuzes.

  • Je werkt samen met Sales aan commerciële kansen en productproposities. Sales blijft verantwoordelijk voor de verkoop en commerciële resultaten.

  • Je zorgt dat productkennis wordt opgebouwd, geborgd en toegankelijk gemaakt binnen de organisatie.

  • Je optimaliseert de ondersteuning rondom het product door supportvragen, bugs en klantwensen te structureren en terugkerende issues te vertalen naar structurele productverbeteringen.

  • Je benut AI om product support verder te automatiseren, onder andere door een Domain AI Assistant te ontwikkelen en te voeden met actuele productkennis.

  • Je werkt samen met development aan de verdere modernisering van Q-Bridge/WebOrder en de aansluiting op de NextGen-architectuur.

Waar ligt de focus?

In deze rol kijk je niet alleen naar wat er vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar waar Q-Bridge/WebOrder naartoe moet. Je brengt eerst rust, structuur en continuïteit, om vervolgens gericht te bouwen aan een toekomstbestendig product.

Op korte termijn ligt de focus op:

  • Het borgen van de continuïteit, stabiliteit en kwaliteit van het product.

  • Het op orde brengen van contractuele en juridische afspraken.

  • Het borgen van productkennis en development-capability binnen de organisatie.

  • Het structureren van product support en waar mogelijk automatiseren met AI.

  • Het verbeteren van de financiële gezondheid en winstgevendheid van het product.

  • Het aanbrengen van duidelijke productprioriteiten en focus.

Op middellange termijn verschuift de focus naar:

  • Het moderniseren van Q-Bridge/WebOrder en klaarstomen voor de toekomst.

  • Het bepalen van het toekomstige productmodel, de productvisie en roadmap.

  • Het geschikt maken van het product voor nieuwe doelgroepen en veranderende klantbehoeften.

  • Het verder automatiseren van product support en ontwikkelen van de Domain AI Assistant.

  • Het waar relevant gefaseerd aansluiten van functionaliteiten op de NextGen-architectuur.

Op lange termijn werk je toe naar een toekomstbestendig, schaalbaar en winstgevend Q-Bridge/WebOrder, met een steeds grotere mate van geautomatiseerde en intelligente productondersteuning.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur.

  • Een salaris tussen €5750,- tot € 7250,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond.

  • 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling.

  • Een pensioenregeling via Zwitserleven.

  • De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding en budget voor je thuiswerkplek.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De mogelijkheid tot fietslease.

  • Ruimte voor opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief.

Wie ben je en wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een ervaren Product Owner die eigenaarschap neemt over Q-Bridge/WebOrder en makkelijk schakelt tussen klant, techniek en organisatie. Je weet richting te geven, maakt duidelijke keuzes en krijgt energie van het verder brengen van een product.

Dit breng je mee:

  • Je hebt hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, informatica, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.

  • Een opleiding of certificering op het gebied van Product Ownership, Agile/Scrum of productmanagement, bijvoorbeeld PSPO, is een pré.

  • Je hebt ervaring als Product Owner of in een vergelijkbare productrol binnen een softwareomgeving.

  • Je beschikt over hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bepalen en bewaken van een productvisie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je hebt voldoende technische affiniteit om inhoudelijk goed met development te kunnen sparren.

  • Je krijgt energie van het moderniseren en toekomstbestendig maken van bestaande software.

  • Je bent sterk in het verbinden van verschillende disciplines en schakelt makkelijk met development, support, operations, sales en klanten.

  • Je bent analytisch én pragmatisch en weet complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot duidelijke keuzes en prioriteiten.

  • Je hebt oog voor zowel het klantbelang als de commerciële en financiële gezondheid van een product.

  • Je weet hoe je productkennis opbouwt, borgt en toegankelijk maakt binnen een organisatie.

  • Ervaring met AI of een sterke interesse in de mogelijkheden ervan om productkennis en support slimmer te organiseren is een pré.

Wie zijn wij?

Vertimart ontwikkelt al ruim 40 jaar softwareoplossingen voor de tandheelkundige sector. Met Exquise ondersteunen wij dagelijks duizenden zorgprofessionals bij patiëntendossiers, planning, declaraties en praktijkvoering. Binnen Vertimart combineren we technische innovatie met korte lijnen, een informele cultuur en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. We geloven in samenwerken, kennis delen en bouwen aan duurzame softwareoplossingen die écht impact maken binnen de zorg.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Het telefonische gesprek is met onze recruiter en kun je zien als een kennismaking. Wie zijn wij, wie ben jij, welke ervaring neem je mee en waar ben je naar op zoek? Daarna volgt een eerste gespreksronde met de leidinggevende en een collega uit het team. In de tweede ronde maak je kennis met een andere collega uit het team en de manager. Onderdeel van de procedure kan ook een assessment zijn. Dit kan plaatsvinden op onze locatie in Dordrecht of Heemstede.

Daarnaast is het belangrijk om te weten dat een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) nodig is om de functie te kunnen vervullen.


Reageren

Ben je enthousiast geworden en geïnteresseerd in deze functie? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog met jouw CV en motivatiebrief. Wil je eerst meer weten? Kijk dan op Vacatures - Vertimart of neem contact op met Chenara Vischer

Heb je vragen? Je mag ons mailen naar .

Aan bureaus & recruiters: we got this. Profielen en cv’s die tóch ongevraagd worden toegezonden, zullen behandeld worden als directe sollicitaties van de kandidaat.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
descriptionHtml:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.


Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.


Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.


Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.


Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
• Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
• Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
• Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
• Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
• Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
• Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
• Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.


• ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
• prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
• vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
• richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
• sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
• onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
• afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
• samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
• signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
• richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
• kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
• organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Product Owner WIFI, RF & Embedded Systems
descriptionHtml:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Au sein de l'équipe Product Management ASRS, le Product Owner Connectivity est responsable de la stratégie produit, du développement, de la performance et de la fiabilité des solutions de connectivité déployées sur une flotte mondiale de plus de 12 000 robots autonomes.

Le Product Owner Connectivity pilote l'ensemble des solutions de communication sans fil utilisées au sein des systèmes robotiques et équipements associés. Il garantit leur performance, leur robustesse, leur évolutivité et leur conformité aux exigences opérationnelles et de sécurité.

À l'interface entre les équipes Software, Electrical, Safety, Architecture, Validation et Opérations, il définit la roadmap produit et assure la livraison de solutions de connectivité répondant aux besoins actuels et futurs de l'entreprise.

Missions :

Solutions de connectivité

  • Pilotage du développement et de l'évolution du nouveau module WiFi propriétaire développé en interne.
  • Pilotage des organes de sécurité utilisant des technologies RF.
  • Responsabilité des équipements électriques intégrant ces technologies de communication.
  • Définition et suivi de la stratégie de connectivité des systèmes robotiques.

Gestion produit

  • Construire et maintenir la roadmap produit Connectivity.
  • Prioriser les évolutions fonctionnelles et techniques en fonction des enjeux business et opérationnels.
  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins des parties prenantes internes.
  • Piloter les arbitrages entre performance, coût, fiabilité et délais.

Performance & fiabilité

  • Assurer la disponibilité et la robustesse des communications sans fil à grande échelle.
  • Analyser les incidents terrain et définir les plans d'amélioration continue.
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité des solutions déployées.
  • Garantir la scalabilité des solutions pour accompagner la croissance de la flotte.

Coordination technique

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Embedded Software, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering et Safety.
  • Contribuer aux choix d'architecture des futures générations de produits.
  • Assurer la cohérence des solutions développées avec la stratégie technologique globale.

Profil

  • 8 à 10 ans d'expérience dans le développement de produits ou systèmes technologiques complexes, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
  • Solides connaissances en connectivité sans fil (WiFi 5 GHz / 6 GHz, technologies RF, couverture, roaming et performance réseau).
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes embarqués, de leurs architectures logicielles et des contraintes associées (temps réel, cybersécurité, sécurité fonctionnelle).
  • Connaissance des architectures électriques et systèmes industriels, avec la capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des experts hardware, software et systèmes.
  • Expérience du pilotage de sujets techniques complexes et de la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires.
  • Excellentes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes, de communication et d'influence.
  • Fort intérêt pour l'innovation technologique, l'amélioration continue et les environnements industriels exigeants.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi.

Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences.
En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

title: Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische
descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig.

Deine Tätigkeiten:

  • Entwicklung neuer Produkte von der Rohware bis zum Endprodukt

  • Bearbeitung / Erstellung von Musteranfragen / Mustern

  • Begleitung von Erstproduktionen und Linientests

  • Rezepturmanagement und Projektdokumentation

  • Organisation und Prüfung neuer Zutaten

  • Bearbeitung von Spezifikationen (Rohwaren, Endartikel)

  • Aktualisieren der bereits bestehenden Produktionsprozesse und -abläufe

  • Prozess- und Produktoptimierung im Rahmen von Neuentwicklungen

  • Deklarationsprüfung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Laboren und Forschungseinrichtungen

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Lebensmitteltechnologie, Oecotrophologie oder Fachkraft für Lebensmitteltechnik mit fundierter Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position

  • lebensmittelrechtliches und -chemisches Grundwissen

  • Erfahrung mit HACCP, Allergenmanagement und IFS

  • Prozesskenntnisse in der Lebensmittelindustrie

  • Sorgfältige und Selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Engagement und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie zielgerichtetes, sorgfältiges und effizientes Handeln

  • hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit, Organisationsvermögen und Teamgeist

  • analytische und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise, gutes Zahlenverständnis, vorausschauendes und ganzheitliches Denken

Das bieten wir:

  • Wir bieten Dir einen spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Vollzeitjob (alternativ Teilzeit - muss von den HR Managern angegeben werden).

  • Bei uns erwartet Dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen freundlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

title: Project Director

You will also build and develop a Project Management team that works with accountability, collaboration and a focus on continuous improvement. A central part of the role is leading change, including the practical adoption of AI and new technologies to improve efficiency, quality and speed. You will set the vision and step into the detail when it is needed, building confidence with senior client and internal stakeholders.

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead and develop the Project Management and Operations teams, setting clear direction and expectations and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Set the operational framework for the Project Managers, including processes, systems, tools, playbooks, templates and standard operating procedures. Establish performance measures that show delivery health, team performance and resource utilisation.

Establish costing models and financial controls, and ensure projects are scoped, costed and managed to support consistent, profitable delivery. Partner with Finance, HR and Recruitment to align resourcing and commercial objectives.

Set quality and governance standards, lead the rollout of new tools with measurable improvements, and build team confidence through experimentation and learning.

Work with Creative, Strategy, Production, Technology and Account Management leaders, and contribute to the senior leadership agenda that shapes the account's direction and growth. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience leading Project Management and Resource teams at director or equivalent senior level within a creative, advertising, marketing or communications agency.

  • Expertise overseeing complex, multi-workstream programmes and delivering consistently against quality, time and commercial objectives.
  • Strong knowledge of integrated marketing communications, particularly social-first content, digital and always-on communications. This includes the demands of high-volume content, reactive opportunities, multiple formats, platform specifications and rapid approval cycles.
  • Experience designing, implementing and embedding operational processes, governance frameworks and project management methodologies, and leading systems implementation and adoption.
  • Commercial awareness, including forecasting, resource utilisation, project costing and profitability.
  • Experience managing offshore and nearshore teams, external partners and complex delivery models.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, constructively challenge and build credibility at senior levels.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR’s Public Policy & Affairs (PPA) function is responsible for shaping and executing the firm’s global public policy, regulatory, and external engagement strategy. title: Quantitative Researcher – Short-Term Power Markets
descriptionHtml:
Role

You’ll take the flexibility of our battery fleet to the short-term power markets (Day-Ahead, Intraday) and develop the trading strategy behind it. Our trading is asset-backed. Every position is backed by real flexibility in our batteries, which sit behind the meter at industrial sites. Available flexibility depends on factory load, site limits and customer needs, and changes every hour.

Our data scientists optimize how each battery operates at its site. You focus on trading our fleet's flexibility in power markets. Both areas are closely linked, and our quantitative researchers and data scientists work as one team, often across each other's topics. We believe our edge will come from better use of data, new approaches and sharper predictions.

 

What you will do

  • Developing our trading strategies on Day-Ahead and Intraday, from research and backtesting to live operation.

  • Building and improving price forecasts for short-term markets and turning them into trading signals.

  • Bidding and trading the fleet's available flexibility under uncertainty and real operational constraints.

  • Managing risk: imbalance costs, execution quality and the trade-off between expected value and downside.

  • Measuring captured value against clear benchmarks and finding where we can do better.

  • Shaping how we access markets and expand to further markets and products as we grow.

  • Bringing models into production together with our engineers.

 

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience in quantitative research, machine learning or data science, ideally in trading or energy. Strategies you have run live are a strong plus.

  • Strong in time-series modeling and machine learning, including deep learning, with models that hold up under non-stationarity and regime shifts.

  • Solid backtesting practice: realistic assumptions, overfitting controls, walk-forward validation, risk-adjusted metrics.

  • You learn new domains fast. Deep knowledge of power markets is not required; our team will get you up to speed.

  • Good Python skills and the ambition to write clean code that runs in production, not just in notebooks. You don't need to be a software engineer by training, but you care about code quality and use AI tools to move fast.

  • Pragmatic and opinionated: you scope work sensibly, make decisions and don't wait for perfect requirements.

  • You enjoy working closely in a small team, learning each other's topics and covering for each other.

  • Nice to have: understanding of European short-term power markets, execution and imbalance settlement; experience trading batteries or other flexible assets; optimization under uncertainty; balancing markets. A PhD in a quantitative field is welcome.

 

What it means to work at BEO

  • We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in.

  • Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together.

  • We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need).

  • You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time.

title: Regional Sales Director - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position 

As a senior sales leader within Energy Exemplar’s EMEA Sales team, the Regional Sales Director - Trading is responsible for leading growth of PLEXOS and related solutions across power and gas trading organisations in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. 

This role combines frontline sales leadership with direct involvement in the region’s most strategic opportunities. The successful candidate will lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Executives while building senior relationships with power traders, trading desks, utilities, energy retailers, and other energy-market participants. They will bring strong enterprise software sales expertise, energy-market knowledge, and a deep understanding of how trading organisations use modelling, simulation, optimisation, and analytics to make strategic decisions. 

This is a unique opportunity to work with leading energy-trading organisations, help them unlock the full potential of Energy Exemplar’s PLEXOS software suite, and shape the future of energy-market simulation across EMEA. 

This Role Has Three Primary Objectives 

  1. Deliver EMEA Trading revenue growth: Lead the regional team to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities for PLEXOS, PLEXOS Insights, and PLEXOS Playbook, positioning Energy Exemplar as a leading provider of energy-market modelling and simulation technology. 
  1. Lead and develop a high-performing sales team: Set clear direction, build capability, and create accountability across the EMEA Trading sales organisation to consistently achieve regional revenue and pipeline targets. 
  1. Build strategic market relationships: Develop executive-level relationships with trading organisations, utilities, partners, and industry influencers to create a robust pipeline and position Energy Exemplar as a trusted adviser in the energy simulation space. 

Primary Responsibilities 

Sales Leadership and Team Development 

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Executives focused on power and gas trading customers across EMEA. 
  • Establish clear individual and regional goals, sales plans, and performance expectations. 
  • Drive sales discipline across opportunity qualification, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and deal execution. 
  • Support team members in complex sales cycles, executive engagements, proposals, negotiations, and strategic account development. 
  • Recruit, onboard, and retain high-calibre sales talent as the EMEA Trading business grows. 
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and customer-focused sales culture. 

Regional Business Development and Sales Execution 

  • Own the EMEA Trading regional sales strategy and execution plan, aligned to company growth objectives. 
  • Lead the delivery of regional new-business revenue and pipeline targets, while maintaining personal involvement in key strategic opportunities. 
  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities across EMEA, with particular focus on power and gas trading organisations, utilities, energy retailers, and energy-intensive organisations. 
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for priority organisations and target market segments. 
  • Lead discovery sessions with senior stakeholders to understand their commercial, operational, and technical challenges. 
  • Clearly articulate how PLEXOS solutions address trading, market modelling, portfolio optimisation, forecasting, and risk-management requirements. 
  • Prepare and support persuasive executive presentations, demonstrations, proposals, and business cases. 
  • Lead or support commercial negotiations involving contracts, pricing, and terms to close high-value new business opportunities. 
  • Partner with the Solutions team to coordinate effective proof-of-concept studies that demonstrate PLEXOS capabilities. 
  • Ensure accurate forecasting of sales activity, pipeline, and revenue through CRM tools. 

Market Intelligence and Strategic Planning 

  • Monitor and analyse market trends, competitive activity, regulatory developments, and customer needs across EMEA power and gas markets. 
  • Identify emerging opportunities within power trading and broader energy-market segments. 
  • Use market and sales data to guide territory strategy, resource allocation, and sales-performance improvement. 
  • Provide feedback to Product, Marketing, and senior leadership on market requirements, competitive positioning, and customer priorities. 
  • Contribute to the development and execution of regional go-to-market strategies. 
  • Represent Energy Exemplar at industry events, conferences, and webinars to build brand awareness and senior customer relationships. 
  • Support thought-leadership activity on energy trading, modelling, and simulation topics. 

Customer and Partner Relationship Management 

  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with key decision-makers and influencers in target accounts. 
  • Act as a trusted commercial adviser to customers on energy-market modelling and simulation best practices. 
  • Collaborate with Solutions and Customer Success teams to ensure a strong transition from sale to implementation and customer adoption. 
  • Work with partners, including consulting firms and system integrators, to develop joint value propositions and market opportunities. 
  • Identify and pursue cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the customer base. 
  • Ensure a consistently high standard of customer engagement across the regional team. 

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of successful enterprise B2B software sales experience, preferably within the energy sector. 
  • 2+ years of sales leadership experience, including coaching and managing quota-carrying Sales Executives. 
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team revenue targets and closing complex, high-value new business deals. 
  • Strong understanding of energy markets, power and gas trading operations, and market fundamentals. 
  • Experience selling complex software solutions to power trading organisations, utilities, energy retailers, or energy-intensive organisations. 
  • Demonstrated ability to build and execute regional sales strategies and strategic account plans. 
  • Strong executive presence, with excellent presentation, negotiation, and written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Experience navigating complex procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation processes. 
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, sales methodologies, forecasting, and sales analytics. 
  • Self-driven, commercially focused, and able to operate effectively in a dynamic, changing environment. 
  • Willingness to travel internationally within the EMEA region, approximately 40-50%.

title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

Vous interviendrez également directement auprès d’un ou plusieurs pôles projets afin de :

  • Participer à la rédaction et garantir la qualité des Features, User Stories et objectifs ;
  • S’assurer que les éléments du backlog sont suffisamment clairs, complets et prêts à être pris en charge par les équipes ;
  • Lever les obstacles rencontrés par les équipes et faciliter leur résolution ;

Outils et environnement

  • Confluence : documentation des équipes et du train ;

descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Insurance: the carriers, MGAs, and brokers people rely on when life gets expensive and complicated. These organizations win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to insurers reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Insurance industry

  • Balance a diverse pipeline of large national carriers that require a white-glove experience with regional and mid-sized insurers that require speed to close

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows, such as claims intake, policy servicing and renewals, billing and payment support, agent and broker support, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in insurance AI governance and regulation

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (Claims Operations, Customer Service and Contact Center, Distribution, Digital and Technology, and Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

title: Activation and Production Testing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Provide eID-specific activation guidance. When customer involvement is needed, explain the provider’s activation requirements, collect the necessary information, and guide customers through the steps they need to complete.

  • Recruit and manage production testers. Find and onboard testers for the countries and identity providers involved, confirm their eligibility and availability, explain what they need to do, and maintain an organized, reliable tester network.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • Help improve how we work. As you gain experience, identify recurring friction and improve checklists, documentation, and handoffs. You’ll also help monitor existing operational automations, check their outputs, and flag exceptions or improvement opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You are detail-driven and dependable. You can follow defined processes consistently, check information carefully, and complete repeatable work without losing accuracy or leaving loose ends.

  • You work in an organized way. You can manage multiple requests and test schedules, keep records current, and follow up with the right people to meet agreed timelines.

  • You communicate clearly and patiently. You’re comfortable working with customers, external testers, and identity providers. You can explain instructions, ask useful questions, and keep people informed without overwhelming them.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

  • You know when to ask for help. You recognize when something falls outside the playbook, escalate with useful context, and handle credentials and tester information carefully.

  • You want to grow beyond the checklist. You’re happy to learn established workflows first, then use what you’ve learned to suggest practical process improvements. We don’t expect you to arrive with every answer.

  • You work comfortably in Korean and English. You can communicate with local teammates and international customers, testers, and providers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Bonus: Experience in customer onboarding, operations, testing coordination, technical support, or customer success. Familiarity with B2B SaaS or digital identity is helpful, but not required.

⚡️ Fast Facts

  • 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors

  • 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library

  • 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs

  • 🔬 82 eID research projects completed

  • 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

title: Backend Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia.

You will work on custom WordPress functionality, editorial tools, content APIs, and integrations that enable our teams to create, manage, and publish content efficiently. You will also contribute to backend services built with Python and cloud technologies. 

We are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with a modern, AI-assisted approach to software development. You should be comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, solve problems, and streamline engineering workflows while maintaining ownership of the solutions you deliver. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience with WordPress architecture and PHP development, understands modern API-driven applications, and is comfortable working across multiple backend technologies. 

What You'll Do 

WordPress & CMS Development 

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom WordPress functionality, including custom post types, taxonomies, metadata, plugins, and editorial workflows. 
  • Build and enhance Gutenberg blocks and editor tools to improve the content creation and publishing experience.

Backend Services & Integrations

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows and automation. 
  • Continuously explore emerging AI development capabilities and adopt practical approaches that improve software delivery without compromising engineering standards. 
  • Follow company security and data privacy policies when using AI tools, ensuring sensitive information and proprietary code are handled appropriately. 

Engineering & Collaboration 

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code. 
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions. 
  • Develop automated tests and follow established CI/CD and deployment practices. 
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions. 
  • Take ownership of assigned features and technical improvements from design through deployment. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve developer workflows, application performance, and code quality. 

Required Qualifications 

  • Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production WordPress applications. 
  • Advanced knowledge of PHP 8+, object-oriented programming, and modern PHP development practices, including Composer and dependency management. 
  • Experience building custom WordPress plugins, post types, taxonomies, metadata, and REST APIs. 
  • Hands-on experience developing custom Gutenberg blocks and working with the WordPress block editor. 
  • Understanding of WordPress security, performance optimization, caching, and coding standards. 
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs. 
  • Working knowledge of Python, including experience developing backend applications, APIs, or background processing services. 
  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. 
  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows. 
  • Ability to understand and modify React and JavaScript code, particularly in Gutenberg-based interfaces. 
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent solutions, to improve development efficiency and code quality. 
  • Demonstrated ability to critically review, validate, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying on it without verification. 
  • Understanding of responsible AI usage in software development, including security, intellectual property, and data privacy considerations. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment. 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience developing or maintaining applications on WordPress VIP or other enterprise WordPress hosting platforms. 
  • Experience with asynchronous Python frameworks such as FastAPI or Quart. 
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
  • Experience with Redis, distributed caching, message queues, or event-driven systems.

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

We’re looking for a Principal SDET with strong experience in Go and Kubernetes to join our core product team. In this role, you’ll set the test strategy and build the quality engineering foundations for our AI cloud, ensuring the services that power AI workloads, including LLMs and GPU-based services, are reliable, performant, and ready for production.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams - including platform, backend, and machine learning engineers - to design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and quality engineering solutions. You’ll build the test automation frameworks that ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of systems that power model training, inference, and orchestration in production environments. You’ll mentor junior engineers, championing quality best practices, and driving initiatives to improve test coverage, release confidence, and overall software quality.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the test strategy and architecture for your team, and work with other SDETs to determine cross-team best practices.

  • Build test frameworks for APIs, services, and end-to-end flows.

  • Build test environments that reflect real GPU and cluster behaviour.

  • Integrate testing into CI/CD so it's fast and reliable.

  • Make testing easy for every engineer, and raise the quality bar across teams.

Your Profile

  • Software engineering experience, focused on testing and quality infrastructure.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Hands-on engineering skills in Go.

  • Experience testing gRPC and REST APIs and distributed systems.

  • Experience building end-to-end test frameworks and test environments.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Developer experience: Think in fast feedback for engineers, not just test coverage.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how your area interacts with compute, networking, storage, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.
