title: Senior Software Engineer (AppSec)
descriptionHtml:
About us

Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month.

About the role

You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with.

Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one.

About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary.

We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship.

What you’ll do

  • Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role.

  • Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening.

  • Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it.

  • Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look.

  • Vulnerability management. Run scanning and triage, own our vulnerability disclosure program, and handle incoming reports.

  • Automated quality. Own our security PR reviews, automated scans, fixes, and triage.

  • Write it down. Document how we do security so the rest of the team can answer customer questions with confidence.

  • Security habits. Help the engineering team build secure habits with reviews, docs, and light guardrails.

Like everyone at Trigger.dev, you’ll also help in our Discord and GitHub community, write docs, and create content like blog posts, code examples, and videos.

What we’re looking for

  • Senior backend engineer. You design and ship production backend systems yourself.

  • AppSec experience. You’ve done hands-on application security work, such as secure code review, threat modelling, pen testing, CTFs or bug bounties. You don’t need a security job title or to have run a security team.

  • Cloud operations. You’ve run production systems in the cloud.

  • Multi-tenant systems. You’ve built or secured systems where many customers share the same infrastructure.

  • TypeScript. You’re comfortable working in it. Our codebase also uses Go and Rust.

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools to automate testing, detection, and defense.

  • Startup pace. You’ve worked somewhere a step or two ahead of where we are, so you know what good looks like at our size.

  • Owner’s mindset. You take work off the team’s plate and fix what you find.

  • On call. Reliability and security response are shared across the team.

  • In-person time. You’re open to team events a few times a year.

You’ll stand out if you have

  • Built or hardened sandboxes: containers, microVMs, gVisor, Firecracker, WASM, or similar.

  • Secured platforms where customers have their own customers.

  • A track record in bug bounties or CTFs.

  • Contributed to open source.

  • Worked at a developer tools, infrastructure, or open source company.

  • Experience with Go or Rust.

Benefits

  • Compensation and equity. Generous, transparent pay, plus equity so everyone shares in the company’s success.

  • Async working. Need a heads-down day or a meeting-free day? No problem.

  • Home office. We help with equipment so you’re as productive at home as in the office.

  • Vacation. 25 days plus national holidays, sick leave, and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget. An annual budget for books, courses, or an Audible subscription.

  • Pension. Join our company scheme, or we’ll pay into your private pension.

Our values

  • We’re proud to be open source. We believe in the open source community and in building a great free-to-use product.

  • We ship uncomfortably fast. Moving fast is key for a startup. We’re pragmatic about what we build and when.

  • We work autonomously. We decide as a team what will help our customers most, and prioritize from there.

title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.
  • Fluent German and English.


Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing.

Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA.

Why you should work at Famedly:

  • Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector.
  • Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments.
  • Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape.
  • Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths.
  • Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens.
  • Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space!
  • Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year.
  • Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club.
  • A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome.
  • Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit.


We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Sounds good? What are you waiting for? Apply now! We are excited to get to know you!

Instead of a cover letter, send us a link to something you've built (Rust preferred) and two or three sentences about how you work with coding agents.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer. Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur.

Jouw rol

Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM.

  • Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden.

  • Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven.

  • Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties.

  • Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica. Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré.

Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum).

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit op deze rol, nodigen we je juist uit om te solliciteren. We denken namelijk graag met je mee! Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment om de match met de rol objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Security GRC Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Security GRC Lead to own security governance, risk, and compliance across Payward's acquisitions. You will be the accountable owner for bringing each acquired company from its own control environment into ours, working with the M&A Technology Team from diligence through to either full platform migration or steady-state coverage under our central program.

Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner.

This is a build role to uphold the repeatable process for assessing an acquired company against our security baseline, mapping its controls into our compliance frameworks,and setting remediation milestones a newly acquired team can realistically hit. You will then run it, deal after deal, and you are accountable for the work getting done.

 

The opportunity

  • Assess each acquisition target against Payward's security baseline, during diligence where deal timelines allow and immediately post-close otherwise

  • Map the acquired company's existing controls to Payward's control framework, and identify gaps against the external frameworks the entity falls under once in scope

  • Score control maturity at the entity level and document the basis for each score

  • Define remediation milestones that are achievable for the acquired team's size and maturity, sequenced by risk reduction rather than by framework order

  • Track milestones to closure and report status to Security GRC leadership and the M&A Technology Team

  • Recommend the endpoint for each entity: full migration onto Payward platforms, or uplift to a maturity level the central program can absorb

  • Load acquired-entity risks into the enterprise risk register and keep them current

  • Prepare acquired entities for inclusion in external audit scope, including evidence collection and walkthrough support

  • Act as the Security GRC point of contact for acquired-entity leadership, finance, and internal audit

  • Maintain policy coverage for acquired entities, including building entity-specific policy libraries where the parent policy set does not apply cleanly

  • Feed recurring findings back into the diligence process, so later deals are assessed against known patterns

  • Document the onboarding process so that it is repeatable and not dependent on one person

 

What Will you Do

  • Target Assessment

    • Review target security posture during diligence: control environment, identity and access management, infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and prior audit or examination history

    • Produce a written assessment of each target against the Payward security baseline, separating the risks that matter to the deal from those that matter to steady-state operations

    • Give the M&A Technology Team and deal sponsors a clear read on what integration will cost in control remediation terms

  • Control Mapping and Framework Onboarding

    • Map acquired controls to Payward's framework and to the external frameworks the entity becomes subject to

    • Identify which parent-company controls extend to the entity as they are, which need an entity-specific variant, and which have no equivalent at all

    • Build the entity's policy library where the parent policy set does not cover it

  • Remediation and Milestones

    • Set milestones the acquired team can meet, each with a date, an owner, and a stated risk reduction

    • Sequence work so that the highest-risk gaps close first rather than the easiest ones

    • Run the cadence for tracking remediation and escalating overdue or material risks Prepare proposed risk acceptances, including the rationale and compensating controls, and present them to leadership for decision

  • Program Integration

    • Prepare entities for external audit inclusion and support fieldwork

    • Keep acquired-entity risk visible in the enterprise risk register and in Security GRC reporting

    • Hand each entity over to central GRC coverage once its maturity supports it, with the handover documented

    • Integrate 3rd parties and vendors into Payward

What you bring

  • 5-7+ years in security governance, IT risk, or compliance, including regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environments

  • Direct experience onboarding an acquired company into an existing controls or compliance program. This is the core of the role

  • Working knowledge of SOX/ICFR IT general controls and what external auditors accept as evidence

  • Experience with at least two of ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS, including mapping controls across frameworks

  • Ability to assess control maturity and set remediation plans the receiving team completes, including teams below Payward's maturity level

  • Hands-on delivery: you write the scope, collect the evidence, and close gaps yourself when needed

  • Sound judgment on priorities with incomplete information, and the sense to escalate decisions that need leadership

  • Ability to build working relationships with control owners in IAM, infrastructure, and engineering

  • Ability to translate control gaps into risk language that deal teams and executives can act on

  • Strong project management across cross-functional, distributed teams

  • Preferred

    • CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

    • M&A or post-merger technology integration experience

    • Familiarity with PKM

 

Why This Role

  • You will own a domain end to end rather than supporting someone else's. There is no incumbent process and no one else doing this work today

  • Acquisitions are one of the fastest-moving parts of the business, and security integration sits on the critical path for each one

  • You will work directly with deal teams, acquired-company leadership, external auditors, and Security GRC leadership, with visibility into how acquisitions are evaluated and closed

  • Payward is preparing for public company reporting, which means the controls you put in place at acquired entities are the ones external auditors will test

  • The scope of this role grows with the acquisition pipeline, across jurisdictions and regulatory regimes

  • You will join a remote-first, international team

   

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Your responsibilities

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • You have proven experience as Sales Manager or Account Executive, preferably in the B2B Software as a Service (SaaS) or FinTech field, and ideally in a full sales-cycle and/or solution sales capacity

  • You are fluent (C2) in German and English (C1)

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Ownership - You take full responsibility for your pipeline, your targets, and your deals — from first touch to close. You drive momentum, solve problems proactively, and keep pushing even when it gets tough.

  • Structured Selling - You bring the method to sales - value-based selling, or your own proven system. You communicate clearly, lead discovery with purpose, and close with control. You know when to challenge, when to listen, and how to create urgency.

  • Customer Empathy - You take the time to understand what matters to each prospect — their pain points, context, and goals. You don’t just pitch features; you connect the dots. You’re consultative, curious, and focused on delivering real value.

  • Team Player - You’re not just here to hit quota — you bring energy, support your peers, and contribute to a positive, high-performance culture. You share what works, collaborate across teams, and care about how we win, not just that we win.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

descriptionHtml:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

Adventure Ahead 🚀

Step into a high-impact role as a Senior Account Executive for Enterprise Sales in DACH, where you will drive strategic growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You’ll partner with major enterprises to transform how they approach learning, enablement, and skills development—turning complex business priorities into measurable, real-world outcomes. Working alongside a powerhouse team of Solutions Consultants, BDRs, and executive leaders, you’ll own the full customer journey from bold territory strategy to celebratory contract close, directly shaping Docebo’s footprint in one of Europe’s most dynamic markets.

The Day-to-Day 💻

  • Command Your Territory: Own and expand a portfolio of named and strategic enterprise accounts across DACH, smashing ARR, pipeline-generation, and new-business targets through sharp account planning and whitespace mapping.

  • Orchestrate Winning Deals: Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from initial discovery to signed agreement, mobilizing BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Legal, Security, Value Engineering, and partners to deliver seamless evaluations and RFPs.

  • Strong command of enterprise LMS/LXP platforms or adjacent HR tech (HCM, HRIS, talent, or enablement), paired with a working knowledge of skills-based talent development.

  • Sharp analytical and forecasting habits using Salesforce, Gong, and modern prospecting tools, backed by the strategic judgment to qualify out poor-fit opportunities early.

  • Fluency in English and German

  • Ability to travel regularly across DACH and to selected EMEA customer meetings or events (approximately 20–30%).


Bonus Points 🌟

  • Direct experience selling enterprise learning, LMS/LXP, HR Tech, or workforce-development solutions, ideally backed by existing relationships with DACH HR, L&D, Talent, or IT leaders.

  • Hands-on familiarity with global learning programs serving external audiences (customers and partners), as well as complex enterprise security reviews, integrations, and RFP-led evaluations.

  • Background thriving in an international, remote-first SaaS environment with a track record of coaching and elevating fellow sellers.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

Our Promise to You 😍

title: Senior Advanced Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

NICE Public Safety – Senior Advanced Support Engineer

Location: Hedge End, Hampshire – Office Based(5 days in Southampton office)

Context and Purpose

Here at NICE Public Safety, we develop state of the art solutions for the Public Safety market, bringing together voice, video and screen recording, playback and analysis for Security customers worldwide.

We are currently expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers. As our products and support workloads scale, we are building an AI-first support model, and this role will help shape it.

Scope

We are looking for a Senior Advanced Support Engineer to work with an innovative product launching in an area new to cloud services.

The primary focus will be providing expert insight and analysis of complex support and integration issues, escalated by our regional T2/3 support teams. The role is hands-on and requires you to resolve the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications. This role will be required to deliver scripts, tooling, automation, documentation, knowledge articles and guidance to the regional teams to reduce the ongoing effort required to support our products.

This is an engineering-minded support role with an AI-first mindset. You will use AI tools and platforms, alongside your own technical judgement, to automate the triage, investigation and resolution of problems raised from the application, and you will help the wider support organisation adopt these ways of working as they evolve.

Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop subject matter expertise in our core technologies and services.
  • Use tools to pull and effectively analyse logs, traces, and other telemetry to determine the root cause of issues.
  • Provide root cause correction, not just symptom relief. Ensure that all facets of the problem are evaluated to eliminate recurrence of the issue.
  • Design, build and maintain AI-first workflows (using approved AI tools and platforms) that automate the triage, classification, investigation and resolution of issues raised from the application.
  • Apply AI to accelerate log, trace and telemetry analysis, and to draft root cause analyses, knowledge articles and customer updates, always validating AI output before it is acted on. Ensure that any data used is safe, secured and sanitised (removing personal, customer-identifiable and other sensitive information) before it is shared for AI analysis.
  • Automate repetitive support activity through scripts, tooling and process automation, turning recurring issues into self-service or auto-remediating solutions.
  • Identify, document, and report issues with software, design, reliability, and maintenance issues to the relevant teams, ensuring that they are aware of and are addressing customer expectations.
  • Collaborate and help build utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Engineers to operate safely at high speed / wide scale.
  • Coach and enable regional T2/3 teams to adopt AI tooling and automation, sharing prompts, patterns and good practice.
  • Measure the impact of automation and AI on time to detection, time to resolution and case volumes, and use the results to keep improving.
  • Work effectively with staff in all areas of the business, escalating when appropriate to management and/or R&D and Cloud Operations.
  • Take ownership of, and resolve, the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications, through to a confirmed resolution. Proactively pull cases from the queue based upon your skills and abilities, and work cases that are increasingly challenging to develop and sharpen your skills.

Knowledge and experience we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud support, ideally with a software engineering or developer background (for example, previously a software developer, DevOps or SRE engineer, a production or application support engineer who writes production-quality code, or similar experience supporting live production systems).
  • Excellent technical and analytical skills.
  • Experience and in-depth knowledge of data handling and MS SQL.
  • Strong experience of programming or advanced scripting (C#, PowerShell, Python, etc.), including version control, code review and testing practices.
  • Proven experience of automation, either through scripts and tooling or by automating and streamlining support processes (for example, CI/CD pipelines, scheduled jobs, runbook or workflow automation).
  • Hands-on exposure to AI tools and platforms, ideally applied to automating triage, investigation and resolution of application problems (for example, prompt design, agents, tool or API integration, or retrieval over knowledge bases and logs).
  • A strong AI mindset: you embrace AI-driven change, experiment with new tooling, and can critically assess AI output for accuracy, security and data-handling risk, with a clear understanding that data must be safe, secured and sanitised before it is shared for AI analysis.
  • Experience querying API’s (REST, SOAP) and processing the output.
  • Experience working on Production and Test customer systems.
  • Exposure to SOA applications and services.
  • Exposure to commercial cloud providers (Ideally Azure, others considered).
  • Familiarity with observability and telemetry tooling for logs, traces and metrics (desirable).
  • Efficient, effective and respectful communication skills both with customers and within internal departments. Including,
    • Good listener, able to identify and validate assumptions.
    • Able to use effective questioning to confirm understanding of a customer problem and then provide help to solve it.
    • Methodical troubleshooting, technical skill and attention to detail used in diagnosing problems and reproducing issues in a local environment.
    • Multi-tasking and time-management to prioritise and switch between varied tasks.
    • Curiosity and adaptability: willing to learn quickly, share knowledge, and change how the team works as AI capabilities evolve.

You must:

  • Be flexible with working hours when needed to address critical or urgent matters.
  • Will require to currently hold, or be eligible for, security clearance (NPVV3 and SC).
  • Be willing to embrace AI and automation as a core part of how Advanced Support works, and to use approved AI tools responsibly in line with NICE security, privacy and customer data-handling requirements.

Who We Are

NICE Public Safety is a software solutions provider specialising in helping public safety agencies round the globe. Our NICE Investigate solution has recently become a significant player in the modernisation of the UK and US justice systems by facilitating digital evidence management and sharing in a cloud service.

What The Team Does

NICE Investigate is being adopted by an increasing number of public-safety organisations around the globe. As a result, we are expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers.

descriptionHtml:

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Our ambition is to build the European leader in legal AI.

The Doctrine tech and product team (~100 people) is one of the best positioned in the world to drive this transformation.

title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist, you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

 

You will work in founder and product mode: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

  • Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them: You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

  • Build and operate AI agents as products: You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

  • Knowledge and context management: You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

  • Evaluation and quality assurance: You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

  • CRM and data integration: You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

  • Central interface and enablement: You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

  • Impact and measurement: Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.

What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:

  • Learning speed and a production mindset: You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.

  • An instinct for evaluation: You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.

  • Ownership and communication: You take ownership of a problem end to end, prioritize rigorously, feel comfortable with ambiguity, and make technical topics understandable to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Technical and data understanding: You can read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Zapier, and know how CRM data, ideally Salesforce data, flows into AI systems.

  • Strong communication skills: You have a confident command of English and can operate at the highest level in our international environment. German at B1 level is sufficient.

We Are Particularly Interested in:

  • Expertise with agent platforms: You have practical experience with systems such as Dust, Claude, or LangChain. Since tools evolve quickly, we primarily rely on your process understanding and evaluation skills as a sustainable foundation.

  • Technical depth and data fluency: You are proficient in languages such as Python or JavaScript and can confidently navigate Salesforce architectures or BI environments such as Tableau and Metabase to manage data flows effectively.

  • Operations experience: You have solid experience working with scaled Customer Success or Operations teams and understand their specific dynamics.

What We Offer

  • A Germany-wide public transport pass sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in hybrid mode

  • Company-sponsored health insurance with excellent additional benefits

  • 28 days of paid vacation, plus one additional day for every full calendar year of employment, up to a maximum of 30 days

  • Participation in Doctolib’s long-term employee equity program, DoctoGrowth

  • The opportunity to work from abroad for up to 10 days per year

  • An occupational pension scheme with an employer contribution of 40%, or 15% during the probationary period

  • The Doctolib Parent Care Program, which includes one additional month of parental leave and much more

  • Free mental health and coaching sessions through an external partner

  • In addition to healthy snacks and a regular breakfast buffet, we offer meal vouchers

  • A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club

  • For caregivers and employees with disabilities, we offer support that includes more flexible working hours, additional leave for medical reasons, and psychological support

The Interview Process

  • Interview with Talent

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • On-site case study

  • Final interview with VP

  • Reference checks

  • Offer

Job Details

  • Permanent position

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Start date: July

  • Hybrid, 2 days working from home per week

Our vision is to improve the health of everyone. This is also reflected in our recruitment process. We evaluate applications exclusively on the basis of qualifications and motivation. We do not tolerate discrimination.

The more diverse our team and ideas are, the more our product can contribute to improving the health of our users. That is why we invite you to apply, regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnic origin, or disability.

 

To ensure equal opportunities, you may omit information such as photos, age, and similar details from your application. Please let us know what accommodations we can make to support you in the best possible way.

We look forward to digitalizing healthcare together with you!

title: Senior AI Transformation & Innovation Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As a Senior AI Transformation & Innovation Consultant (internal title: Senior Applied Value Engineer )you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers.

The Role:

As Senior Applied Value Engineer, you are a strategic pioneer leading the charge in solving complex, business-critical problems for our customers. Working with our most strategic global accounts, you will diagnose their strategy and key operational challenges to discover and build tailored, domain-specific use cases. You will architect and prototype state-of-the-art AI and technical solutions on the Celonis platform, demonstrate their business impact to C-suite Executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realization. 

Native-level German proficiency (C1/C2) is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in German.

The role is based in Munich.

The work you’ll do:

  • Discovery & Advanced AI Solutioning: Act as the foremost Celonis product and domain positioning expert. Seamlessly translate deep domain expertise and complex customer requirements into flawless enterprise architecture. You will lead technical discovery to architect, prototype, and build bespoke, state-of-the-art AI solutions targeting nuanced operational pain points.
  • AI Solution Development: Lead the end-to-end execution of high-stakes Proof-of-Value (PoV) projects. Architect and deliver highly secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with advanced RAG, tools, and strict guardrails; integrating flawlessly with rigid enterprise data, identity, and compliance frameworks.
  • Value Selling & Realization: Act as a trusted advisor, maintaining active involvement with strategic accounts to ensure programmatic value realization until agreed-upon value, massive adoption thresholds, and operational transformations are achieved.
  • Domain & Industry Specialization: Leverage deep domain expertise combined with cross-system, AI-driven solutioning to architect industry-specific E2E solutions. You will codify this work into reusable methodology and globally scalable assets to accelerate time-to-value and mentor junior peers.

The qualifications you need:

  • Executive-Facing Presales & Value Engineering (5+ years): Demonstrated experience independently owning the technical close and driving compelling AI transformation narratives. Requires a proven background in accountable PoV execution, complex ROI/TCO modeling, and showcasing the "Art of the Possible" by pitching visionary solutions to hidden problems—with a clear track record of driving projects all the way through to achieved value.
  • Domain & Industry Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows and industry landscapes (e.g., supply chain, finance). You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • Software/Data Engineering: Python proficiency, modular API design, creating reusable libraries, advanced SQL, and scalable data integration using ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face).
  • Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos. 
  • Degree: Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • Native-level or near-native German language skills ((C1/C2)), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.
  • The role is based in Munich.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Autonomy Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments. The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.
What you'll do:
  • System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

    • Required qualifications:
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

    • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.

title: Senior Brand Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Role overview 🌟

Alan has passed 1M members, works with 40K+ companies and operates in seven countries. New products and a flagship international event are coming, and the Brand team is investing in bigger campaigns. So far brand spend has gone mostly to broad awareness. We now need targeted B2B campaigns for specific verticals (for example TNS, retirees, very small company owners), run alongside the broad campaigns to reinforce them.

You'll own these vertical B2B brand campaigns for France, plus a portfolio of other brand projects. You'll work closely with the Brand Lead, Product Marketing, Growth, segment owners and Sales. This is an individual-contributor role at C1-D level.

What you'll do

  • Vertical campaigns: Define the audience, message, proof points and channels for each priority vertical. Choose priorities and objectives with segment owners, Growth and Product Marketing. Run each campaign from brief to post-mortem, and build reusable toolkits (messaging, assets, case studies) for other teams.

  • Product and offer launches: Support the launch of new product features (e.g. Mo, Alan Précision) and new offers (e.g. Alan retirees) in France. Work in strong collaboration with the Product teams to build a creative, impactful go-to-market that stands out in the market. Turn product positioning into launch plans and assets.

  • Partnerships and events: Run vertical-specific events, sponsorships, ambassador and creator partnerships that build credibility with each audience.

  • Local markets: Give feedback on local briefs and plans. Spot French initiatives that could scale to other markets and capture them in playbooks.

  • Measurement: Set KPIs for every project (reach in the target, qualified leads, pipeline influenced, brand perception). Run test-and-learn with Growth and Data. Manage budgets, vendors and deadlines.

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years of in-house brand marketing (B2C, B2B or B2B2C). Paid media or media planning is a big plus.

  • Have led at least two B2B campaigns or brand projects end to end, and can walk us through the problem, your choices and the measurable result.

  • Have managed agencies and budgets and made trade-offs when resources were tight.

  • Are a generalist across campaigns, content, partnerships, events and PR, with sharp creative judgment you can defend with senior stakeholders.

  • Set brand KPIs and link brand work to pipeline or lead quality.

  • Work well with Sales and Growth and can influence without authority.

  • Written and verbal communication fluency in English and French

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Senior Business Analyst - BI Expert & Strategy Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst AI-Projekte umsetzen – bei Weltkonzernen und Marktführern, die du aus dem Alltag kennst? Willkommen bei twomynds.

Wir sind eine dedizierte Data-&-AI-Beratung und Service Provider mit End-to-End-Umsetzung – von der strategischen Zielsetzung bis zur operativen Realisierung. Unsere Mission: Ambitionierte Unternehmen befähigen, Data & AI in geschäftskritischen Mehrwert zu verwandeln.

Von der Use-Case-Identifizierung über Prototyping bis zur produktionsreifen Implementierung in interdisziplinären Teams – wir bringen AI gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden messbar in die Umsetzung.

Was uns auszeichnet

  • End-to-End-Ansatz: Von der Business-Strategie bis zum laufenden Betrieb.
  • Unsere Werte: Perform. Grow. Communicate. Dedicate. Balance.
  • Wachstum & Entwicklung: Verantwortung, Weiterbildungsbudget, Mentoring & individuelle Karrierepfade.
  • Flexibilität: Moderne Arbeitsmodelle mit Remote-Optionen (1x Woche fixer Office Day)

Deine Rolle – Senior Business Analyst - Power BI Expert & Strategy Consultant (m/w/d)

Du liebst es, mit Daten zu arbeiten und möchtest den Business-Erfolg unserer Kunden direkt mit beeinflussen? Als Senior Business Analyst übernimmst du bei uns echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: von der strategischen Anforderungsanalyse beim Kunden, über Datenmodellierung, DAX-Logik und Dashboard-Design, bis zum regelmäßigen Reporting vor dem Kundenkreis. Du bist nicht Umsetzer*in im Hintergrund, sondern Owner*in deiner Themen – inklusive Storyline, Empfehlung und Wirkung im Management-Meeting. Als Power BI Expert*in bist du dabei der inhaltliche Anker im Team: Du beherrschst Power BI auf Senior-Level (saubere Modellierung, wartbares DAX, klares Visual Design) und entwickelst unsere Standards rund um BI-Architektur, Datenmodelle und Reporting-Logik aktiv weiter – im Kundenprojekt und intern.

Als Power BI Expert*in liebst du nicht nur Power BI als Tool – du nutzt es, um die richtigen Business-Fragen zu beantworten und Entscheidungen im Kundenkreis vorzubereiten. Du verwandelst komplexe Anforderungen in saubere Modelle, kluge Measures und Reports, die nicht nur zeigen, was passiert, sondern auch erklären, warum es relevant ist und was daraus folgt.

Du bist genau richtig, wenn:
• Du einem C-Level erklären kannst, was das Chart bedeutet – und einem Entwickler, warum das Measure gerade falsch rechnet. Auf Wunsch auch gleichzeitig.
• Du Marktanalysen, Customer Journeys und Performance-Daten nicht trennst, sondern daraus eine Geschichte machst, die im Management-Meeting hängen bleibt.
• „Wir haben noch keine saubere Datengrundlage" kein Stopper für dich ist, sondern der Startschuss.
• Du die Power BI Release Notes liest, bevor sie in deinem Feed aufpoppen – und dir bei manchen Features denkst: endlich
• Nichts besser ist als das Gefühl, wenn eine komplexe Business-Anforderung in einem sauberen, wartbaren Measure landet.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von Daten- & KI Strategien: Beratung unserer Kunden bei Strategiedefinitionen, Datenerfassungen, Analysen, Visualisierungen, Maßnahmenableitungen & der Umsetzung von Use Cases.
  • BI-Lösungen von Grund auf bauen: Du entwickelst skalierbare Power BI Reports – von der Datenmodellierung und Power Query über DAX-Measures bis zum fertigen Dashboard, das Kunden wirklich nutzen.
  • Anforderungen in Lösungen verwandeln: Du übersetzt vage Kundenwünsche in konkrete BI-Anforderungen – und sorgst dafür, dass der fertige Report die eigentliche Frage beantwortet, nicht nur die, die jemand gestellt hat.
  • Analyse von Märkten, Customer Journeys & Performance: Du analysierst z. B. Märkte oder Performance, leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab & entwickelst auf dieser Basis Präsentationen für das Top-Management.
  • Zahlen in Stories & Entscheidungen übersetzen: Du verarbeitest große Datenmengen in Business-Intelligence-Tools (primär Power BI), erstellst fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen & entwickelst Datenstrategien von der Beschaffung über die Modellierung bis zur intelligenten Visualisierung.
  • Vermittlung von Daten & Erkenntnissen an Entscheider: Kommunikation der Analyseergebnisse an Stakeholder – du machst komplexe Daten verständlich und präsentierst sie klar & adressatengerecht.
  • Storylining & Aufbau des Dashboards: Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden die konkreten Leitfragen, die das Dashboard beantworten soll, und baust den Report so auf, dass Nutzer*innen schnell verstehen, was sie sehen, warum es wichtig ist und welche Entscheidung daraus folgt.
  • Mitgestaltung von Data- & AI-Use-Cases: Du übernimmst Management- und PMO-Aufgaben bei der Implementierung von Use Cases: koordinierst Stakeholder, sicherst die operative Umsetzung & treibst Projekte bis zum Impact beim Kunden.

Qualifikation

Power BI Expert-Level:

Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Datenanalyse, -aufbereitung und -visualisierung mit – und arbeitest dabei auf Senior-Level: saubere Datenmodellierung, wartbare DAX-Measures, strukturiertes Visual Design und der sichere Umgang mit großen Datensätzen und komplexen Datenbanken.

Power Query, SQL & Datenaufbereitung:

title: Senior Business Development Executive
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and enabling our clients to Do Great Things. As a trusted technology adviser and managed services provider, we help clients navigate continuous change and embrace innovation.

We deliver world-class transformational services across AI, hybrid cloud, infrastructure, mainframe, data, IdAM, and cloud-native solutions, simplifying complex business challenges and creating new pathways to success. Headquartered in the USA and backed by private equity, Ensono has a strong track record in the UK and Europe, with growth plans built on trusted partnerships and deep industry expertise.

About the role:

As a Senior Business Development Executive, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating Ensono’s growth in the UK by identifying, developing and converting opportunities with organisations that align to our Ideal Client Profile (ICP).

You will take a proactive, insight-led approach to opening new client relationships and building a high-quality pipeline of net-new logo opportunities. Using market intelligence, targeted research and AI-enabled tools, you will identify where Ensono can add the greatest value, develop compelling account and pursuit strategies, and create actionable business development initiatives that bring our full portfolio of capabilities to the UK market.

Working closely with senior sales leaders, sales and wider go-to-market teams, you will help shape opportunities from initial prospect identification through to proposition and pursuit development. You will bring strong commercial judgement, curiosity and creativity, using client and market insight to turn potential opportunities into meaningful business conversations.

The ideal candidate will be an accomplished business development professional with a strong track record of creating new opportunities and engaging senior stakeholders. You will be confident using AI and data to sharpen prospecting and account strategies, an excellent communicator, and a collaborative self-starter with the energy and commercial focus to help Ensono win new clients and deliver sustainable growth.

How Your Success Will Be Measured and Rewarded

At Ensono, we want great business development to deliver great outcomes and be recognised accordingly. Success in this role will be measured through the number and quality of leads you generate, the new-logo opportunities and pipeline you create, and your contribution to converting those opportunities into sustainable growth. You'll have clear lead-generation and pipeline objectives, with strong performance recognised and rewarded through Ensono's incentive arrangements, eligibility for Presidents Club nomination, and recognition via the global Elevate recognition platform.

Role & Responsibilities:

Lead Generation & New Logo Pipeline Development: Proactively generate and qualify leads within organisations aligned to Ensono’s Ideal Client Profile (ICP), using targeted, multi-channel outreach to build a high-quality pipeline of net-new logo opportunities.

Target Account Prospecting: Develop and execute focused prospecting plans across priority accounts, identifying key decisionmakers, buying signals and relevant entry points for Ensono.

Partner with New Logo Sellers: Work closely with New Logo Sales to identify, engage and qualify prospective clients, providing insight and account intelligence that helps open doors and progress opportunities.

Market Intelligence & Whitespace Identification: Conduct targeted research across industries, markets and competitors to identify whitespace, emerging client needs and new opportunities for Ensono.

AI-Enabled Business Development: Use AI extensively to enhance prospect research, identify buying signals, personalise outreach, develop account strategies and increase the effectiveness and scale of lead-generation activity.

Target Account Management: Own and continually refine Target Account Lists (TALs), prioritising activity based on market intelligence, engagement data, seller input and opportunity potential.

Client Engagement & Relationship Building: Build relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, creating relevant conversations that connect client priorities with Ensono’s capabilities.

Lead Qualification & Opportunity Development: Qualify prospective opportunities and work with sellers to move strong leads through the early stages of the sales cycle, ensuring effective handover and continued momentum.

Propositions & Pitches: Contribute insight and research to tailored propositions, pitches and pursuit activity that demonstrate Ensono’s value and differentiation.

Go-to-Market Collaboration: Work across Sales, Marketing, Alliances and solution teams to coordinate campaigns, account-based activity and market initiatives that generate demand and create new opportunities.

Sales Effectiveness & Conversion: Analyse outreach, engagement and conversion data to continuously improve targeting, messaging, prospecting methods and lead quality.

CRM & Pipeline Discipline: Maintain accurate CRM data and account intelligence, providing clear visibility of prospecting activity, lead progression and pipeline development.

Performance & Impact: Deliver against defined lead-generation and pipeline objectives, measuring success through qualified leads, opportunities created, pipeline progression and contribution to new-logo growth.

What you will being to Ensono

  • Minimum of 8+ years of experience in business development, new logo acquisition, sales, or sales support within the IT/managed services industry.
  • Track record of supporting successful client acquisition and building net-new pipeline.
  • Experience analysing sales performance and market data to inform BD strategy and improve conversion.
  • Ability to translate research and market intelligence into actionable go-to-market plays.
  • Experience supporting partnership development and structured pursuit cycles.
  • Strong understanding of managed services, cloud solutions, and IT infrastructure.
  • Exceptional communication, proposal creation, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
  • Ability to manage CRM hygiene and support process improvements to accelerate BD effectiveness.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to identify whitespace opportunities and influence decision-making.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to operate independently and collaboratively in a fast-moving environment.
  • Willingness to travel when needed for client and stakeholder engagement.

What we can offer you:

We are a people-first business, people are at the heart of everything we do here. We offer our associates a safe environment where learning, knowledge sharing, and open communication is encouraged. Whether at one of the internal social events, competency meet-ups, hackathons or as part of one or more of our global Community Groups, such as Beautiful Brains (for the neurodiverse and curious), HERO (helping to education regarding orientation), E-Vets (Ensono veteran community) and many more, we strive to ensure that everyone feels welcome, included, and valued. Additionally, our standard benefits include:

  • Competitive base with uncapped commission
  • The ability to work from a range of flexible locations
  • Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual Presidents Club
  • Starting with 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) – accruing to 30
  • 1/2 day leave on your birthday
  • Sabbatical options at 5 & 10 years' service
  • 5 days study leave
  • Generous company pension
  • Private healthcare for you and your family
  • Payroll giving
  • Enhanced paternity and maternity leave
  • Equity appreciation program incentive plan
  • Life and income protection

Additional perks such as discounted gym memberships, cycle scheme, EAP and more.  If this all sounds great, we’d love to hear from you!

title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick.

  • Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten.

  • Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen.

AI-native arbeiten

AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse.

  • Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach.

Noch Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Echte Wirkung: Deine Analysen fließen direkt in Entscheidungen von Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen.

  • Kurze Wege und enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern.

  • Einen modernen Stack (Snowflake, Tableau, NetSuite, AI-Tools) und den Freiraum, ihn weiterzuentwickeln.

UNSERE BENEFITS

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.
