title: Senior C++ Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Every payment we process runs on infrastructure we built. At Checkout.com, the Cloud Platform team owns the cloud foundations that global payments depend on: a large multi-account AWS estate, a growing Azure platform, and the networking and connectivity that reaches card schemes and banks worldwide. We are genuinely multi-cloud, and we are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who is too - a strong generalist who treats infrastructure as a software problem and can deliver from week one.

This is a hands-on senior role in an established, fast-moving team. Everything we run is defined in code, deployed through pipelines, and reviewed like software. You will bring deep cloud expertise across AWS and Azure and pair it with a genuine software engineering mindset: you write Terraform modules others build on, you automate away toil rather than documenting it, and you treat the platform as a product with users, SLOs, and a roadmap.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you are responsible for the technical delivery of your team's services. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure our platform meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

What we are looking for:

Deep AWS expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure in AWS at enterprise scale: multi-account architectures (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs), IAM, KMS, and the core compute, storage, and security services that a large regulated estate runs on. You should have a proven track record of delivering resilient, multi-region architectures.

Azure experience: Real production experience with Azure alongside AWS: landing zones, VNet architectures, Entra ID, and the Azure resource and governance model. You understand where the two clouds differ and can design well for both rather than forcing one cloud's patterns onto the other.

Software engineering mindset: You treat infrastructure as software. Expert-level Terraform: reusable modules, secure state management, and disciplined code review. You are comfortable in a Git-based workflow with CI/CD (we use Spacelift), and you reach for Python or similar to automate what others would handle with a runbook. No ClickOps.

Strong cloud networking: Confident designing and debugging in a complex network estate: VPC and VNet design, hub-and-spoke and Transit Gateway or Cloud WAN architectures, DNS, private connectivity (PrivateLink, Private Link), and enough routing knowledge to own connectivity issues end to end rather than escalate them.

Kubernetes: Solid experience running containerised workloads in production, ideally on EKS/AKS: cluster lifecycle, workload deployment patterns, and the operational realities of keeping Kubernetes healthy at scale.

Security and compliance awareness: Experience operating in regulated environments. You understand why change control, least privilege, and auditability matter, and you design controls in rather than bolting them on. Familiarity with PCI DSS is a strong plus.

Engineering excellence: A focus on observability and measurement: you instrument what you build and answer operational questions with data rather than opinion.

Leadership and mentorship: A natural ability to guide and mentor peers, translate ambiguous problem definitions into actionable technical plans, and raise the bar through your code and your reviews.

Pragmatic problem solver: You understand when to move fast (creating tech debt) and when to move right (paying it off). You are a cornerstone in incident resolution and root-cause analysis.

Experience: 5+ years in cloud engineering roles with significant AWS depth. We need someone who can hit the ground running: comfortable joining a complex, established estate and delivering meaningful work in their first weeks, not their first quarter. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is useful but not required; we care about what you can build.

How you’ll make an impact:

Lead Design & Delivery: Take ownership of large-scale platform projects end to end, from architecture through Terraform to production, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and cost-optimised.

Build the paved road: Design the platform primitives that every product team at Checkout.com builds on, so that the secure path is also the easy path.

Architectural Influence: Work with Engineering Managers and architects to refine requirements and shape the technical direction of the platform, documenting significant decisions as ADRs.

Operational SME: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for numerous team-owned services, providing advanced operational support and ensuring high availability for our global payment systems.

Evangelise Best Practices: Produce exemplary code and documentation that inspires others. You will be responsible for spreading best practices and standards across your group.

Manage Dependencies: Navigate the organisation to manage technical dependencies inside and outside your pillar, optimising for both delivery speed and business outcomes.

Foster Culture: Embody Checkout Operating Principles, using them to shape the group’s culture and acting as an example of efficiency and professional excellence.

AI Integration: Proactively explore and implement AI-driven automation to enhance infrastructure efficiency and team productivity.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Creative Project Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role working 3 days a week from our London HQ. In this role, you'll help us lead the end-to-end delivery of creative projects across diverse briefs—from fast-turnaround sprints to global, multi-channel campaigns—while driving studio operations and process improvements. This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Creative Studio team. Reporting into the PMO Lead, you'll work alongside Creative, Campaign, Design, and Creative Operations functions to power our in-house marketing and creative output.

Campaign & Project Delivery

title: Senior Customer Support Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Location: Stoke-on-Trent ST1
Training Period: Will be conducted Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm for the first four weeks
Working hours: 40 hours per week, 5 days out of any 7 (8 hours a day, between 7:50am - 2am)

Remuneration Package

  • Up to 20% annual company bonus and unsociable hours allowance, when applicable
  • Office-based for the first 4 months (probation and training period) - this will allow you to get to know the team, soak up crucial knowledge and benefit from face to face support whilst learning the role!
  • Hybrid working (2 days in the office) available after successful completion of probation period

The Role

Providing the best in class service to our players needs lots of work. Your energy and passion will be put to good use, and the more you give, the more you'll get in return.

LiveScore Group is home to LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet, three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming industries today. We are passionate and excited about what we do in the Sports Media, Gaming and Betting sector and are proud of the high ratings we have achieved. We live our values, aiming to enhance and increase the enjoyment of sport through innovative products and immersive experiences. Trust is important in how we work, ensuring we are a collaborative unit who holds each other accountable. Relentlessly ambitious in everything we do, we embrace change and understand that failure is part of success.

We use our platform for positive social change and work to build a company our employees are proud to work for. We have a long-term commitment to diversity and inclusion. Our I.D.E.A (Inclusion, Diversity, Equality, Awareness) Forum is critical to our business and is embedded in our organisational structure to support a sense of belonging for everyone and to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive.

We know a job description can often deter an applicant who does not believe they match 100% of our requirements. If you are interested in this position and have relevant experience, then we would still love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a first point of contact for our players providing them with a resolution to their sporting or gaming query. Sports betting happens quickly; in this role we will expect you to think fast and react even faster.
  • Try to resolve everything, first time, every time. With complex issues, you should ascertain urgency and follow the appropriate next steps in line with the department guidelines, escalating issues to the right department or Service Lead where appropriate.
  • Time is of the essence. You'd need to manage all tasks in an efficient and timely manner. If you follow the escalation procedure, keep track and see it through resolution, too.
  • Numbers are important. We need tip-top mathematicians to provide our players with transactional advice on banking, deposits, withdrawals, pricing and calculation of bet settlements.
  • The art of conversation. You'd need to communicate effectively and efficiently with players, colleagues, Service Leads and the Management Team to ensure delivery of business objectives.
  • Hit the spot. Our department KPIs need to be met (or exceeded) and so we ask that you're fast, efficient and that you get it right first time to thrill our players and reduce duplicate contacts.
  • Knowledge is power - Keep on top of sports, as well as our other products and tools, to ensure you're keeping up with our players, and with the business and department's strategy.
  • Collaborate with other departments, take part in projects, and attend meetings at other locations as required.
  • Have fun, making fun – Contribute to, and promote, a positive working environment.
  • Become a constant, positive role model and drive to inspire others to have fun whilst working.
  • Be proactive and demonstrate Real Time Resource Management awareness maintaining service levels and efficiencies.
  • Deflect Operator Complaints by handling 2nd line escalations and finding positive solutions.
  • Have a flexible attitude towards shift patterns.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • A key understanding of the business and department OKRs with a determination to achieve and exceed targets.
  • A technical problem solver with a focus on helping develop internal functions.
  • An ability to bring outstanding issues to a resolution, building key relationships across the business.
  • Liaise with key stakeholders raising critical issues and reduce the customer propensity to contact.
  • To escalate and help guide company decisions through sharing voice of the player feedback.
  • A problem solver whilst showing commercial awareness for each player.
  • An expert in the group marketing initiatives and internal functions and processes.
  • To be able to resolve complex queries and show a commitment in helping guide the CS Advisor group.
  • Maintain & exceed the internal QA score going above and beyond for each customer contact.
  • An expert in handling multiple Live Chat, email & social media
  • Outstanding customer handling skills, as well as oral and written communication skills
  • An investigative approach whilst fact-finding to guarantee first contact resolution
  • Excellent PC skills, who is an expert with Excel and the web.
  • Fast and accurate typing skills
  • Sports knowledge & a passion for sports is essential

What can we offer?

  • Hybrid working for all staff with flexible working opportunities
  • Private Healthcare scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay

title: Senior CX Solution Design Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

The Senior CX Solution Design Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the solution design and delivery of complex Digital Asset client engagements. Engagements can range from delivering expert design and implementation advice to hands-on software delivery.

The role combines deep expertise in product management, business analysis, enterprise software delivery, Daml, and the Canton Network with strong client leadership and cross-functional execution.

Operating as a player-architect, the Senior CX Solution Design Lead ensures complex client objectives are translated into practical solution designs, structured implementation plans, actionable requirements, guiding the solution end-to-end to ensure a successful final delivery. The role independently coordinates across clients, partners, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other internal teams to drive successful outcomes while ensuring solutions align with Digital Asset’s architectural and delivery standards.

The role also serves as a functional and solution-design authority within CX, raising the quality of client deliverables, mentoring less-experienced colleagues, and identifying opportunities to improve the way complex client engagements are delivered.

Responsibilities:

Lead Complex Solution Design & Client Delivery

  • Leads the solution design and day-to-day execution of complex client engagements involving Daml, the Canton Network, and enterprise software implementations
  • Translates client business objectives and requirements into structured solution designs, implementation approaches, delivery plans, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Independently leads complex workstreams across multiple teams, managing dependencies, decisions, risks, and competing priorities
  • Serves as a senior functional and solution-design authority throughout the engagement lifecycle
  • Leads client steering committee meetings and other senior stakeholder forums, providing clear updates on delivery progress, risks, decisions, and recommended actions

Drive Business Analysis & Functional Design

Apply Daml & Canton Expertise

  • Applies deep knowledge of Daml, the Canton Network, distributed ledger technology, and enterprise application architecture to complex client challenges
  • Guides solution approaches that align with Digital Asset's architectural principles, product capabilities, and implementation best practices
  • Identifies architectural, integration, and implementation risks and work with internal technical teams to develop effective solutions
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on Daml and Canton-related solution design within CX and across relevant internal teams

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

  • Coordinates independently across CX, Product, Engineering, Sales, and other functions to ensure effective execution of client solutions
  • Manages cross-team dependencies and resolve technical or procedural misalignments without requiring routine escalation to senior leadership
  • Maintains strong transparency across internal and external teams, ensuring stakeholders have clear visibility into priorities, decisions, progress, and risks
  • Provides guidance to external partners and vendors involved in client solution delivery
  • Establishes appropriate delivery practices, documentation standards, communication cadences, and quality checks within assigned engagements and workstreams

Support Sales & Client Expansion

  • Partners with Sales on pre-sales opportunities, providing solution-design expertise, client discovery, workshops, and implementation perspectives

  • Supports a seamless transition from pre-sales to post-sales by ensuring requirements, commitments, assumptions, and solution decisions are clearly documented
  • Identifies recurring client needs and opportunities for reusable solutions, services, or product improvements

Influence Product Development

  • Works closely with clients to understand and capture product feature requests, business needs, and implementation challenges
  • Consolidates and synthesizes client feedback into clear, actionable inputs for Product and Engineering
  • Provides context on business value, use cases, and client impact to help inform product decisions and roadmap discussions
  • Identifies patterns across client engagements that may inform improvements to Digital Asset products, implementation methodologies, or CX offerings

Raise Quality & Develop Expertise

  • Establishes and reinforces high standards for solution design, business analysis, requirements quality, documentation, and client delivery

  • Shares knowledge, methodologies, and best practices across CX and contributes to the development of reusable tools, frameworks, and delivery approaches

What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of experience in product development, technical business analysis, solution design, enterprise software delivery, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience leading complex Agile software delivery initiatives, either as a lead consultant, solution lead, product professional, or senior delivery practitioner

title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information.

Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information.

Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Senior Electrical Design Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Electrical Design Manager

 

Location - United Kingdom

 

Role Summary

 

As Senior Manager, Electrical Design, you will act as a senior electrical technical authority within STACK Infrastructure's EMEA Design & Engineering function. You will define, govern and continuously improve STACK's electrical engineering standards, helping to ensure consistent delivery of the European Reference Design across regions.

Working at platform level, you will shape electrical resilience, capacity modelling, grid interface strategy, power distribution architecture and energy performance alignment across mission-critical data centre developments. This is a high-impact role for an experienced electrical design leader who can balance technical excellence, commercial judgement and future-ready thinking for hyperscale environments.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Own and maintain the electrical architecture within STACK's European Reference Design, including utility interface, HV/LV configuration, generator strategy, UPS architecture and modular power building block standards.

  • Define and govern electrical resilience models, ensuring power distribution standards remain scalable, consistent and aligned to customer, operational and investment requirements.

  • Validate capacity modelling assumptions, including MVA to MW IT conversion, load growth, diversity assumptions and partial versus full build-out scenarios.

  • Provide senior technical oversight at design stage gates, reviewing and challenging consultant designs for compliance, resilience integrity, constructability, maintainability and client requirements.

  • Shape platform-level grid and infrastructure strategy, including utility connection configuration, on-site substations, dual-feed resilience positioning, generator capacity and autonomy assumptions.

  • Support technical due diligence and early feasibility activity by assessing power availability, infrastructure risks and abnormal assumptions before underwriting or investment decisions.

  • Approve structured deviations from electrical standards and lead peer reviews for high-risk or high-complexity schemes across the EMEA portfolio.

  • Develop the roadmap for future electrical requirements, including higher rack densities, AI-driven load profiles, liquid cooling implications, energy efficiency evolution and alternative generation technologies where relevant.

  • Partner with commercial, development, delivery and engineering teams to evaluate CapEx drivers, specification changes, yield opportunities and investor-level technical risk.

  • Develop and maintain electrical engineering standards, technical guidance, Basis of Design inputs, QA checklists and peer review frameworks, ensuring consistency across regions.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex electrical engineering environments.

  • Deep technical expertise across MV/LV distribution systems, generator and UPS topology, resilience strategy, capacity modelling and grid connection processes.

  • Strong understanding of electrical design trade-offs, including resilience, scalability, energy performance, constructability, maintainability and commercial optimisation.

  • Experience working with developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platforms is highly advantageous.

  • Confidence reviewing complex consultant designs, challenging assumptions and translating technical risk into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • A governance-led approach to standards, documentation, version control, QA and structured decision-making across multi-region programmes.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align technical, commercial, delivery, operations and investment teams.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. Chartered Engineer status, or progress towards chartership, is preferred.

  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to mentor others, promote technical excellence and support continuous improvement across design practices.

 

What We Offer

 

  • Work on critical digital infrastructure, supporting the development and operation of some of the world's most advanced data centre environments.

  • Build your future with STACK, gaining exposure to large-scale projects and clear opportunities for professional growth across a fast-growing European platform.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

 

About STACK Infrastructure

 

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world's most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

title: (Senior) Electronics Engineer, Hardware & Firmware (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As an Electronics Engineer (Embedded Hardware & Firmware) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will help design and build the physical and low-level intelligence that brings our robotic hands to life.

You will own the complete embedded hardware and firmware stack—from schematics and high-density multilayer layouts to the real-time C/C++ firmware running directly on the metal.

Fitting multiple drives, high-density tactile arrays, and power electronics into a hand-sized volume means every decision is a tight balance of space, thermals, signal integrity, and manufacturability. You will work closely with the CTO and cross-functional team, moving smoothly between architecture, circuit design, and the lab to solve complex problems where physics meets code.

What you will do:

  • Own the hardware architecture. Design schematics and high-density, multilayer PCB layouts (mixed-signal, tight thermal/EMC constraints) built for modularity across product variants—not a one-off prototype.

  • Build control hardware and firmware that can't miss a beat. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate actuator hardware alongside motor drivers for compact servo drives; write deterministic real-time firmware (C/C++) for control loops, timing-critical execution, limit monitoring, and fault handling.

  • Choose the right sensor and make the data mean something. Search, evaluate, test, and integrate sensor hardware for tactile sensing and proprioception (position and force); design low-noise readout electronics, signal conditioning, filtering, and calibration pipelines to deliver clean, low-latency telemetry to the software stack.

  • Ship rock-solid bootloaders and drivers. Build field-updatable bootloaders, low-level drivers, and secure, fail-safe update strategies across product generations—documented and reliable, not tribal knowledge.

  • Build interfaces customers actually want to integrate. Implement and maintain fieldbus and hardware communication layers (EtherCAT, CANopen, Ethernet) aligned cleanly with higher-level software and robot controllers.

  • Debug on real hardware. Own the lab bring-up process from first power-on to full validation. Trace issues across the hardware, firmware, and mechanical boundaries with scopes, logic analyzers, and thermal imaging.

  • Build security into the product from day one. Support Cyber Resilience Act compliance by integrating secure boot, signed firmware updates, and hardware-level trust mechanisms early in the design cycle.

  • Build for series production, not just the lab. Design for manufacturing and test (DFM/DFT), select resilient supply-chain components with second sources, run EMC pre-compliance, and drive hardware through production ramp-up.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics, Software, and System Applications—translating mechanical and control requirements into robust, deployable electronics.

What you bring:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience developing embedded hardware and firmware for mechatronic products, including at least one product taken into series production.

  • Proven expertise in schematic capture and multilayer PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, or similar), specifically for space-constrained, mixed-signal designs.

  • Strong C/C++ skills on bare-metal or RTOS (ARM Cortex-M or similar) with a deep understanding of timing, concurrency, memory, and register-level hardware control.

  • Hands-on experience with BLDC/DC motor driver design, current/velocity/position control loops, and low-level sensor interfacing.

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, signal-integrity debugging, and getting to the bottom of transient issues with a scope or logic analyzer.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement.

Bonus:

  • Miniature electronics, high-density PCB packaging, or tight thermal constraints

  • Tactile, force/torque, or contact-rich sensor arrays

  • Real-time fieldbuses (EtherCAT, CANopen)

  • Product security: secure boot, signed firmware, CRA, IEC 62443

  • Functional safety standards (Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066)

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Frontend (Full-stack) Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

  

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of user‑facing product experiences that make complex clinical trial data intuitive, actionable, and delightful. You will own major parts of our web application, from frontend architecture and UX to integration with backend services, while remaining comfortable contributing across the stack when needed. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to ship high‑quality features iteratively and help shape the future of our platform.

 

To succeed in this role, you should have a passion for iterative product development and possess a strategic, analytical mindset. You should be comfortable navigating the uncertainties of a startup environment, adaptable to shifting priorities, and driven to transform the pharmaceutical industry. Embrace the challenge of building the future of clinical trial technology and help realize Rivia's vision of becoming the definitive unified data infrastructure for clinical trials.

 

Our stack

Some technologies we use today: Typescript & React (must-haves for this role), Java, Python, Spring, Postgres, GPT-4, AWS, Kubernetes.

 

There's no need to be a prior expert in our stack; it's more important that you learn new technologies quickly.

  

What excites you

  • Building high‑quality, performant web interfaces that delight end users and make complex data easy to understand.

  • Owning features end‑to‑end on the frontend, from initial idea and technical design through implementation, testing, and rollout.

  • Collaborating with design and product to refine UX, interaction patterns, and visual polish.

  • Occasionally working across the full stack (APIs, data models, cloud services) to unblock frontend work and ship complete product slices.

  • Thriving in a fast‑paced startup environment where you have autonomy and make strategic decisions that impact users and the team.

  • Leveraging the latest advancements in technology, particularly in AI, to develop great products.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, implementation, and maintenance of core frontend systems and user interfaces for our clinical trial data platform.

  • Build robust, accessible, and responsive React/Typescript applications that integrate seamlessly with our backend services and data infrastructure.

  • Work across the stack when required (e.g., defining APIs, adjusting backend endpoints, or working with cloud services) to deliver end‑to‑end features.

  • Provide technical leadership, helping to design scalable architectures that can support our growth to a multi‑million‑dollar business.

  • Address and resolve performance and scalability challenges, both in the frontend and, when needed, in the broader system.

  • Level up your teammates by providing mentorship and guidance

  • Coordinate closely with sales and customer success teams to ensure technical developments align with customer needs and business objectives

 

What Excites us

  • Extensive experience with Typescript and React

  • Previous experience working in a startup environment

  • Minimum four years of relevant experience

  • A proven track record of taking initiative and leading projects or teams

  • Drivers, not passengers

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities focused on delivering practical and timely solutions

  • Strong technical knowledge and expertise in current and emerging technologies

 

Hiring Process

Our hiring process takes 2-4 weeks over four distinct stages:

  1. Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

  2. Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

  3. Coding Interview: 60-minute online exercise.

  4. Meet the team: 3-4 hours.Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

 

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - AdManager
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You’ll join AdManager, the team behind everything advertisers touch in Vibe: campaign setup, performance reporting, creatives management, integrations, payments, and account management. This role exists because AdManager’s scope is growing fast, and we need senior engineering capacity to keep shipping complex initiatives without dropping the bar on quality or reliability. Three reasons to take it: you’ll own work on a product surface advertisers use every day, you’ll work with a team that runs on high ownership and low process, and you’ll be somewhere speed and technical excellence are expected to go together.

What You’ll Do

Build & Ship Advertiser-Facing Product

  • Design core AdManager features for campaign setup, reporting, and creatives management

  • Ship complex advertiser-facing initiatives from concept to production

  • Own initiatives from start to finish with minimal supervision

  • Turn ambiguous product requirements into clear technical plans

  • Define delivery milestones with product managers and engineers

Fullstack Engineering

  • Build advertiser-facing interfaces in Next.js, React, and TypeScript

  • Design scalable APIs and services for advertiser workflows

  • Design database schemas that keep campaign data clean and queryable

  • Maintain the PostgreSQL systems behind reporting and campaign data

  • Apply rigorous testing and code review across the codebase

Reliability & Production Ownership

  • Instrument every new feature with monitoring, logging, and alerting before launch

  • Debug production issues in the systems you build

  • Lead incident response and postmortems for your own systems

  • Improve codebase conventions and developer experience beyond your assigned tickets

Product & Technical Judgment

  • Propose better technical solutions to advertiser workflow problems

  • Challenge weak assumptions with pragmatic, data-backed alternatives

  • Use AI-assisted development workflows to speed up delivery

  • Protect correctness across a shared codebase

What You Need

  • You’ve shipped production-grade fullstack software with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL

  • You’ve owned projects end-to-end, from problem definition through long-term maintenance

  • You have strong backend fundamentals in API design, data modelling, and system architecture

  • You’ve owned production systems, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response

  • You can break ambiguous initiatives into technical plans and manage dependencies

  • You move fast without sacrificing reliability or maintainability

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in CTV, campaign management, or customer-facing SaaS products

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design and Test-Driven Development

  • Experience building AI-powered products

  • Experience improving developer experience or internal engineering tooling

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the pay range for this role is €74,000 - €114,000 (base salary). We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You’re building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We’ll share context; you’ll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you’d work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We’ll work through it together.

  4. Team Interview — Meet the team members you'd work with directly.

  5. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we’re holding a consistent, high bar.

  6. Offer — Fast. We don’t let good decisions sit.

  7. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Support Analyst, London

Who We Are:

Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

We are looking for a Support Analyst to join our Corporate Technology team in London. You will support a range of systems across the breadth of our ecosystem. You will be the first point of contact for our employees when technology gets in the way of their work, covering everything from laptops and login issues to first-line support for the business systems our teams rely on every day.

This is a hands-on, people-facing role. Our hospitality and workplace experience is award winning, and the technology behind it has to be just as dependable. You will resolve the majority of issues yourself, escalate cleanly and quickly when you cannot, and help us spot the patterns worth solutioning.

You will work alongside IT, Network, Software, and Infrastructure engineers, and you will have real visibility into how a global technology organisation is run.

This role is based out of our beautiful and brand new London office at 200 Aldersgate St (5 days a week on site).

Please note: candidates must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.

What You'll Do:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across macOS and Windows endpoints, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Okta, Active Directory, and other Convene business systems.
  • Provide first-line (L1) support for business applications: access and permissions questions, basic configuration, data corrections, and triage of functional issues before they reach system owners.
  • Triage, prioritise, and manage tickets in our service desk, keeping requesters informed at every stage.
  • Coordinate escalations to L2 and L3 support, engineering, vendors, and other functions across the business, tracking dependencies through to resolution rather than handing them off.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Execute technical onboarding for new starters and offboarding for leavers, including account provisioning, device build and assignment, and access reviews.
  • Handle sensitive identity changes with care and accuracy, for example legal name changes across ADP, Okta, and downstream systems.
  • Follow defined protocols for urgent deactivations and security incidents to protect company and client data.
  • Maintain device compliance, patching, and configuration through our MDM platform.
  • Support badge and physical access platforms alongside our Security and Workplace teams.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact incidents, and capture the detail the team needs to automate repetitive work.
  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence so employees can self-serve and colleagues can pick up where you left off.
  • Explore new tools and approaches, and tell us when you have found something better.

What We Look For:

  • 3+ years in a technical support, help desk, or IT operations role.
  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting across macOS and Windows.
  • Working knowledge of Okta (or a comparable IdP), Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Active Directory.
  • Experience supporting SaaS business applications such as Salesforce, including user administration and access management.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform (Jira Service Management or similar) and a documentation tool such as Confluence.
  • Clear, patient written and verbal communication with non-technical colleagues at every level, including senior stakeholders and clients.
  • Sound judgement about when to solve, when to ask, and when to escalate.

What's nice to have:

  • Endpoint protection platforms (Sophos Central or equivalent) and MDM/UEM tooling (Omnissa Workspace ONE, Intune, Jamf).
  • Basic scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python) or experience with no-code automation in Jira or Okta Workflows.
  • Experience in hospitality, events, professional services, or another environment where the client is in the room.
  • Relevant certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals).

We're Here For You:

  • Subsidised eye care

  • Employee Assistance Program: well-being support and personal advice programme

Time Off and Work-Life Balance

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, and company sick pay

Professional Development and Recognition

Community and Impact

Convene is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and we believe that diverse teams are the best teams. title: (Senior) Influencer Marketing Manager DACH (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
DAS IST DER JOB

Location: Deutschland (Remote möglich)

Wir sind everdrop – eine schnell wachsende D2C Brand mit der Mission, die Welt der Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte nachhaltig zu verändern. Du entscheidest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead, wo wir investieren, was wir skalieren und was wir stoppen. Dabei nutzt du deine Creator-Beziehungen, Daten und KI, um neue Standards für unser Team zu setzen.

Als (Senior) Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bei everdrop werden das deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Budget- & Portfolio-Ownership: Du verantwortest den Großteil unseres monatlichen Kooperationsbudgets im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenständig. Du steuerst ein hochvolumiges Portfolio aus Always-on-Creatorn, Performance-Partnern und Top-Creatorn und allokierst Budgets nach CAC, NC ROAS und Skalierungspotenzial. Du bist bereit, Budgets konsequent umzuschichten, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.

  • Datenanalyse auf Expertenniveau: Du analysierst die Performance über den gesamten Funnel, von CPM und CTR über CVR und AOV bis zu CAC, NC ROAS und LTV. Du baust Dashboards und Forecasts selbst und kannst jederzeit belegen, warum eine Kooperation performt hat oder nicht. Deine Analysen sind die Grundlage für Budgetentscheidungen im Management.

  • Creator-Beziehungen & Verhandlung: Du bringst ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Creatorn und Management-Agenturen mit und baust es weiter aus. Du führst anspruchsvolle Vertrags- und Rahmenverhandlungen mit Top-Creatorn und Agenturen und entwickelst Vergütungsmodelle für nachhaltig hohen NC ROAS und langfristige Partnerschaften.

  • Kreatives Testing mit System: Du denkst in Hypothesen und isolierst Variablen sauber. Du planst Testing-Roadmaps für Produkte, Hooks, Formate und Angles, wertest sie statistisch belastbar aus und überführst die Learnings in Briefings, Bundles und Landingpages.

  • KI als Hebel und neuer Standard: Du setzt KI dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit steigert, zum Beispiel bei Creator-Scouting und -Scoring, Performance-Auswertung, Briefing-Erstellung oder Content-Analyse. Du entwickelst daraus Workflows und Best Practices, die das ganze Team nutzt, und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kritisch.

  • Konzeption, Bundles & Verkaufspsychologie: Du übersetzt Daten in messerscharfe, kreative Creator-Briefings, konzipierst unwiderstehliche Produkt-Bundles und gestaltest Landingpages mit, gezielt mit verkaufspsychologischen Triggern für maximale Conversion.

  • Schnittstelle zum Performance-Team: Du bist der verlängerte Arm von Paid Media. Du erkennst, welcher Creator-Content als Ad auf Meta oder TikTok performt, sicherst die nötigen Nutzungsrechte und lieferst dem Team laufend frisches Creative-Futter.

  • Channel-Expansion: Du bringst neue Plattformen und Formate in den Mix und baust sie datenbasiert auf. Gerade Social Commerce wie TikTok Shop (Affiliate-Programm, Live-Shopping) ist für uns ein spannendes Feld.

  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Management und Kolleg:innen, coachst bei Bedarf Junior-Kolleg:innen und hilfst, Prozesse, Benchmarks und Reportings im Team zu professionalisieren.


DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Wir glauben, das könnte ein gutes Match sein!

Bei everdrop arbeiten Menschen mit Growth Mindset, die Lust darauf haben, immer wieder Neues zu lernen. Wenn du gerne eigene Ideen einbringst, Lust hast, Dinge von Beginn an mitzugestalten und die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen mitbringst, könnte das der Anfang einer wunderbaren Love Story sein.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Senior-Vorerfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im performance-getriebenen Influencer Marketing in einem schnell wachsenden D2C-E-Commerce-Umfeld oder einer Performance-Agentur, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Budgetverantwortung.

  • Budget-Verantwortung: Du hast bereits einen Großteil eines monatlichen Creator-Spends im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und kannst nachweisen, welchen Impact deine Entscheidungen hatten.

  • KI-Kompetenz: Du hast KI bereits praktisch im Marketing eingesetzt, etwa für Analyse, Automatisierung oder Content-Prozesse, und kannst Beispiele nennen, wie du damit Ergebnisse verbessert oder Zeit gespart hast.

  • Analytische Exzellenz: CAC, NC ROAS, CVR, CPM und LTV sind dein Alltag. Du kannst komplexe Performance-Daten über den gesamten Funnel hinweg eigenständig auswerten, Zusammenhänge erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und daraus klare Budgetentscheidungen ableiten. Du hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch, trennst Korrelation von Kausalität und stellst deine Erkenntnisse so dar, dass auch das Management sofort handeln kann.

  • Netzwerk: Du bringst bestehende Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Agenturen im DACH-Raum und idealerweise darüber hinaus mit, sodass wir schnell Zugang zu starken Partner:innen bekommen.

  • Verhandlungsgeschick: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit komplexen Verträgen und Rahmenvereinbarungen mit Top-Creatorn und Management-Agenturen.

  • A/B-Testing-Mindset: Du isolierst Variablen, denkst in Hypothesen und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Konsumentenverständnis: Du kennst Direct-Response-Prinzipien und weißt, welche psychologischen Trigger Conversions auslösen, im Storytelling der Creator ebenso wie auf der Landingpage.

  • Ownership: Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit Durchschlagskraft, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine KPIs und behältst auch bei hoher Kampagnendichte den Überblick.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (mind. C1) und sichere Englischkenntnisse. Französisch, Italienisch und Polnisch sind ein Plus.

  • Plus: Erfahrung mit TikTok Shop (Affiliate, Live-Shopping, GMV-Tracking).

DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub (plus 24.12. und 31.12. frei)

  • zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)

  • eine Outdoor-Fitnessanlage neben dem Büro sowie eine Special Rate für deine EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

  • kostenloses veganes Mittagessen einmal pro Woche und Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine

  • ein monatlicher Gutschein für everdrop Produkte in unserem Mitarbeitershop

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft und Discounts über FutureBens & Corporate Benefits

    Darüber hinaus erwarten dich ein wunderschönes, offenes Büro in der Nähe der Isar, ein Macbook solange du bei everdrop arbeitest, regelmäßige Team-Events, ein starker Teamgeist und ganz viele Office-Hunde die sich schon darauf freuen, dich kennenzulernen!

Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Unser Commitment, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen, ist mit JEDI-Prinzipien verbunden. JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft. Wir verpflichten uns dazu, daran zu arbeiten, systemische Barrieren abzubauen und eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jede Stimme gehört wird. Dies setzen wir durch konkrete Maßnahmen um:

  • Im Unternehmen: Wir schaffen Awareness und Flexibilität, z. B. durch bedingungslose 'Power Days' für menstruierende Kolleg*innen oder unsere 'Green & Social Impact Days' für gesellschaftliches Engagement.

  • In der Community: Wir nutzen unsere Plattform, um das Bewusstsein für soziale und ökologische Gerechtigkeit zu stärken.

Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

#1 WE ARE AMBITIOUS
#2 WE TAKE OWNERSHIP
#3 WE ARE SOLUTION-ORIENTED
#4 WE ARE AWARE

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

Wir sind ganz bestimmt nicht perfekt – aber wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden und mit jedem Schritt etwas Neues dazulernen. Genau darum geht es ja bei jeder Reise. Kommst du mit?

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day
