title: (Senior) IT Security Consultant – Vulnerability Management & Container Security (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest Sicherheitslücken nicht nur identifizieren, sondern deren Analyse, Bewertung und Behebung durch intelligente Prozesse und Automatisierung nachhaltig verbessern? Du arbeitest gerne hands-on mit Security-Tools, APIs und Container-Technologien und möchtest auch KI gezielt für effizientere Security-Prozesse einsetzen?

Bei carmasec unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, ihre digitalen Infrastrukturen sicherer zu machen. Unser Team aus Security-Expert:innen arbeitet mit viel technischer Freiheit, kollegialer Unterstützung und minimaler Reisetätigkeit in anspruchsvollen Projekten.

Mit langjähriger Beratungserfahrung, agilen Arbeitsweisen und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung unterstützen wir unsere Kunden branchenneutral und herstellerunabhängig.

Wir legen großen Wert auf kollegiale Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Bei komplexen Aufgaben findest du immer Unterstützung im Team.

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst, bewertest und priorisierst Sicherheitslücken anhand von CVE, CVSS, Exploitability und dem jeweiligen Risikokontext und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du implementierst, konfigurierst und entwickelst Vulnerability-Management-Plattformen wie DefectDojo weiter, um Schwachstellen zentral zu erfassen, zu bewerten und nachzuverfolgen.

  • Du integrierst unterschiedliche Security-Scanner und optimierst die Konsolidierung, Normalisierung und Deduplizierung von Security Findings.

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst Security-Workflows für die Bewertung, Zuordnung und Nachverfolgung von Schwachstellen und setzt dafür APIs, Skripte und geeignete Schnittstellen ein.

  • Du entwickelst KI-gestützte Ansätze zur Analyse, Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Security Findings und integrierst diese in bestehende Security-Prozesse.

  • Du analysierst und sicherst Kubernetes- und OpenShift-Umgebungen ab, identifizierst Schwachstellen in Container-Infrastrukturen und setzt Maßnahmen für Container Hardening und sichere Konfigurationen um.

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung technischer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und unterstützt sie dabei, ihr Vulnerability Management nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Gemeinsam suchen wir nach Projekten, die zu deinen Interessen und Stärken passen.

Qualifikation

Deine Fähigkeiten (wichtig für uns)

Für uns ist es wichtig, dass Du Spaß daran hast, Neues zu lernen und Dein Wissen weiterzugeben.

Das wünschen wir uns von Dir:

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und in der operativen IT Security und bist mit der technischen Analyse, Bewertung und Bearbeitung von Sicherheitslücken vertraut.

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in DefectDojo oder vergleichbaren Vulnerability-Management-Lösungen und Erfahrung mit der Integration von Security-Scannern sowie der Verarbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Findings.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CVE, CVSS und risikobasierter Schwachstellenbewertung und kannst technische Risiken unter Berücksichtigung von Exploitability und Sicherheitskontext fundiert priorisieren.

  • Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, OpenShift und Container Security mit und hast Erfahrung in der Analyse und Absicherung containerbasierter Umgebungen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit API-Integrationen, Skripting und der Automatisierung von Security-Prozessen. Dabei arbeitest du strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und hands-on und setzt technische Lösungen eigenständig um.

Deine Fähigkeiten (nice to have)

Über folgenden Fähigkeiten von Dir freuen wir uns, ansonsten erlernst Du die Aspekte im Rahmen der Einarbeitung:

  • Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI- und LLM-Technologien und hast diese bereits zur Security-Analyse, Klassifizierung von Findings oder Automatisierung von Workflows eingesetzt.

  • Du besitzt gute Python-Kenntnisse und hast Erfahrung mit Security-Tools wie Trivy, Grype, OWASP Dependency-Track oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.

  • Du kennst dich mit Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), Software Supply Chain Security und Open Source Vulnerability Management aus.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Sicherheitskonzepten wie RBAC, Network Policies, Pod Security Standards oder CIS Benchmarks.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse in DevSecOps und CI/CD-Security mit und hast idealerweise bereits Security-Scans in automatisierte Build- und Deployment-Pipelines integriert.

Falls du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung.

Benefits

  • Selbstverwirklichung: Freiraum zum Ausprobieren, eine offene Fehlerkultur und die Mitgestaltung von Strukturen im Unternehmen sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

  • Dein Weg zur Expertin/zum Experten: Unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden begleiten Dich bei Deiner persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Arbeite in Deiner produktiven Zeit und plane private Verpflichtungen flexibel ein. Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Du hast die Wahl zwischen verschiedenen Angeboten wie
    Deutschland-Jobticket, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Kitaplatzes
    Förderung oder Job Rad.

  • Weiterbildungen: Wir investieren in Deine Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Weiterbildungen und renommierte Zertifizierungen.

  • Individuelle Hardware-Auswahl: Du entscheidest, welche Hardware Du nutzen möchtest.

  • Geringe Reisetätigkeit: Wir arbeiten remote oder in unseren Büros in Köln oder Essen. Besprechungen vor-Ort beim Kunden sind bei uns die Ausnahme.

  • Teambuilding: Unser monatlicher Open Space dient der kreativen Arbeit an aktuellen Themen. Regelmäßige Events (z.B. gemeinsame Workation, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier) werden vom Team selbst geplant und umgesetzt.

  • Workation: Kombiniere Arbeit und Reisen oder nimm Dir eine längere Auszeit im Rahmen eines Sabbaticals.

  • Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr und Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe.

Du brennst für Cyber Security und bist begeistert, Teil eines starken und diversen Teams zu sein, in dem auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt. Wenn Du unser Unternehmen langfristig mitgestalten möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank und unkompliziert. Es erwarten Dich keine endlosen Fragerunden oder Assessment Center. Im Interview geht es uns vor allem um den lockeren Austausch und das gegenseitige Kennenlernen.

Schick uns lediglich einen kurzen Lebenslauf mit den wichtigsten Stationen, die für die Stellenausschreibung relevant sind. Wir melden uns umgehend zurück und vereinbaren einen Termin via Microsoft Teams.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (f/m/d) – Commercial Law
descriptionHtml:
To further strengthen our Legal Department in Munich, we are looking for an experienced, pragmatic and business-oriented Senior Legal Counsel (f/m/d) – Commercial Law.

In this role, you will take ownership of the drafting, review and negotiation of a broad range of national and international commercial agreements across the Agile Robots Group. You will work closely with our Business, Engineering, Procurement and Management teams, providing practical legal advice on commercial transactions and projects involving robotics, hardware, software and industrial automation.

You will report to the Legal Director Germany and join our Legal team in Germany, currently comprising four members. You will also collaborate with five additional Legal Counsel across the group internationally. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Munich, with the option to work remotely one day per week.

Your Responsibilities: 

  • Independently draft, review and negotiate a broad range of complex national and international commercial agreements, including supply, procurement, sales, service, cooperation, development, licensing, software and technology agreements as well as NDAs, taking ownership from initial instruction through negotiation and execution.
  • Advise on complex project-related contracts and support cross-functional teams throughout the entire project lifecycle, including Proof-of-Concept and Proof-of-Technology projects.
  • Address IP-related provisions in commercial, technology and development agreements, particularly licensing and the allocation of intellectual property rights, in collaboration with colleagues specializing in IP.
  • Act as a trusted legal business partner for internal stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and international group companies, proactively identifying legal and commercial risks and developing pragmatic solutions.
  • Support legal matters across the group's international subsidiaries and acquired businesses, collaborating with other members of the Legal team on cross-functional matters as needed.
  • Develop and maintain the group's commercial template library, negotiation playbooks and contracting processes together with internal stakeholders.

Your profile:

  • You are a fully qualified German lawyer (Volljurist) with strong academic credentials.
  • You have at least five years of post-qualification experience, including relevant experience in commercial contract law gained at a leading international law firm. Previous in-house experience, whether through an in-house role or a substantial secondment, is highly desirable.
  • You have substantial hands-on experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements and are comfortable independently leading negotiations with sophisticated counterparties.
  • Experience advising technology, software, hardware or industrial businesses, including IP-related contractual matters such as licensing and the allocation of intellectual property rights, is an advantage.
  • You have excellent drafting, negotiation and communication skills, take ownership of your work and provide pragmatic, commercially oriented advice.
  • You combine professional excellence with a down-to-earth attitude, a sense of humor and a collaborative mindset, and are happy to support colleagues beyond your immediate area of expertise.
  • You are fluent in German and English and comfortable negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in both languages

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Senior Legal Counsel (Director)
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Legal Counsel (Director)

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Legal Counsel (Director) to join Radiant's Legal Team, working alongside and reporting to the General Counsel as one of the first lawyers in the business. You will take ownership of and lead on contractual negotiations and drafting of a wide range of agreements covering our customers and supply chain, plus areas of compliance and the development of new systems and processes. You will get to shape how the business operates and functions, allowing it to seize opportunities and grow rapidly, whilst managing risk, scaling sustainably and keeping clear long-term goals in focus.

Strong technical legal skills are the bedrock of this role, combined with a strong sense of commercial judgment and the wider risk environment. The answers are not always clear or certain and being able to balance a range of factors and still give clear guidance or make a decision is part of this role.

Your experience will ideally be built in commercial contracting within the data centre and AI space or, more generally, IT or technology, alongside developing or running in-house compliance programmes.

You will work across hyperscaler and enterprise customer contracts, supply chain arrangements and data centre agreements. Integrating with our debt financing and understanding and managing how that impacts and shapes so much of what we do will be critical. Supporting or leading on ABC and other areas of compliance will be essential.

Additional areas of work will be numerous. You need to be at ease with being out of your comfort zone, bringing your experience and intelligence to new areas and will view this as a great opportunity to grow and expand rather than just turning up 9 to 5. This is a role for someone who gets stuck in: happy leading on and owning work, working collaboratively cross-function, figuring out the answers and coming up with solutions, as well as guiding others, as Radiant builds its Legal function to enable the business to succeed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead on the negotiation and drafting of complex hyperscaler and enterprise customer contracts for GPU as a service, balancing commercial opportunity with risk and managing pertinent regulatory matters.

  • Lead on supply chain agreements for the procurement of hardware and associated maintenance services, along with data centre agreements and FM outsourcing arrangements that underpin how Radiant builds and operates its infrastructure.

  • Understand the importance of financing to our business and how this threads through the Radiant ecosystem. Help ensure our customer and supply chain arrangements enable and are carefully calibrated against our financing requirements. Build connectivity across the business to help manage those requirements throughout their lifetime to keep Radiant well funded, stable and ready to seize future growth when opportunity arises.

  • Advise colleagues, including the C-Suite and Heads of Department on regulatory and contractual positions as deals develop.

  • Assist the General Counsel in developing Compliance at Radiant (including anti-bribery and corruption, data protection, modern slavery and broader corporate compliance).

  • Work with a wide range of business functions to integrate Compliance into how we operate and ensure Radiant meets its legal and regulatory obligations as it grows in scale and expands into new markets.

  • Support the General Counsel and business more widely in maturing and scaling Radiant as it grows at pace. Set-up or help set-up new systems, processes and interconnectivity throughout the group to empower the business, breaking-down or preventing silos and ensuring that decision-making is informed and risk-adjusted yet agile.

  • Partner closely with commercial, procurement, development, operations, technology, and business leadership teams to achieve the business’ goals.

  • Instruct and manage external counsel across multiple jurisdictions where specialist input is needed.

  • Partner with the General Counsel on legal strategy and priorities.

  • Help shape how the Legal function operates as it grows, including developing templates, playbooks and ways of working with the business.

Other Responsibilities May Include:

  • Support or lead on horizon scanning.

  • Help manage the group’s Trademarks portfolio.

  • Support in areas across the business, such as Company Secretarial and Governance, HR, Marketing, Finance and so on.

  • Assist with planning, permitting, power and construction-related matters, drawing on specialist advice where needed.

  • Acquisitions and joint ventures.

Qualifications:

  • 7–10+ years PQE, with strong relevant post-qualification experience and ideally trained and at least several years post-qualification at a top tier law firm.

  • A commercial contracting background, ideally with GPU-as-a-service or data centre experience but otherwise in the IT and technology sector and across services, outsourcing and equipment supplies, from both a customer and supply chain point of view.

  • Meaningful experience negotiating customer, supplier, procurement, technology, and commercial agreements, preferably with exposure to complex agreements. Being self-sufficient in respect of and being able to lead on the same. A hands-on approach: comfortable drafting and negotiating yourself, not only directing others.

  • Strong in-house experience is preferred, particularly within a fast-growing or technology-led business, albeit exposure to a large, sophisticated, enterprise is useful as well.

  • Established track-record of working in multiple jurisdictions and being confident progressing matters on your own, bringing in external advisors to support when sensible or required to do so.

descriptionHtml:

Great to Have (but not required):

Benefits

title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior Lifecycle Marketing ManagerDepartment: Marketing
Location: London (Hybrid 2 days a week)

We’re looking for a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to lead lifecycle marketing for self-serve software at Disguise. 

In this role, you’ll own lifecycle marketing across the end-to-end customer journey, from first sign-up through to renewal. As we build a product-led growth model, you’ll use product usage data to drive users to value quickly, keep them engaged, and grow their value over time. You’ll design and build automated programmes yourself, with real scope to shape our lifecycle marketing foundations in HubSpot.

Disguise sits at the heart of the biggest live and virtual experiences in the world. Our market-leading technology enables users to imagine, create, and deliver the most inspiring productions across live events, immersive experiences, virtual production, and broadcasting.

To support the transition from hardware-first to a software-led ecosystem, we’re opening our products to a much wider market of independent operators, smaller shows, and venues through self-serve software subscriptions. Your role is to build the customer journeys that turn new subscribers into long-term customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and execute the lifecycle marketing strategy for self-serve software customers across email and in-product channels
  • Map customer journeys by segment and lifecycle stage, and build automated, personalised programmes for onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, adoption, retention, expansion, and winback
  • Define the activation milestones (“aha moments”) that lead to long-term usage, and develop journeys that help new customers reach them quickly
  • Work with Product, Engineering and Analytics to bring product usage data into HubSpot, and use it to build segments and automated triggers
  • Set the lifecycle content strategy, working with Marketing and Customer Success on guides, tutorials, and product updates
  • Run onboarding and cancellation surveys, and use the insights to reduce drop-offs, friction, and churn
  • Run a continuous “always-on” experimentation engine across messaging, segmentation and creative
  • Own the lifecycle reporting and measurement framework, including setting KPIs for each programme such as activation rate, time to value and free-to-paid conversion
  • Work with Product, Customer Success and the broader Marketing team to align lifecycle programmes with product launches and the marketing roadmap

Experience we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing within a subscription-based business where customers buy online
  • You have built onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, retention and winback programmes from the ground up, and scaled them into a full set of automated journeys
  • You’re a strong copywriter, with experience writing email and in-product messaging for different customer segments and lifecycle stages
  • Strong track record of building automated, behaviour-based journeys in a marketing automation platform, ideally HubSpot
  • Proven experience using product usage data to improve activation, conversion and retention
  • Hands-on experience analysing performance data in tools such as Mixpanel, Power BI, Salesforce (or similar)

Skills, behaviours and values we’re looking for:

Skills:

  • Product-led growth: understands how product usage drives conversion, retention, and expansion
  • Strategic thinking: able to move from test campaigns to a scalable lifecycle marketing engine
  • Commercial acumen: understands subscription unit economics and recurring revenue models

Behaviours:

  • Curious and explorative: actively seeks new ways to engage customers
  • Experimental: comfortable testing, iterating, and learning quickly
  • Outcome-driven: balances innovation with tangible commercial impact
  • Autonomous yet collaborative: drives initiatives while building strong cross-functional alignment

Values:

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: operates confidently in emerging, undefined market spaces
  • Evolutionary: continuously adapts based on user and market feedback
  • Fearless: explores new territories and challenges assumptions
  • Resilience: persists through iteration to develop scalable lifecycle models
  • No Ego: approachable, authentic, and humble

About Disguise

Disguise is the industry-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real-time spectacle.
We partner with the biggest entertainment brands and companies in the world to deliver the A-list of live music events, live TV broadcasts, immersive experiences, installations, theatre, film and TV production, corporate communications and brand product launches. Working with Disney, Snapchat, Netflix, ESPN, the Burj Khalifa, and Adele, Disguise is the number one partner delivering the next dimension of entertainment. 

Watch our showreel

Don’t Disguise your differences.

Innovation comes from everyone. We strive to create a workplace that reflects our diverse audience. We celebrate our people for their full authentic selves, and embrace uniqueness. Inclusion and Equity matter at Disguise. We create together and we create everywhere. 

Our values

  • Honest. We are real with ourselves and our clients and share our ideas with openness and transparency.

title: Senior Manager, Maintenance Compounding (Enfield, UK)
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

This role reports to the Director of Maintenance and Reliability. The Senior Maintenance Manager leads the maintenance and reliability function for our London compounding pharmacy, providing high-level support to Pharmacy Operations and Engineering through predictive and preventive maintenance programmes for all production, utility, and facility equipment. This position analyses, troubleshoots, and communicates maintenance problems and concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air and process gases, HVAC, and clean utilities, as they relate to equipment and controlled environments in the pharmacy. The Senior Maintenance Manager works with general supervision and interacts regularly with the Director of Maintenance and Reliability to receive guidance and feedback. Many non-routine activities will require the Director’s advance approval.

This position will be in Enfield.

You Will:

  • Lead a team of maintenance technicians, supervisors, and managers across a multi-shift, multi-discipline operation.

  • Own the predictive and preventive maintenance programme for all GMP equipment, including automated compounding and filling equipment, isolators and cleanroom pharmaceutical safety cabinets (PSCs), laminar airflow (LAF) units, autoclaves and depyrogenation ovens, pharmaceutical fridges, freezers, and cold storage, balances, and associated controls.

  • Maintain and reliably operate facility and clean utilities, including HVAC and cleanroom environmental systems, purified water, compressed air, nitrogen and other process gases, and chilled and hot water systems.

  • Document maintenance, technical, and other data on predictive and preventive maintenance charts, as required.

  • Diagnose and repair equipment and systems throughout the facility, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air, PLC/controls, and HVAC repairs.

  • Identify facility and equipment issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take remedial action using a predictive maintenance approach.

  • Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks, product quality impact, or loss to Hims & Hers or its colleagues.

  • Work as directed in all areas of the facility to maintain health and safety standards, ensuring compliance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, PUWER, LOLER, the Pressure Systems Safety Regulations, and COSHH.

  • Perform and oversee calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards.

  • Conduct regular checks and measurements to verify equipment performance, including temperature, pressure, differential pressure, airflow, and other relevant parameters.

  • Maintain calibration records and documentation in compliance with GMP, MHRA, and GPhC requirements.

  • Ensure that all equipment meets regulatory and quality standards and take corrective actions to address any non-compliance.

  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance, the Responsible Pharmacist, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs to implement and maintain proper documentation, including equipment logs, maintenance records, change controls, deviations/CAPAs, and qualification and validation reports.

  • Support equipment and facility qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), commissioning, cleanroom classification and requalification (BS EN ISO 14644), and environmental monitoring activities, and maintain the validated state of equipment through the change control process.

  • Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimise downtime and protect patient supply.

  • Work closely with pharmacy and production personnel to coordinate repairs and planned maintenance and minimise disruption to the compounding schedule.

  • Develop and manage the maintenance budget, spare parts strategy, and external contractor and vendor relationships.

  • Identify opportunities for process optimisation, efficiency improvements, and cost savings related to equipment maintenance and operation.

  • Participate in cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and contribute to a continuous improvement culture within the organisation.

  • Stay up to date with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practice related to pharmaceutical and compounding equipment maintenance.

  • Make sure all assets, parts, and work orders are updated and tracked in the CMMS for all facility equipment.

You Have:

  • Right to work in the United Kingdom.

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a related field, such as engineering.

  • Ability to safely lift and carry items weighing up to 25 kg, either in conjunction with regular responsibilities or those assigned in other areas as directed.

  • Proficiency with business computer systems and applications, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and project management tools.

  • Ability to troubleshoot problems with machinery without supervision or direction.

  • Ability to document predictive and preventive maintenance charts, technical data, and other data; interpret data and provide relevant input for process improvement.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with others in spoken and written English.

  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach overhead, and climb ladders; ability to climb stairs up to three flights and work at height using scissor or bucket lifts.

  • Ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with others.

  • Capacity to receive and apply cross-functional training; willingness to assist other functions and work groups as needed so the department achieves or exceeds its business objectives.

  • Ability to comprehend and adhere to all company policies and procedures, including those related to attendance and scheduling, honesty and integrity, confidentiality, safety, and conflicts of interest.

  • 5+ years of experience in maintenance or engineering within the pharmaceutical industry, or a similar regulated industry (e.g., MHRA, CAA).

  • Working knowledge of GMP requirements (MHRA Rules and Guidance for Pharmaceutical Manufacturers and Distributors, the “Orange Guide”; EU GMP Annex 1 where applicable) and experience maintaining equipment in a GMP environment.

  • Demonstrated high-level ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and operate advanced technical equipment in a related industry.

  • Demonstrated ability to teach and motivate in a highly technical and fast-paced environment.

  • 10+ years of formal leadership experience with direct reports, both hourly and salaried.

  • Knowledge of and experience with PLC systems.

  • Knowledge of and experience with CMMS systems.

  • Ability to present problems and solutions in a formal setting to mid- and senior-level management.

  • Ability to delegate complex tasks and follow up on completion.

  • Experience working with multiple facilities and other facility managers to implement systems and solutions to network-level problems.

  • Ability to assess talent at both the salaried and hourly level to provide performance management and reward based on accomplishments and ability.

  • Ability to evaluate personnel needs and adapt existing resources by structure and shift to enhance the business and support operations.

  • Business acumen, emotional intelligence, and willingness to objectively assess issues (both operations and personnel) and provide solutions.

  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and be available for emergency situations.

  • Formal training or certification (e.g., NVQ/City & Guilds, HNC/HND, or equivalent) in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, PLC systems, or HVAC trades.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience leading multi-discipline teams.

  • 10+ years of maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing or compounding facility (including MHRA-licensed “Specials” or GPhC-registered sterile and non-sterile compounding), or a similar GMP environment with the equipment referenced above.

  • 10+ years of electrical knowledge and electronic principles.

  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) status, or advanced degree or training in engineering, maintenance, or another related field.

  • Advanced formal training in lean or Six Sigma.

Compensation: £60K – £100K • Offers Equity

Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.

title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, Customer Ops & Specialist Services
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits  ✨

Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐

We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. We are recruiting for 4 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: Complaints, VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements), Financial Health and Core Customer Operations.

Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area. 

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.


🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

  • Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.
  • Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.
  • Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.
  • Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.
  • Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.
  • Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.
  • Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.
  • You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.
  • You have a proven track record of leading through others and  can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.
  • You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.
  • You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Recruiter call (25 minutes)
  • Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)
  • Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE#LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it’s a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Privacy

Deliveroo will process your personal information in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Network Engineer

  • Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

  • Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works


What you bring

  • A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

  • At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

  • Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 3, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

About the Role

Summary

Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

 

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.

 

This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability.

  • A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window.

  • Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.

  • Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release.

  • Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

  • Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

What You'll Do

  • Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy.

  • Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

  • Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.

  • Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release.

  • Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet.

  • Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content.

  • Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface.

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team.

  • Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter.

  • Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually.

  • Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is.

  • Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations.

  • Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it.

  • Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform.

  • Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers.

  • Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security.

  • Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls.

  • Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction.

  • Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Menlo Mindsets

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

  • Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go.

  • Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises.

  • United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.

  • Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.

  • Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.

    • What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research.

About Menlo Security

Menlo Security's mission: Enabling humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely without compromise. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies, to protect their most important asset — their data — and is backed by top-tier investors.

Our Compensation and Benefits

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen
  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen
  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört
  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen
  • Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen
  • Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben
  • Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen
  • Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen
  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
  • Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung
  • Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen
  • Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

  • einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,
  • einen reinen Projektmanager,
  • einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,
  • einen Presales-Spezialisten,
  • einen reinen Strategen,
  • einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

  • Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus
  • Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams
  • Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit
  • Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

title: Senior Product Manager - User Platform
descriptionHtml:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications.
You’ll bring together consumer experience and technical product strategy, working closely with engineering, design, research, insights, security, and teams responsible for Spotify’s clients and partnerships. Your decisions will help people get to the experiences they want, stay in control of their access, and use Spotify with confidence.
What You'll Do
  • Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for session management across Spotify’s clients, device types, and strategic partner integrations.

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We're seeking a Senior Product Security engineer to develop novel security tooling, discover vulnerabilities, and ultimately secure our suite of advanced technologies including artificial intelligence systems, command and control platforms, aerospace vehicles, and long range sensors.

The ideal candidate has a background in electrical or software engineering, with a focus on platform security, or has pivoted to a product or application security role. They will be able to conduct complex security architecture reviews, research and mitigate exploits against hardware and software, and work with other engineering teams to build resiliency into our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Owns the development and maturation of security features for Anduril’s products

  • Collaborates with manufacturing and operations teams to develop secure handling and operational processes
  • Engages with teams to remediate uncovered weakness in designs, implementations, integrations, and processes

  • Experience building, testing, and delivering production-ready systems, especially for embedded and/or Linux systems
  • Experience with structured threat modelling and risk assessment methodologies
  • Experience in building and security autonomous systems and their unique threat model
  • Experience in any previous military or defence domain; land, air, sea desirable but not mandatory

  • Strong and professional communication skills (written and verbal)
