title: Senior Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Recruiter to be the face of Taktile for our future team members. Your primary responsibilities will include sourcing, recruiting, and managing the candidate journey to ensure we attract and hire exceptional talent. As a key driver of our growth, your work will directly influence the success and scalability of our operations.

This role is perfect for someone eager to play a central role in shaping Taktile's organization. We are looking for a skilled recruiter who knows how to identify and attract top talent and who thrives in the fast-moving, competitive landscape of AI.

This role is based in our London or Berlin office. We believe great recruiting is highly collaborative and relationship-driven, so we work together in person at least three days per week.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full recruiting cycle for a portfolio of GTM roles, from role scoping with hiring managers through offer close, moving fast without sacrificing quality or candidate experience.

  • Build and execute sourcing strategies tailored to each role, using LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-assisted tools, and creative outreach to reach both active and passive candidates.

  • Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, not just an executor. That means shaping job requirements, challenging assumptions, and keeping searches on track when priorities shift.

  • Deliver a standout candidate experience at every touchpoint: clear communication, timely feedback, and a process that reflects Taktile's values even when we're moving quickly.

  • Leverage data to drive decisions. Track pipeline health, identify drop-off points, and share regular hiring funnel updates that lead to action, not just reporting.

  • Act as a strong partner and domain expert to the organization. Collaborate closely with leaders to comprehend their hiring needs and develop recruiting strategies to meet headcount targets. This person will be a senior partner to our leaders and shape our overall talent strategy.

  • Contribute to how we hire, not just who we hire. Help refine our assessment frameworks, improve structured interview practices, and bring new ideas for how Taktile stays competitive in a tight talent market.

  • Support employer branding and talent marketing through events, content, and community presence, making Taktile a name candidates recognize and want to join.

  • Collaborate with People Ops to ensure smooth handoffs post-offer, including onboarding coordination, relocations, and visa support where needed.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in proactive sourcing and talent acquisition, preferably in high-growth startups or dynamic environments.

  • Deep experience hiring across GTM functions- including Account Executives, BDRs, Solutions Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, & Marketing. You know how to read a strong GTM candidate and how to sell a compelling opportunity to them.

  • Experience partnering with leaders throughout the recruiting process, acting as a strong hiring partner and trusted advisor.

  • Actively using AI tools in your recruiting workflow- whether for sourcing, outreach personalization, candidate research, or pipeline management. You stay current with the evolving recruiter tech stack and bring a point of view on how AI can make hiring smarter and faster.

  • Skilled in using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS tools, and Google Suite to streamline the recruitment process for both active and passive candidates.

  • Proficient in sourcing talent across a range of seniority levels, from entry-level graduates to senior professionals.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The company is hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the commercial engine behind our growth. You’ll own the systems, data, and processes that keep Sales moving fast and Leadership fully informed.

This is not a reporting role – it’s an operating one. Your goal is to increase our revenue through designing and implementing better commercial systems. You’ll design a scalable workflow, translate raw signal into actionable intelligence, and make sure every quote, deal, and forecast connects seamlessly across Sales, Tech, and Operations.

You’ll work side by side with Sales Leadership, BDRs, Operations and Product to synchronize demand, supply, and revenue forecasts. Expect to spend your days turning noise into structure, friction into flow, and data into decisions that move millions in GMV every week.

What You’ll Drive

  • Revenue predictability and accountability across the entire funnel.

  • Adoption of standardized sales processes across markets and teams.

  • Identification of revenue potentials in SME and enterprise accounts

  • Clear, reliable visibility into team performance and forecast accuracy.

  • Incentive models that drive win-win for the individual and the company’s growth

  • Increase of sales productivity through targeted initiatives and process improvements

What you will do:

  • Land-and-expand motion: Steer the farming motion by identifying account potentials across products and prioritizing sales opportunities

  • AI adoption: Collaborate with the Tech team to deploy new automations or integrations (Salesforce Engagement, Aircall, Slack workflows, AI-driven analytics).

  • Funnel Analytics & Forecasting: Build and maintain advanced dashboards to track funnel performance from MQL to close, ensuring accurate visibility of volume, velocity, and conversion in close alignment with the supply side.

  • Data Infrastructure Ownership: Maintain and enhance CRM data integrity, enrichment flows, and automation rules linked to Salesforce, Slack and internal pricing tools.

  • Reporting & Insights: Develop data models and reports in Salesforce, Google Sheets, and Metabase to provide actionable insights on revenue, demand planning, and sales performance by segment, country, and product line.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Procurement and Finance to align supply and sales forecasts, ensuring coherent demand planning and margin tracking.

  • Enablement & Coaching Support: Design sales dashboards and internal tools that empower the sales function to monitor KPIs, drive accountability, and coach based on real-time data.

Who you are:

  • 3–5 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Data Analytics, ideally within a fast-paced B2B sales or trading environment.

  • Strong understanding of B2B sales funnel metrics, forecasting methodologies, and sales efficiency KPIs.

  • Proven expertise in Salesforce administration, reporting, and process design (custom fields, validation rules, approval flows, automation logic).

  • Strong skills in Claude Code or the AI platform of your choice - you are expected to build MVPs for your initiatives and test them with the sales team to prove impact

  • Experience working with high-volume transactional sales cycles and multi-market data models.

  • Fluent in English; German, French, or Italian is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 2-sided platforms where demand drives supply and supply impacts demand

  • Experience with Salesforce for Slack, Salesforce Engagement, or Agentforce.

  • Ability to work with data ingestion and automation tools

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: (Senior) Robotics Testing and Applications Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Agile Robots SE is a high-tech startup based in Munich. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI and robotics by developing robotic systems that offer state-of-the-art full-body force sensitivity and world-leading vision intelligence. This unique combination of technologies enables us to provide intelligent, easy-to-use and affordable robotic solutions with safe human-robot interaction.   We are a dynamic and innovative software development company dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology. We specialize in creating cutting-edge solutions that transform industries and redefine user experiences

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute structured test plans for robotic components, modules, and fully integrated systems
  • Validate functionality, robustness, and performance of software and hardware in real robotic platforms
  • Develop Python-based test scripts, tools, and automation frameworks to improve testing efficiency and coverage
  • Contribute C++ code when required for low-level testing, tooling, or integration support
  • Analyze robot behavior and system performance, identifying root causes for issues related to kinematics, motion planning, control, perception, or hardware interaction
  • Evaluate and debug complex robotic behaviors such as singularities, joint limit violations, trajectory instabilities, and configuration inconsistencies
  • Work with URDF models, coordinate transformations, and robot descriptions to validate system correctness
  • Support development and refinement of application demos, internal showcases, and customer-facing use cases• Collaborate closely with software, electronics, controls, and mechanical teams to reproduce issues and validate fixes
  • Document test procedures, results, defects, and system performance in a clear and structured manner
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing strategies, coverage, and automation infrastructure• Support field tests, prototype validation, demos and integration activities when required

Essential Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in robotics testing, applications engineering, integration, or system validation roles
  • Strong hands-on experience writing Python for testing, automation, data analysis, and robot interaction
  • Experience with C++ is a plus (especially for writing tests, tools, or interfacing with robot drivers)
  • Solid understanding of core robotics concepts, including kinematics, dynamics, singularities, joint limits, URDFs, coordinate transformations, and motion constraints
  • Experiencein  testing and validating software and hardware modules in integrated robotic systems
  • Ability to design, execute, and analyze structured test plans — including edge case testing, regression testing, and real-world scenario validation
  • Strong debugging skills across software and hardware layers
  • Experience with Git, JIRA, and structured issue tracking workflows
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and system-level understanding• Excellent communication and documentation skills in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience building and maintaining robotics application demos for internal stakeholders or customers
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for robotics software
  • Familiarity with motion planning frameworks and validation of planning outputs
  • Knowledge of perception systems (cameras, LiDAR, IMUs) and sensor integration testing
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) or simulation-in-the-loop (SIL) validation
  • Familiarity with robotics safety concepts and validation procedures
  • Experience supporting customer deployments or reproducing field issues
  • Background in data visualization, performance benchmarking, or telemetry analysis
  • German or Mandarin language skills

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

About the role

This role will play a critical part in ensuring our customer support systems (Service Cloud, Zendesk, Gainsight) are reliable, well-integrated, and enabling scalable revenue operations.

You will work within our Salesforce team, liaising closely with the data team, and business stakeholders across Renewals and Customer Success to ensure systems and integrations support end-to-end revenue processes and help optimise the tech stack to deliver tech efficiencies to the company.

Responsibilities:

  • CSM System Ownership
    • Act as the technical SME for the customer support ecosystem, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.
    • Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimisation of Service tools (Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Gainsight).
  • Integration & Data
    • Monitor and support integrations between Salesforce, CSM tools and other key business systems.
    • Investigate data-flow issues and work with internal engineering teams or external partners to resolve them.
    • Gather requirements and contribute Salesforce expertise to integration design.
  • Process Enablement
    • Support key processes with the CS teams to translate business requirements into system solutions.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Data & Reporting
    • Ensure accurate and timely data flows between systems to support reporting and analytics.
    • Collaborate with the Data team to ensure Salesforce data is properly modelled and available in downstream systems (e.g. Databricks, BI tools).
  • Governance & Best Practice
    • Establish and maintain standards for system configuration, documentation, and change management.
    • Ensure appropriate access controls, compliance, and auditability across the Customer Support stack.

The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Trading Infrastructure | Python/Linux
descriptionHtml:
BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam.

Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock.

In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust.

What will you do?

You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back.

You will:

  • Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one.

  • Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on.

  • Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk.

  • Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves.

  • Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments.

  • Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does.

  • Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark.

  • Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role.

  • At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders.

  • A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter.

  • A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer (ML Platform).

In this role you will work on the ML platform inside Rosso, improving the infrastructure, tooling and standards that let us develop, train, evaluate, monitor and iterate models quickly and with confidence. You know ML engineering deeply and will contribute to model improvements where it matters, with a primary focus on building the platform and tools that help the whole team work faster and better.

You will:

  • Build the systems that let us deploy, iterate, and scale ML and optimisation models without friction.

  • Give us clear operational visibility into how every model is performing, and where it is not.

  • Build evaluation and backtesting tooling for ML models, pricing and trading strategies.

  • Take ownership of model inference and training in production. The role includes work-hours on-call responsibility, and may extend to out-of-hours in the future.

The metric this role moves: number of effective forecasting & optimisation ML models deployed within our stack. Success means a new model goes from idea to trusted production with standard tooling, clear evaluation and confidence from day one.

Responsibilities

ML infrastructure and deployment

  • Shape and improve the infrastructure that underpins ML deployment across pricing, forecasting, prediction and optimisation.

  • Design and build the systems that let us take a model from experiment to production quickly and repeatably.

  • Scale models and pipelines as volume, markets and complexity grow.

Observability and quality

  • Build the tooling and code that ensure models run reliably and produce sensible results.

  • Create operational and analytical monitoring so we catch failures, drift and degradation early.

  • Build confidence in our input data through validation, checks and clear data contracts.

Evaluation, experimentation and backtesting tooling

  • Develop the tooling and abstractions to evaluate ML models and optimisation algorithms during experimentation, including backtesting of pricing and trading strategies.

  • Standardise processes and data structures so each new model is faster to ship than the last.

Data systems

  • Mature the data systems (databases, pipelines, validations, ingestions) that let us manage model rollouts safely.

Ownership

  • Own model inference and training in production, including on-call during working hours. There is no out-of-hours on-call today, though this may change as the platform grows.

  • Contribute directly to model improvements where your ML expertise moves the needle.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Strong ML engineering foundations: experience developing, deploying and improving ML models in production.

  • Experience contributing to or building an MLOps stack, including ensuring reliability and observability.

  • Experience with the scaling pressures and complexities of large-data ML workloads, and designing data systems (pipelines, databases, query patterns) to handle them.

  • Experience with time-series forecasting in particular.

  • Knowing what good looks like in a ML platform, and being ready to build it in a high-ownership environment.

Bonus points

  • Probabilistic modelling and quantifying uncertainty, for example probabilistic forecasts, calibration or Bayesian methods.

  • Quant tooling experience, such as building backtesting frameworks or evaluation tooling for trading or optimisation strategies.

  • Any of the above in finance or energy, including automated trading systems.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

title: Staff Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 4, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 4 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see.   • Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster

Observability & production confidence

  • Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue

  • Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist

Change confidence & release quality

  • Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing

  • Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them

  • Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation

  • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

Platform enablement

  • Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default

  • Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene

  • Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices

  • Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit

  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

  • Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

  • Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

  • Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

title: Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol
descriptionHtml:
Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol

Locatie: Haaften | 32–40 uur | Start: februari, maar mag ook per direct!

Wat jij tijdens je stage maakt wordt straks écht gebruikt op onze bouwplaatsen

Hoe ziet een goed ingerichte bouwplaats eruit? Waar hoort de bewegwijzering? Welke uitstraling geven we bouwhekdoeken? Hoe maken we duidelijk wat de standaard is voor veiligheid, afval, parkeren of bezoekers? En vooral: hoe zorg je dat een uitvoerder niet eindeloos hoeft te zoeken, maar in één oogopslag weet wat nodig is en welk materieel daarbij hoort?

Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol: een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken.

Dit maakt deze stage interessant:

Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. De volgende dag orden je alle informatie die al binnen Dura Vermeer beschikbaar is. Daarna schrijf je een richtlijn zo dat iemand hem in een paar seconden begrijpt en zet je die in Adobe InDesign om in een pagina die ook visueel klopt.

Je hoeft dus niet te kiezen tussen schrijven of ontwerpen. Je doet allebei.

Dit ga je doen:

  • bestaande richtlijnen en informatie binnen Dura Vermeer verzamelen en structureren;

  • bekijken hoe bouwplaatsen nu worden ingericht en waar collega's in de praktijk tegenaan lopen;

  • praten met uitvoerders en collega’s binnen Dura Vermeer Materieel;

  • bepalen welke onderwerpen, standaarden en middelen in het Dura Vermeer-protocol thuishoren;

  • foto's, illustraties, iconen, tabellen en andere visuele middelen maken en inzetten om informatie snel duidelijk te maken;

  • waar nodig nieuwe communicatiemiddelen of formats ontwikkelen;

  • het complete protocol vormgeven in de huisstijl van Dura Vermeer;

  • kritisch testen of iemand op de bouwplaats er ook daadwerkelijk snel mee kan werken en het protocol op basis van deze feedback verbeteren.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om na te denken over vragen als: hoe maken we een document van deze omvang prettig om te gebruiken? Wat moet je laten zien in plaats van uitleggen? Welke informatie hoort bij elkaar? Welke dingen helpen een uitvoerder echt verder?


Wat breng jij mee

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we niet alleen iemand die mooi kan vormgeven. En ook niet alleen iemand die goed kan schrijven. Juist de combinatie is belangrijk.

Jij:

  • vindt het leuk om veel informatie terug te brengen tot een logische structuur. Je kunt een technisch verhaal begrijpelijk opschrijven en hebt tegelijkertijd oog voor typografie, beeld, hiërarchie en vormgeving;

  • volgt een hbo-opleiding zoals Communicatie, Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Media & Design, Crossmedia Design, Marketingcommunicatie, Visual Communication/Graphic Design of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • schrijft helder en foutloos Nederlands;

  • kunt werken met Adobe Creative Suite;

  • kunt zelfstandig informatie ophalen, ordenen en keuzes onderbouwen;

  • vindt het leuk om collega's uit verschillende vakgebieden te spreken en hun kennis te vertalen naar een bruikbaar eindproduct.

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een afstudeer- of meewerkstage met duidelijke opdracht en zichtbare impact;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invulling;

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 700,- per maand;

  • Begeleiding vanuit communicatie en nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit de praktijk;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen van de bouwplaats én de materieeldienst.

Waarom dit interessant is

Je werkt niet aan een onderzoek dat in de la verdwijnt, maar aan een product dat straks op al onze bouwplaatsen zichtbaar is. Je combineert analyse, creativiteit en praktijk en levert iets op wat direct gebruikt wordt door uitvoerders en projectteams.

descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

Wir bauen myScribe – eine KI-gestützte Dokumentationslösung, die Ärztinnen und Ärzten den Rücken freihalten soll, damit sie sich wieder auf das konzentrieren können, wofür sie eigentlich Medizin studiert haben: Patientinnen und Patienten. Dazu kommt myScribe Connect, mit dem wir unsere Lösung tief in die Krankenhaus-IT integrieren.
Klingt nach Mission? Ist es auch. Aber wir sind kein Pitch-Deck – wir sind ein Produktteam, das jeden Tag echten Code in echte Kliniken bringt.

Wo wir gerade stehen
myScribe läuft heute dort, wo die Ärzt*innen arbeiten: On-Prem, in der Klinik-IT, bei zahlenden Kunden in der DACH-Region. Trotzdem releasen wir mehrmals pro Woche – Continuous Deployment, Fix-Forward, ohne Wartungsfenster-Drama. Im Gesundheitswesen? Eher unüblich.
Doch der Markt verschiebt sich: KI-Inferenz wird teuer, Kunden öffnen sich für die Cloud, SaaS rückt in den Fokus. Um diesen Wandel – und alles, was noch kommt – aktiv mitzugestalten, bauen wir gerade das Core-Entwicklungsteam auf, das myScribe durch die nächsten Jahre trägt. Sei dabei.

Aufgaben

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Founders Associate und den Gründern zusammen. Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich strategisch relevante Projekte – von der Marktanalyse bis zum Investorenmemo. Du denkst in Kontext, nicht in Aufgaben. Du verstehst, warum eine Entscheidung getroffen wird, und bringst dich aktiv ein.

  • Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalysen – du beobachtest den Healthcare-SaaS-Markt und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Investorenmaterial – Pitch Decks, Memos, Fact Sheets: du bringst Substanz in unsere Außendarstellung
  • Business Cases & Pricing-Strategie – du modellierst Szenarien für neue Produkte, Märkte und Preisstrukturen
  • Partnerstrategie – du identifizierst potenzielle Partner (Kliniken, Verbände, Tech-Partner) und entwickelst Outreach-Ansätze
  • Ad-hoc-Projekte – strategische Fragestellungen direkt aus dem Führungsteam, mal klein, mal komplex

Qualifikation

Wie wir arbeiten
Kein Scrum-Theater, keine wochenlangen Review-Zyklen. Eine These am Montag, eine fundierte Empfehlung bis Ende der Woche – das ist unser Anspruch. Wir geben dir eine Spielwiese: Wenn du eine Idee hast, wie wir besser werden können, bring sie. Wir wollen Drive, keine Leute, die auf Aufgaben warten.

Was wir uns von dir wünschen

  • Studium der BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbar (mind. 3. Semester)
  • Analytisches Denkvermögen – du kannst Komplexität strukturieren und auf den Punkt bringen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was du nicht brauchst
Einen Healthcare-Background. Den lernst du bei uns. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich in eine komplexe Domäne reinzudenken – und dort wirklich Spuren zu hinterlassen.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

title: System Identification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

  

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

  

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

 

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Technical Product Manager (Superapp)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Quick call with the Talent Team (30 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Technical Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our global Recruiting team. In this role, you will focus on hiring engineers across our Trading Technology (live trading environment) and Research & Development (enabling research) engineering teams. You will partner directly with hiring managers who have incredibly high standards, helping them navigate a competitive talent landscape. You will engage with deeply technical candidates, and manage the end-to-end hiring process for a variety of technical roles within HRT’s engineering ecosystem. 

HRT is one of the top quantitative trading firms in the world. We combine world-class engineering and scientific rigor with a low-ego, collaborative culture. Our people and our compute capabilities are our two most important differentiators, and that is where we are investing the most. We want recruiters who bring a unique perspective and curiosity, who can challenge the status quo of how to find the brilliant yet humble technical talent that make HRT so special. 

Responsibilities 

  • Partner directly with engineering leadership on recruitment strategy, and be a proactive and consultative strategic partner to hiring managers
  • Manage the end-to-end hiring pipelines of engineering roles from first outreach through offer acceptance, including navigating complex offer negotiations
  • Provide a high-touch, white-glove candidate experience across both opportunistic roles and high-volume pipelines
  • Apply an engineering mindset to your recruitment approach, continuously leveraging recruiting data & analytics to identify inefficiencies and iterate on your process
  • Build relationships with external recruitment agencies to generate high-quality candidate flow for your roles
  • Conduct market research and talent mapping projects to identify top technical talent, uncover candidate trends, and complete competitor analyses
  • Attract passive candidates using creative sourcing methods (open-source community involvement, network building, direct outreach, referrals) to build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs

Qualifications 

  • 3+ years of full life cycle technical recruiting experience 
  • Bachelor’s degree 
  • Proven success recruiting in specialized technical domains 
  • Strong talent mapping capabilities—comfortable researching companies, org structures, roles, and skills in depth
  • Data-driven mindset with experience using recruiting analytics to guide strategy 
  • Excellent cross-functional verbal and written communication skills 
  • A passion for building technical teams and delivering an outstanding candidate experience 

The estimated base salary range for this position is 150,000 to 250,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

title: Third Party Risk Analyst (Vendor Security Assessments)
descriptionHtml:
Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for growing technology companies certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. We are appointing a Third Party Risk Analyst as an associate contractor to carry out supplier security assessments for our clients.

Your first assignment is a review of the suppliers used by an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. The work runs from December 2026 to February 2027 at about 2 to 3 days a week, then moves to a lighter monthly review. You will work with our ISMS Manager and Cyber Assurance lead, who check your work and stay accountable for quality.

This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate.

Tasks

  • Build and keep a complete list of the client's suppliers, with what data each one holds and how critical it is.

  • Risk rate each supplier as high, medium or low using our method.

  • Send and follow up security questionnaires, and collect evidence such as SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certificates and penetration test summaries.

  • Review the evidence, record gaps and agree follow up actions with the supplier owner.

  • Check data processing agreements and security terms are in place for suppliers that handle personal data.

  • Record everything in the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta Vendor Risk Management) so it is ready for audit.

  • Set review dates so each supplier is checked again at the right time.

  • Report progress each week in plain English, with clear actions, owners and dates.

  • Follow Intelance quality, security and confidentiality procedures.

Requirements

Essential

  • At least two years of hands on supplier security or third party risk work.

  • Able to read and judge a SOC 2 Type II report and an ISO 27001 certificate and Statement of Applicability.

  • Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 supplier controls (5.19 to 5.23).

  • Experience with a compliance or vendor risk platform such as Vanta, Drata, OneTrust or Whistic.

  • Organised, persistent and good at chasing replies without upsetting suppliers.

  • Clear, concise writing.

  • Based in the UK and able to work as a self-employed contractor.

Desirable

  • Experience with SaaS and cloud suppliers.

  • Knowledge of UK GDPR data processing agreements and international data transfers.

  • A security or privacy certificate such as CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 Foundation, CIPP/E or similar.

Benefits

  • Join Intelance's specialist cyber assurance associate panel.

  • A clear first assignment with steady work over the winter, then ongoing reviews.

  • Remote work with a written scope, timetable and agreed day rate.

  • Support and review from an experienced assurance team, with structured templates.

  • Flexible, project based work you can fit around other commitments.

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for references. Anonymised examples of past work are enough at application stage. Please do not send confidential client material.

title: Unity Intern
descriptionHtml:
Join Our Team as a Unity Developer Intern at Beyond Sports!

Hi, I’m Leon, part of the team here at Beyond Sports, and I’d love to invite you to consider joining us as a Unity Developer Intern!

Beyond Sports is a visualization company that is changing the way the world experiences sports. We work with the biggest leagues and broadcasters in the world—including the NFL, NHL, NBA and more—to turn real match data into groundbreaking, real-time virtual experiences.

From creating the Inside Out Classic altcast with Disney Pixar to building live virtual worlds for fans, our work is at the forefront of sports technology. As part of Sony’s sports businesses, we’re a passionate, creative, and ambitious team based in Alkmaar—and we’re looking for the next generation of talent to join us.

If you’re passionate about Unity, real-time 3D, and want to see your work come to life on a global stage, this could be the perfect internship for you.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Unity Developer Intern, you’ll be a real part of the development team. You won’t be observing from the sidelines—you’ll actively contribute to projects that are experienced by millions of sports fans around the world.

Working closely with developers, artists, and producers, you’ll help bring data-driven sports experiences to life.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing, testing, and debugging real-time 3D applications using Unity and C#

  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-structured code together with the team

  • Assisting with integrating new features, from data processing to visual output

  • Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews

  • Collaborating with experienced developers and learning from their expertise

  • Contributing your own ideas to solve technical challenges and improve our products

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we value curiosity, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are eager to learn and continuously improve your technical skills

  • Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking analytically

  • Take initiative and feel ownership over your work

  • Have a strong eye for detail

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a team environment

About You

  • Currently enrolled in (or recently graduated from) a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field

  • Experience with Unity (Unity3D) and C#

  • Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles

  • Familiar with version control systems, preferably Git

  • Good communication skills in English

  • Available to work on-site in our Alkmaar office

Nice to have:

  • Affinity with sports (e.g. football, American football, ice hockey)

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum

  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines

Why Start Your Career at Beyond Sports

You’ll be part of an international and energetic team where no day is the same. We work on cutting-edge technology, move fast, and make sure there’s always room for fun alongside hard work.

We also make sure it’s a great place to grow:

  • Daily lunch prepared by our in-house chef

  • Fresh fruit, snacks, and beverages

  • Friday drinks and regular team outings

  • A social and international work environment

  • The opportunity to work on products seen by millions worldwide

  • A chance to learn from experienced developers in a fast-growing tech company

Ready to Change the Game?

If you’re excited to combine your passion for technology and sports, we’d love to hear from you.

At Beyond Sports, you won’t just be learning—you’ll be building the future of sports experiences.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
descriptionHtml:
Supervisor

Location: Vauxhall (SE11)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £15.55 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Supervisor to join our Vauxhall team. In this role, you’ll be the beating heart of our daily site operations, maximizing customer satisfaction by ensuring our loyal customers receive their household essentials as quickly as possible.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the HOP Operations team. This team is responsible for the end-to-end management of our rapid grocery delivery sites, ensuring inventory accuracy and lightning-fast dispatch.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Dispatch Excellence: Oversee that all orders are picked to meet time targets and lead the dispatch area to ensure seamless packing for our customers.

  • Manage Inventory Rigour: Unload deliveries according to procedure, ensuring total accuracy of product locations, date rotations, and claims logging.

  • Maintain Operational Standards: Ensure the warehouse remains clean, tidy, and safe at all times, dealing with hazards urgently and conducting regular H&S checks.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Manager to ensure the site runs smoothly and employees follow company procedures.

  • Ownership of Stock Integrity: Ensure stock counts are 100% accurate across all designated counting areas.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Operational Experience: Proven ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments (FMCG, Retail, Warehouse, or Last-mile delivery is a major plus).

  • Performance Driven: A track record of hitting goal targets, such as pick times or dispatch KPIs.

  • Natural Leadership: A "lead by example" mentality with a genuine passion for motivating and coaching junior team members.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to finding new ways to improve site operations and resolve challenges as they arise.

  • Adaptability: The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a high-energy, positive team environment.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with structured progression pathways.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

  • 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Many roles offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend shifts.

What We Offer

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Access to great discounts and free Deliveroo Plus!

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support or reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application.

Qualifikation

title: Working Student Data Engineer – Python, SQL & Cloud Platforms
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run.

Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use.

What you will do

Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources.

Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation.

Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible.

Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting.

Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows.

Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline.

Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows.

A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines.

Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool.

The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English.

Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth.

What you can expect

You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Describe one pipeline or data model you delivered, the decisions you owned and how you tested or improved its reliability. An anonymised example is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentixlakegmbh/

Website: https://agentixlake.com/
